Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now *and* build for long-term success.

**Job Description**

**How will you make an impact?**  
**Job Purpose**

As Patient Care Regional Manager, you will be the people manager and operational lead for Patient Care teams in your assigned European markets. You will own team performance, quality reviews, and day-to-day operations — while working closely with Country Managers and the Global Patient Care Head to align on priorities and ensure service consistency across markets.

You will be the missing link between global standards and local execution: someone who can read data, give direct feedback, run a tight operational cadence, and genuinely develop the people on your team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**People Management**

* Own performance reviews, 1:1s, and development conversations for direct reports across your markets
* Manage absence, availability, and team sizing for your region
* Lead hiring decisions and internal mobility within the Patient Care team
* Build a culture of direct feedback and consistent follow-through

**Operational Performance**

* Track and own regional KPIs: response SLA, first-contact resolution, CSAT, and quality scores
* Run quality review and moderation programs — calibration sessions, rubric definition, feedback loops
* Identify performance trends using dashboards and reports; translate them into concrete actions
* Own escalation protocols for complex patient cases

**Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Country Managers to align on priorities, workload, and service commitments
* Work with the Product/PATS team on tooling rollouts, workflow automation, and process improvements
* Contribute to the monthly Patient Voice reporting — classified ticket analysis, actionable issue surfacing
* Act as regional interface for global policy rollouts and operational changes

**Qualifications**

**What will help you thrive?**

**Must-haves**

* 5+ years in customer support, patient experience, or service operations — with at least 2 years managing people
* Experience managing teams across multiple countries in Europe (not just one market)
* Strong people instincts: direct, empathetic, consistent — someone teams trust and grow under
* Data-driven: comfortable with dashboards, pulling operational reports, and making decisions from numbers
* Experience running quality review or moderation programs (calibration, rubric design, scoring)
* Fluency in English mandatory
* Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, Notion, or similar)

**Nice to have**

* Background in healthtech, marketplace, or two-sided platforms
* Experience working with AI-assisted support tools or automation workflows
* Familiarity with Intercom, Zendesk, or equivalent support tooling
* SQL knowledge or comfort querying data independently
* Experience onboarding a new org structure or consolidating teams
* Strong plus — Spanish, Italian, Polish, or German language speaker.

**What to Expect from Our Hiring Process**

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

**Intro Chat** – A first call with our Talent Partner to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

**Hiring Manager Interview** – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with your Hiring Manager and your potential manager in this role**.** Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

**Business Case –** A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

**Additional/ Final Interview (Optional)** – A final conversation with another senior stakeholder from our Global Team.

**References & Offer!**

**Why You’ll Love It Here**

**Global Benefits –** No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:

* Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
* Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
* Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.

**Local Perks –** Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

**Career Growth –** We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

**A Truly Global Team –** Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

**Flexibility That Works for You –** Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

*Please note:*At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

**What We Believe In**

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

**Focus on results –** we're here to make an impact.

**Think like an owner –** take responsibility, drive outcomes.

**Keep it simple, keep it lean –** smart solutions over complexity.

title: Installation and Logistics Principal Engineer
description:
As the Principal Engineer for Installation and Logistics, you are responsible for the overall technical underwriting and acceptance of design, development, and implementation associated with wind turbine installation processes and site logistics. You will support defining rigor for acceptance of the design decisions for installation tooling and processes, lifting strategies and logistics strategy that will result in safe, high-quality products and services that meet customer needs.
  
  
The areas associated with Installation and Logistics include crane operations, lifting equipment design, site mobilization, transport logistics, ground preparation and up-tower installation support. For these areas, you will support Senior Principal Engineers and Chief Engineers to set and execute a strategy associated with design processes, field issue resolution, and design tools and technology.
  
  
You will collaborate with design teams, cross-functional teams and other designated experts across subsystems to achieve desired outcomes, sometimes executing the work yourself. You will mentor and develop engineering talent, creating technical depth within the Installation and Logistics domain.
  
  
This is a leadership position and requires technical proficiency and adept problem-solving skill while developing fundamental capabilities for organizational advancement.
  
  
As the Principal Engineer for Installation and Logistics your curiosity, problem-solving skills, and ability to lead design teams will be crucial in ensuring we can technically underwrite that our products and services are of high quality and meet customer needs. Your passion for innovation, your capacity to solve technical challenges head-on, and your ownership to develop technical talent will drive your success in OneWind Engineering.

**Job Description**
===================

* Provide technical leadership and guidance to the design teams involved in Installation and Logistics within the OneWind engineering team across all stages of the project lifecycle, spanning from conceptualization and design development to product launch and ongoing fleet operations.

* Accountable for overall technical underwriting of designs in the areas of Installation and Logistics and site execution processes, and consequently, accountability for the design itself.

title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer – Wind Turbine Driveline Systems
description:
The successful candidate will be a part of GE Vernova’s Wind Global Machine Head Driveline subsystem. The team is responsible for mechanical hardware (main bearing, main shaft, covers, rotor locks, rotor brakes, and couplings) including New Product / Technology Introduction, Validation & Testing, Field Support, and Root Cause Analysis for utility scale wind turbines.
  
  
This position will primarily support the high speed rotor lock, rotor brake, and flex coupling through the entire life cycle from conceptual design through detailed design and development, testing, qualification, manufacturing, validation, and installed fleet support. The engineer will drive technical excellence and continuous improvement in the design, analysis, cost, and reliability of the components under their responsibility.

**Job Description**
===================

**The Opportunity**

Wind turbine reliability is engineered before a single blade turns — in the design of the rotor brakes, locks, and couplings that have to perform for decades in some of the most demanding environments on earth. As a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer at GE Vernova, you will own the full design lifecycle for Machine Head Driveline subsystem components across the wind turbine fleet: from specification and analysis through validation testing, root cause investigation, and standardization across the global product portfolio.

This is a role for someone who combines deep mechanical design expertise with the judgement to make consequential decisions independently — and the collaborative instinct to bring manufacturing, sourcing, quality, and field teams along with them.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lead component design and development** — design build-to-spec rotor brakes & couplings and build-to-print rotor locks for wind turbines; own component specification design, system interaction analysis, and reliability verification through physical testing; drive new product introduction and new technology integration from concept through to validated production release.

* **Own design quality and documentation standards** — ensure quality of new and revised drawings, BoMs (Bills of Materials), and specifications in accordance with GE Vernova and industry processes; own and drive lessons learned, design best practices, and standardization into design practices, drawings, and technical specifications.

* **Develop and execute validation plans** — design testing and validation programs to prove component function and reliability; resolve field issues through root cause analysis and identify design-based corrective actions that prevent recurrence.

* **Solve cross-functional manufacturing and field issues** — work closely with quality, manufacturing engineering, sourcing, suppliers, and field support teams to improve product quality and FTY (First-Time Yield); provide design-based corrective actions for NCR (Non-Conformance Report), SDR (Supplier Deviation Request), and PAC (Product Acceptance Criteria) issues.

* **Identify and execute cost and technology improvements** — identify and deliver cost-saving strategies; introduce advanced materials, manufacturing methods, and design tools to advance the strategic position of Driveline subsystem components within the broader wind turbine portfolio.
  

**About You**

You are a senior mechanical engineer with extensive experience in component design, analysis, and validation for rotating or power generation equipment — comfortable operating with a high degree of independence while driving outcomes across global, cross-functional teams. You are also experienced working with suppliers and manufacturing processes to ensure your design is consistently produced with high quality.

**Required**

* A Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or similar discipline.

* Major experience in mechanical analysis and design in an industrial or product engineering environment.

* Working knowledge of technical drawings, GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing), and manufacturing processes.

* Proficiency in 3D CAD (Computer-Aided Design) tools — specifically Unigraphics / Siemens NX.

* Proven ability to lead global projects with team members across different geographies and cultural contexts.

* Clear communication, project management, and interpersonal skills — with the ability to present complex technical findings to diverse audiences.

* Fluent written and spoken English.

**Preferred**

* Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering.

* Experience in design and/or application of mechanical components in the powertrain of rotating equipment.

* Working knowledge of ANSYS or other FEA (Finite Element Analysis) tools.

* Experience in design or product development of mechanical components in wind turbines or other power generation products.

* Experience with system design including interface definition, system stiffness, DFMEA (Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis), and DFM (Design for Manufacturability) / DFI (Design for Installation) / DFS (Design for Serviceability) methodologies.

* Exposure to PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) processes and tools.

* Track record of collaborating with product managers and suppliers to optimize component costs and shape purchasing strategy.
  

**Why GE Vernova**

GE Vernova employees rise to the challenge of building a world that works. In this role, you will contribute directly to the reliability and performance of wind energy technology that operates at scale across the global fleet — supported by a team that values engineering rigour, continuous improvement, and long-term thinking.

We provide varied, competitive benefits designed to reward high performers and support your personal and family needs. GE Vernova invests in your continued on-the-job learning and development and provides a clear path for career growth within a global organization.

==========================

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.

**We care about our customers.** We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

**Collaborative**

**We work as one and win together,** each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

**We strive to succeed through continuous innovation.** It's our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

**We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization,** by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

title: Performance Media Buyer
description:
### **About ExoClick**

ExoClick is an innovative and global ad company serving 20 billion daily geo-targeted ads to web and mobile advertisers & publishers. We are part of EXOGROUP, a set of companies made up of +200 talents and offering a wide range of services within the digital business landscape with headquarters in Barcelona and offices in Dublin, Porto and Valencia.

We are revolutionizing the online ad-serving industry for advertisers, publishers, and networks alike and are seeking to recruit a Performance Media Buyer for our Barcelona office.

### **Role**

As Performance Media Buyer, you will work with global performance-based online advertisers across a wide variety of verticals within the adult entertainment industry. You will actively create, monitor and optimize campaigns for a portfolio of clients (both assigned and newly qualified leads) with a particular focus on effective inventory monetization, delivering a first-class service and sharing best practices within the various internal departments. Your daily tasks will also involve data analysis, preparing strategic client reports, proposals and contracts.

Together with a cross functional team, you will participate in development on new products and new marketing angles. As a top-notch media buyer you should educate and coach new media buyers in developing advertising strategies and campaigns. You will report to the Sales Director.

### **Responsibilities**

* Media buy on CPM, CPC, and CPV pricing models to back into CPA goals.
* Setup, manage and optimize campaigns using ExoClick Ad platform.
* Use of internal tools, systems and processes to keep a daily track of client development and expansion.
* Prospect and identify new potential direct response advertisers.
* Daily spend/revenue monitoring.
* Effective client relationship management, dealing with internal/external conflicts and collate best practice examples of reporting, client feedback and case studies.
* Proven technical capabilities and understanding, including basic skills in the editing of landing pages (HTML), use of tracking pixels and creative optimization.
* Close interaction with Business Intelligence, Business Development teams in order to interpret market insights, client data, and be able to react quickly and implement this back into the business.
* Effective management of your clients on performance versus target and company growth strategies.
* Support and coach existing and new employees. Help Performance team members by providing additional steps and resources that help employees move ahead with confidence.
* Collaborate with multiple departments in creation of documentation, educational material, case studies.
* Develop and incorporate new marketing angles in the user flows. Guide the marketing team on how to implement them in the marketing material.
* Participate in establishment and improvement of relevant processes of the department.
* Take responsibility and accountability over new products and projects within the department.

### **Profile**

* You have a solid working knowledge of the digital performance and affiliate marketing ecosystems, and understand the general needs of online advertisers and publishers
* Very detail-oriented with a meticulous approach and be able to manage multiple campaigns successfully
* Excellent time management and organizational skills
* Money conscious with an innovative approach and ability to thrive in a fast-paced working environment
* Proactive, a strong communicator and confident with pitching new opportunities to external clients
* Analytical mind, good with calculations and statistical interpretation
* Problem-solving attitude
* Interest in following advertising and media trends

### **Requirements**

* +2 years minimum experience in the online advertising industry as a media buyer.
* Previous Developing effective media buying strategies.
* Experience with RevShare models.
* Experience managing 6 digit campaigns directly for product owners or affiliate networks.
* We will value any experience as a media buyer or traffic manager. Previous experience with ExoClick Platform is a highly appreciated.
* Strong analytical proficiency, especially with Excel or Google spreadsheets.
* Good technical knowledge (HTML).
* Perfect knowledge of the different performance-based pricing models (CPA, CPL, CPM, CPC, etc.).
* Fluent English, written and spoken (Russian, German, French, Spanish or other languages will be highly valued).
* Strong proficiency with web applications (browsers, software).
* Experience with tracking and attribution tools.

### **What you’ll find working at ExoClick**

We offer a position in a young, dynamic and international team with exceptional working conditions in unique offices high up in the Torre Mapfre, one of Barcelona’s world-renowned landmarks, located right on the city’s seafront.

Additionally, we offer the opportunity for permanent training, personal development, ambitious career growth, and a competitive salary.

Most of all, we offer a position in a team that thrives on achievement, success, and leadership within our industry. Our core company value is innovation: where people and creativity drive innovative technology. If you have an innovative, winning mentality, this position is for you!

### **Our company benefits**

* Flexitime and summer schedule
* Private health insurance
* Your Birthday off as a paid holiday
* Flexible compensation plan: travel, meals & childcare
* Additional internal and external training through our EXOGROUP University program
* English, Portuguese & Spanish classes
* Training budget & study leave
* Employee referral program bonus - You can earn 2500Eur by referring someone!
* Exciting team buildings in locations such as Ibiza
* Office games room/chill-out zone
* Organic fruit
* Monday team breakfast
* Yoga classes
* Subsidised Well-Being activities
* Calm App
* Massages
* Subsidized catering
* Flexible remote work

Is this not the right role for you? Then make sure to check out all other roles we have open for you on our careers website.

description:

Puig is a home of Love Brands within a family company that furthers wellness, confidence and self-expression while leaving a better world. For more than a century, our entrepreneurial spirit and passion for creativity have made us a challenger in the premium beauty industry.

Puig is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, ethnicity, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Freelance Campaign Manager, Beauty (UK/ Europe)
description:
**About Kyra**
--------------

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. Our platform manages the full lifecycle — creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

**Freelance Campaign Manager | Beauty**
=======================================

**Fully remote | Up to 3 months, with potential to extend | Immediate start**

**Working hours:** Monday to Friday, 9am–6pm

We're looking for an experienced **Freelance Campaign Manager** to support one of our Beauty clients.

This is an immediate opportunity for someone who knows influencer marketing inside out, can hit the ground running and is confident owning campaigns from start to finish.

**The opportunity**
-------------------

You'll work predominantly with one Beauty client, managing creator campaigns from brief through to delivery.

Our clients move quickly, and so do we. Briefs evolve, priorities shift and campaigns often need creative problem-solving along the way.

We're looking for someone who enjoys that pace, takes ownership and knows how to deliver great work without needing constant direction.

**Your role**
-------------

* Own the day-to-day delivery of influencer campaigns, from planning through to reporting.
* Lead creator discovery, casting, outreach, negotiation and contracting.
* Manage campaign timelines, budgets, deliverables and performance.
* Keep clients informed of progress, results and any changes.
* Work closely with your Campaign Lead, with strategic client conversations supported by a Director.
* Collaborate with our Client Solutions, Strategy and wider campaign teams.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

### **Commercial performance**

* Deliver against agreed CPV, CPM, reach and engagement targets.
* Track performance and adjust budgets or creator selections to stay on target.
* Negotiate competitive creator rates while maintaining strong relationships.
* Identify changes to scope, including additional content or usage rights, and agree costs upfront.

### **Creator casting and content quality**

* Build culturally relevant casting lists that go beyond the obvious creators.
* Translate client briefs into targeted creator searches.
* Develop clear creator briefs that minimise revisions.
* Review content to ensure it meets both client expectations and quality standards.

### **Platforms, AI and data**

* Confidently manage campaigns using influencer marketing platforms, from discovery and outreach through to reporting.
* Deliver high-volume creator outreach while keeping communication personal.
* Use AI to improve research, outreach and briefing, while applying your own judgement.
* Understand TikTok, Instagram and YouTube analytics and use data to improve results.

### **Communication and ownership**

* Manage multiple deliverables, stakeholders and shifting priorities.
* Keep clients and internal teams informed without needing to be chased.
* Flag risks early and come prepared with solutions.
* Communicate performance clearly and honestly, including when results are behind target.
* Stay calm and commercially minded when challenges arise.

**What you bring**
------------------

* **3+ years' experience** in influencer marketing, talent management or campaign management.
* Proven experience managing influencer campaigns end to end.
* Experience working with **Beauty or Fragrance brands**, ideally with enterprise clients.
* Strong understanding of UK beauty trends, creator culture and audiences.
* Hands-on experience with influencer marketing platforms for discovery, outreach and reporting.
* Confident creator negotiation and contracting skills, including usage rights.
* Strong commercial awareness and experience managing campaign budgets and performance.
* Experience working in an agency, fast-growing business or similarly fast-paced environment.
* Excellent organisation, communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently and get up to speed quickly.

**Essential:** You must be available Monday to Friday, **9am–6pm**, regardless of where you're based.

**The contract**
----------------

* **Duration:** Up to 3 months, with potential for extension.
* **Location:** Fully remote.
* **Rate:** Day rate, dependent on experience.
* **Start date:** Immediate.

**How to apply**
----------------

Please send us your CV, expected day rate and earliest availability.

If shortlisted, you'll have a short conversation with our Talent team and the relevant Campaign Lead.

### **AI in your application**

AI is central to how we work at Kyra, and we encourage you to use it thoughtfully. Your application should still reflect your own experience, skills and judgement.

**Sound like you? If you know Beauty, understand creators and love delivering great campaigns, we'd love to hear from you.**

**Support**

If you have a condition or require an adjustment to our interview process - please let us know so we can make adjustments to support you. Please note that when you submit an application or resume, your data will be processed in line with our **privacy policy**.

title: Head of People
description:
Founded in 2019, Qualifyze is a leading company in supply chain compliance management in the Life Sciences industry, trusted by over 1,600 pharmaceutical and healthcare companies globally. Our digital suite of solutions connects manufacturers, suppliers, and a global network of more than 250 auditors and quality experts.

With a track record of over 4,500 audits across 85+ countries and the largest and most accurate supplier network and data analytics tools, Qualifyze stands as the all-in-one partner for quality compliance and supply chain risk mitigation in the Life Sciences sector.

We are looking for a **Head of People** who will own the **operational infrastructure** that lets Qualifyze **hire, pay, develop, and retain people effectively**: Talent Acquisition, People Operations, Performance Management, Payroll, Compensation & Benefits Administration, and Compliance. Reporting directly to the SVP of Finance, you are the backbone of the People function.

**You'll have end-to-end ownership.** Every area below is yours, from design through execution to results. You don't hand work off and step back. When something breaks, you fix it, then fix the process behind it

You'll **shape the team**, hire into new roles, and set the standards the People function runs on.

#### **Main responsibilities:**

* **Leading and developing a high-impact team:**
  + You'll lead a lean, pragmatic team across People Operations, Talent Acquisition, and Business Partnering, setting clear priorities and performance expectations while carrying your own operational workload.
  + You'll coach each team member through regular 1:1s, reviews, and growth plans, building a team that becomes a trusted advisor to managers and business leaders as the business scales, hiring into open roles, and putting shared processes in place so delivery stays consistent across every location.
* **Driving end-to-end hiring & Employer Branding initiatives:**
  + You’ll deliver the hiring plan across all entities, owning the full recruitment process from sourcing and interviews to hiring manager enablement and offer management, while strengthening our employer brand to attract the talent we need.
  + You bring a data-driven mindset, tracking and acting on metrics such as time-to-hire, pipeline health, and source effectiveness to set priorities.
* **Building scalable People Operations & HR Systems:**
  + Own and continuously improve Personio and end-to-end People Operations across our entities ensuring accurate, compliant, and scalable processes throughout the employee journey.
  + Oversee accurate and timely payroll across all entities and jurisdictions, in collaboration with Accounting and external partners, while managing benefits administration and vendor relationships.
  + Drive operational excellence through automation, self-service, and AI-enabled solutions that improve the employee and manager experience, focusing on outcomes rather than activity.
  + Ensure compliance with local labour laws, maintain employment policies, contracts, and the employee handbook, and handle employee relations cases in partnership with legal counsel.
* **Driving our rewards policy & high-impact performance:**
  + Own compensation reviews, promotions, compensation ranges, and progression frameworks, ensuring fair and consistent outcomes.
  + Maintain compliance with EU Pay Transparency requirements and related audits and reporting.
  + Lead the performance review cycle across all entities, including manager enablement, calibration, and consistent, well-documented outcomes.
  + Design and continuously improve performance frameworks, ensuring successful rollout and adoption.
* **Workforce Planning & Organisational Effectiveness:**
  + Partner directly with Finance to build and maintain workforce planning models, budget-to-actuals tracking, and headcount reporting.
  + Provide the data and process rigour needed to support organisational design and restructuring decisions.
* **Creating and Engaging Workplace & Culture:**
  + Ensure the smooth running of our offices in Frankfurt, New Jersey, Hyderabad, and Barcelona, creating environments that support productivity, community, and employee well-being.
  + Lead culture and key company initiatives, including global and local office events.

#### **Main requirements:**

* 7+ years in people, HR, or shared services roles, with direct, hands-on ownership of talent acquisition, performance management, payroll, HRIS, and compliance.
* Experience in high-change environments. Multi-country and multi-entity experience is a strong plus.
* Comfortable managing complexity across multiple jurisdictions. Practical experience with Spanish and/or German labor law is a strong plus.
* A track record of personally owning the operational execution of people processes at scale, and of managing teams across multiple locations.
* Tech-savvy with a mindset for adopting AI, automation, and process optimization.
* Fluent English is required. Spanish and/or German are a plus.
* An organized, structured thinker with a pragmatic approach to finding solutions in a fast-paced environment.

#### **Salary:**

At Qualifyze, our salary ranges are transparent internally, and we aim to follow a similar approach externally. For this role, we’re happy to share a reference point within the band: the expected salary range is around **80,000 - 85,000 €**, centred around the median.

Final compensation will depend on experience and performance during the process, with some flexibility within the range.

#### **What We Offer:**

* Competitive, annually reviewed compensation package
* Country vacation package that increases with your tenure
* ️ Country specific benefits offering incl.private health care, fitness and meal allowances
* Annual personal development budget to increase your impact
* Hybrid working mode, plus up to 3 months of the year work from anywhere.
* All the best kit and tools to work effectively
* Annual in person all company event and celebration in Europe
* Working with an exceptional team, doing some of the best work of your career

#### **Use of AI in Our Recruitment Process:**

We believe in a humanled hiring process. All applications are reviewed manually by our Talent Acquisition team, and neither Talent Acquisition nor Hiring Managers use AI to screen, filter, rank, assess, or make decisions about candidates, including during interviews and assessments. During interviews, AI may be used only to support note-taking and transcription. All hiring decisions are made by people!

#### **Diversity & Inclusion at Qualifyze:**

At Qualifyze, we value diversity and inclusion, recognizing the strength that complementary talents and perspectives bring to our team. Join us and help drive innovation, tackle challenges, and create meaningful change. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, disability, or age. Our hiring practices are rooted in fairness and respect, and we strive to create a culture where everyone feels valued and empowered.

title: Faculty Member - CSCI 1110/1111 Introduction to Programming
description:
**Seville Faculty Member: CSCI 1110/1111 Introduction to Programming**

On-site - Seville | Verto Education  
Learn more about us:  
https://vertoeducation.org/abroad-locations/study-abroad-spain/

**About Verto**

Verto is on a mission to provide the best possible start to college. We make travel and experiential education a core part of the first year, enabling students to begin their academic journey overseas before transferring to one of 70+ partner universities in the United States.

We are building a more accessible, more impactful model of higher education. We are a fast-growing, mission-driven organisation creating transformational global experiences.

**✨ About the Role**

Successful candidates will be highly motivated, energetic, student-oriented educators who bring courses to life for students through a combination of active classroom learning and experiential education. Faculty must possess a commitment to undergraduate teaching and experiential education, and be prepared to work with diverse students early in their higher education journey.

Deeply engaged learning is a key element of teaching. Faculty must be willing to help students develop necessary academic skills and build their academic identity as a new college student, alongside teaching disciplinary content. Faculty work with program staff to embed active and experiential activities into the course and will teach in traditional face to face classroom settings as well as taking students into the community. Verto’s academic team provides ongoing faculty training and support, offers regular feedback and coaching, and offers access to a wide variety of teaching and professional development resources and course/student support structures. Verto academic staff work closely with faculty to ensure unity across instructors and courses for continuity in delivering high-quality teaching and learning experiences across Verto program locations. Faculty are encouraged to collaborate with peers in their disciplines across the global Verto network.

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**

Faculty are responsible for teaching and creating an inclusive learning environment for all participants, and for following the established teaching methodologies and expectations of Verto, its Academic Provider, and other stakeholders. Faculty design courses utilizing the provided syllabi and supporting resources, including LMS and online textbooks. Faculty implement academic policies and coursework in compliance with academic requirements established with Verto’s Academic Provider(s). This includes, but is not limited to:

* Develop and deliver course(s) utilizing the provided academic policies, course syllabi and LMS (Canvas) and textbook resources, templates and timelines.
* Adhere to all local and global faculty and course requirements including delievery of all expected contact hours and adherence to teaching schedule and curriculum.
* Faculty must demonstrate appropriate conduct and treat all students, faculty and staff with respect to create an inclusive environment.
* Develop relevant, discipline-based, up-to-date course content and applied learning experiences. Willingness to advance curricular experimentation, particularly related to active and experiential learning, student development, learning assessment (e.g. rubrics) and technology (e.g. AI, Canvas) and following established best practices for curriculum development and openness to feedback is important.
* Evaluate students’ homework and provide regular and formative feedback, and score student work in a timely and constructive manner. Assess student mastery of Course Objectives and Student Learning Outcomes in your course(s).
* New faculty are expected to participate in up to ten hours of faculty training & development every semester prior to program start date and an additional five hours of ongoing professional development throughout the semester. Attend regular faculty meetings (1x1 and group) throughout the semester. Returning faculty are expected to contribute to ongoing faculty development and may be asked to share good practices, lead training, conduct course observations and/ or mentor peer / new faculty or contribute to course-specific projects.
* Teach all scheduled courses and host weekly office hours, respond in a timely, specified manner to student inquiries. Communicate promptly with local academic staff in the event of emergencies.
* Champion student success by holistic student support, monitoring student attendance & monitor student engagement, communicating care and concern requests to academic staff. Diligently meet the specific, documented ongoing needs of students with academic accommodations. Refer students to appropriate learning support services and interventions.
* Educate participants and enforce policies on Attendance and Academic Integrity, and proactively and professionally address any related grading questions, concerns or appeals with students directly, consulting with local academic staff as needed.
* Follow established academic calendar(s), relevant parts of term and grading progress and policies, and maintain highly accurate academic records related to student enrollments, attendance and academic performance.
* Accurately calculate and submit grades on-time through the LMS and via the Academic Provider’s grade reporting software (Banner), following established mid-term and end-of-term grade reporting timelines and protocols. Respond to student inquiries related to their grades in a timely manner including any grade disputes or discrepancies after the final grading period.
* Foster learning environments that are respectful and positive, conducive to early college student development, adhere to Verto values, and that are characterized by learner-centered approaches to instructional design and delivery:
  + Helping students develop their academic identity and foundational academic skills with appropriate levels of challenge and support
  + Appropriate use of professional language and tone, modeling constructive feedback and conflict negotiation
  + Active classroom management and consideration of power dynamics in faculty-student relationships
  + Auditing course materials for representation for diverse student populations by including bringing in local and global perspectives through course readings, assignments, and activities.
* Build and maintain positive, collaborative, and professional relationships with program participants, staff, and community partners.
* Share feedback with local and global Verto academic leaders to provide recommendations for academic excellence and faculty support needs.
* Participate in curriculum development projects and assessment initiatives as directed by the University of New Haven and Verto Edcuation.
* Other duties as reasonably assigned.
  

**What We’re Looking For**

* Master’s degree required, terminal degree (PhD) in English Language or a closely related field preferred.
* Minimum eighteen graduate credits in the field of study relevant to the course(s) of interest.
* A minimum of two years of teaching experience in the English language with at least one year teaching at the university level.
* Demonstrated success in teaching students with varied learning styles and abilities.
* Appreciation for, and proven record of, success in working with students of diverse economic, racial, cultural, and educational backgrounds.
* Openness to feedback and application of strategies for continuous improvement.
* Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfort level implementing policies and classroom standards that align with established policies and protocols.
* Passion for active, experiential, reflective and discussion-based learning and helping students make meaning out of their experiences.
* Eager to learn from colleagues and enjoys open collaboration and teamwork.
* Must have the legal right to work in the country for the full program duration, prior to the start of the semester. Verto Education does not sponsor visas or permits of stay.
  

**Who We’re Looking For**

The successful candidates are highly collaborative. They prioritize engaged teaching practices and will work closely with team members within and across global Verto locations, including the Program and Academic Director(s), Academic Managers, and local and global staff, to provide comprehensive student care. Candidates achieve excellence in teaching and learning to support a diverse student body. title: AI-Native Business Analyst / Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
### **Why Keyrus, Why Now!**

Keyrus is an international group of 2,800 consultants and experts across 28 countries, built on a single conviction: **AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.**

For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: **we operationalise intelligence.**

AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow: **understanding, deciding, designing, and creating.**

At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills — you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, and every deployment that compounds on the last.

Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a **Keyrus Architect of Intelligence.**

**Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two.**

### **Role Details**

**Job location:** Barcelona, Spain (Onsite model)  
**Contract type:** Employee / Contractor B2B  
**Target start date:** Early January 2027  
**Working hours:** Full-time
  
**Compensation:** €45,000–€60,000 gross per year  
**Languages:** Spanish and English

**Note:** All applications and CVs must be submitted in English.

#### **What You'll Architect**

As an **AI-Native Business Analyst / Forward Deployed Engineer**, you will help organisations transform complexity into measurable outcomes by combining **business analysis, data, AI-enabled ways of working, and human decision-making**.

Working closely with **business stakeholders and digital delivery teams**, you will help identify the real problem behind a request, challenge assumptions constructively and **translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements.** You will also bring a practical **AI-first approach** to your work, exploring how **AI and Generative AI can accelerate analysis, improve processes and help teams** validate solutions more effectively.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys working at the **intersection of business, data and technology**, and who is curious about better ways to turn ideas into outcomes.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

* Engage directly with business stakeholders to understand **processes, challenges, and desired business outcomes**.
* Translate business needs into **clear requirements, user stories, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria** for digital delivery teams.
* Challenge requirements constructively to ensure teams solve the **right business problem**, rather than simply implementing requested features.
* Act as the bridge between **business stakeholders and technical delivery teams**, ensuring alignment throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Apply an **AI-first mindset** to identify opportunities where **AI and GenAI can accelerate analysis, improve requirements quality, support prototyping, or optimise business processes**.
* Leverage AI tools as part of your daily work to increase speed, quality, and effectiveness in analysis and documentation.
* Help teams rapidly explore and validate alternative approaches rather than defaulting to traditional solutions.
* Understand and consider **data dependencies, data quality considerations, and governance implications** when shaping requirements.
* Collaborate effectively with distributed teams across **France, Spain, India, and the Philippines**.
* Build strong relationships with stakeholders through an active on-site presence in Bangalore.

#### **Who You Are**

* You are naturally curious and constantly looking for better ways to solve business problems.
* You do not see AI as a separate capability. Instead, you instinctively think **AI-first**, using AI tools to improve analysis, accelerate delivery, and challenge traditional ways of working.
* You enjoy understanding business processes, questioning assumptions, and uncovering the underlying problems that need to be solved.
* You are comfortable working between **business** and **technical teams,** helping both sides reach clarity and alignment.
* You are a**nalytical and structured**, but also p**ragmatic and focused** on outcomes.
* You are **confident challenging stakeholders constructively** when requirements, assumptions, or proposed solutions can be improved.
* You **thrive in collaborative and international environments** and enjoy working with people from different backgrounds and functions.
* You are **self-directed, take ownership of your work, and are comfortable operating autonomously** within a global organisation.
* You communicate clearly and effectively with both business users and technical teams.

#### **️** **What You Bring**

##### **Qualifications & Experience**

* Relevant academic background or equivalent professional experience.
* Strong Business Analyst experience with **strong data / CRM / Salesforce exposure**.
* Experience gathering, analysing, documenting, and refining business requirements.
* Experience producing high-quality **user stories, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria**.
* Ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams including business stakeholders, developers, product teams, and data specialists.
* Experience operating within international or distributed organisations.
* Professional proficiency in **English**.
* Able to work **on-site in Bangalore.**

##### **Technical & Professional Skills**

* Excellent **requirements engineering and business analysis capabilities**.
* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate business challenges into clear and actionable delivery requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience working closely with technical delivery teams and understanding technology constraints and opportunities.
* Practical experience using **AI and GenAI tools** to improve productivity, analysis, documentation, requirements engineering, or delivery effectiveness.
* Strong understanding of the value AI can bring to business analysis, process optimisation, and solution design.
* Ability to challenge both business and technical stakeholders constructively.
* Understanding of **data dependencies, data quality considerations, and governance principles**.
* Comfortable working autonomously while managing multiple stakeholder relationships.

##### **Particularly Valuable Experience**

* Experience using tools such as **Microsoft Copilot, Copilot for Microsoft 365, Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar LLM-based assistants** to improve analysis, documentation, problem-solving, and delivery workflows.
* Ability to demonstrate how AI meaningfully changes and improves your approach to business analysis rather than simply using AI occasionally.

##### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with **data-intensive applications**, analytics platforms, or data transformation programmes.
* Understanding of **data governance, data lifecycle management, and data quality frameworks**.
* Experience in a **Technical Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Forward Deployed Engineer, or similar hybrid role**.
* Exposure to **industrial, manufacturing, energy, or services environments**.
* Experience working in **Agile product delivery environments**.
* Familiarity with using AI to support **requirements engineering, business analysis, solution exploration, documentation, or rapid prototyping**.

#### **What Makes You Successful**

* You focus on **understanding the business problem** before defining the solution.
* You use **AI naturally as part of your workflow**, enabling faster analysis, better requirements, and more informed decision-making.
* You challenge assumptions respectfully and help stakeholders explore alternatives that may create greater value.
* You balance business needs, technical realities, and delivery constraints to arrive at practical solutions.
* You can move **comfortably** between **strategic conversations** anddetailed **requirements definition**.
* You **build trust with stakeholders** through clear communication, curiosity, and consistent delivery.
* You understand that requirements are rarely perfect on day one and are comfortable working through ambiguity to create clarity.
* You proactively identify opportunities to improve processes, accelerate delivery, and **enhance outcomes through AI-enabled approaches.**
* You contribute to collective intelligence by **sharing knowledge,** **encouraging better ways of working**, and **helping teams become more effective.**
* You combine the mindset of a **Business Analyst, Product Analyst, and AI practitioner**, using technology not as an end goal, but as a way to solve meaningful business challenges.

#### **What We Offer at Keyrus Spain**

* **Competitive salary**, paid in **14 instalments** (option for **12 from day one**).
* **Annual performance bonus**.
* **Meal allowance** (Restaurant Tickets): **€1,800/year net,** distributed over 11 monthly reloads
* **Flexible retribution plan**: transport & daycare tickets
* **Private medical insurance with Sanitas** (no copays, dental included)
* **22 days of annual leave**, increasing every 3 years (up to 26 days)
* **14 public holidays** (Madrid calendar)
* December **24th** and **31s**t are considered **company holidays when they fall on working days**
* Continuous learning via **KLX – Keyrus Learning Experience**
* A collaborative, international, and human-centred work environment

#### **How Our Salary Ranges Work**

At Keyrus, salary ranges reflect **different levels of mastery and impact within the same role** — not different job titles.

* **Bottom of the range**  
  You meet the core requirements and will need ramp-up time and support.
* **Middle of the range**  
  You are fully autonomous from Day 1 and deliver consistently.
* **Top of the range**  
  You are a reference for the role, mentor others, and raise the bar for the team.

Final offers are based on **experience, autonomy, scope, and market context**, and are discussed transparently during the process.

#### **Responsible AI & Recruitment**

**At Keyrus, all stages of our recruitment process are conducted and evaluated by human recruiters and interviewers.**  
To support accuracy and efficiency, AI may occasionally be used internally by our team exclusively for **note-taking purposes during interviews**. AI is **never** used to make decisions.

To ensure **fairness, authenticity, and the protection of confidential and proprietary information**, the use of AI tools by candidates during the recruitment process is **strictly prohibited**.

Our commitment to **responsible AI practices** ensures that hiring decisions are based solely on each candidate’s own skills, experience, judgment, and expertise.

️ **Any use of AI assistance during the interview process may result in immediate disqualification from the recruitment process.**

title: BIM Modeller - AI Product Platform
description:
**About the role:**

**About Janus Digital** Janus Digital ™ is the agentic AI platform that runs the world's real assets. We earn only on the additional value we create. Built on 15+ years of R&D, 76 granted patents and US$100M+ invested, the platform is live across 10,000+ building datasets in 253 cities with Fortune Global 500 owners, sovereign funds and hospitality groups.

**Strategic Context** Every building we make intelligent starts with accurate information about how it is built. High-detail BIM models, and MEP models in particular, are the foundation for digital twins, predictive maintenance and autonomous building operations. Janus Digital is now building its own AI BIM platform to create, check and enrich these models far faster than traditional workflows allow.

This role sits at the centre of that effort. You will deliver production-grade MEP and commercial BIM models using AI tooling to speed up every step, while giving the Chief Platform/Product Officer a practitioner's view of the AI-for-AEC market and the requirements our own platform must meet.

**Position Overview** We seek an experienced BIM Modeller specialising in MEP and commercial buildings, reporting directly to the Chief Platform/Product Officer. This hands-on role combines high-detail model delivery with structured market research into AI tooling and platforms, directly guiding the build of the Janus AI BIM platform.

Your time will split roughly 60% production BIM and 40% platform intelligence. You will model to LOD 350-400 under ISO 19650, measure the time AI and automation save against manual baselines, evaluate emerging AI tools on real project data, and translate real modelling workflows into product requirements, datasets and acceptance criteria.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Produce federated MEP models (HVAC, plumbing and drainage, fire protection, electrical, ELV and low-current systems) for offices, retail, hospitality, mixed-use and data-centre projects
* Model to LOD 350-400, including fabrication-ready ductwork, pipework, containment, hangers and supports where required
* Build and maintain parametric Revit families, shared parameters and project templates aligned to Janus Digital standards
* Run clash detection in Navisworks and BIM Collaborate Pro across architectural, structural and MEP models
* Apply AI and automation across the modelling workflow: auto-routing, family generation, drawing and sheet automation, model checking and scan-to-BIM
* Write and maintain Dynamo and pyRevit/Python scripts, using AI coding assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to build them faster
* Map the AI-for-AEC landscape and run structured, hands-on evaluations of shortlisted tools on real Janus Digital project data
* Work closely with the Chief Platform/Product Officer to shape platform priorities from a practitioner's perspective

title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO) | Hydrogen
description:
*Lead the technological core of Kerionics: the development and industrialization of the SOEC technology you'll bring to market in 2028.*

### **About us**

At Kerionics, we accelerate industrial decarbonization through technologies that make cleaner, more efficient energy possible. We are a spin-off from ITQ (UPV-CSIC), born from scientific knowledge with a clear goal: turning research into real industrial solutions.

Our SOEC (solid oxide electrolysis) technology produces hydrogen with high energy efficiency where it is needed most: energy-intensive industries such as steel, petrochemicals, cement, ceramics and paper, where replacing fossil fuels remains a major challenge. We are a multicultural team of more than 40 people, united by a shared purpose.

### **What we are looking for**

We need a CTO to lead the development and industrialization of our SOEC technology, with our 2028 go-to-market in sight. Over the coming years we will scale the technology by orders of magnitude. You would join at a critical point: not at the beginning, where everything is exploration, nor at the end, where everything is execution, but where scientific rigor and industrial discipline must coexist every day.

We want someone who combines the scientific rigor to solve the open challenges in MEA (Membrane Electrode Assembly), Stack and Balance of Plant (BoP) with the discipline of New Product Introduction (NPI) to take the technology from the lab to an industrial product.

You will lead three managers, one each for MEA, Stack and BoP: people with judgment, autonomy and deep knowledge of their fields. Your challenge is not to build a team from scratch, but to take it to the next level: aligning everyone around the roadmap, professionalizing how we develop product and building a technical culture together.

This is not a role for silent execution. You will be **the CEO's technical right hand**: following the defined strategy and, when needed, challenging it with arguments if you believe something has been decided wrongly. You report to the CEO, but we expect you to co-build, not just execute. That technical honesty is part of the job.

### **Why this role matters**

* **Technical leadership of a European deeptech scale-up**, with technical, commercial and environmental impact at the same time.
* **A project with real backing**: financial support from deeptech-specialized funds such as InnoEnergy, top-tier industrial and scientific partners, participation in strategic European projects, and new conversations with private investors for the next phase.
* **A real voice in strategy**: you sit on the management committee, take part in strategic and investment decisions, and your technical opinion carries weight.
* **The full transition to market**: from prototype to product, from lab to industrial plant, from first customer to deployment.

### **What you will do**

* **Product development:** lead the cross-functional development of our SOEC technology across MEA, Stack and BoP; make sure it follows an NPI logic with clear stage gates, technical pass/fail criteria and traceability of decisions; lead the transition from R&D to industrialization.
* **Team and culture:** lead the MEA, Stack and BoP managers directly, unblock what they need, build a technical culture grounded in data, honesty and accountability, and take an active role in technical hiring.
* **Critical technical problems:** provide top-level judgment on open challenges and lead decisions that cut across areas, even with incomplete data.
* **Strategy:** be the technical reference in the management committee, give the CEO honest judgment, and represent Kerionics before partners, investors and customers.
* **Industrialization and quality:** coordinate with the Industrial Project Manager on the future plant, and with the Quality & Testing Manager to align validation criteria with the product.

### **What we expect in your first 12 months**

1. **Own the technical roadmap:** understand the current state of the product and the commitments made to partners and investors. By the end of your first quarter, present your own critical assessment of the roadmap to the CEO and the board.  
2. **Build the trust of the MEA, Stack and BoP managers and their teams**, and the cross-functional rituals and processes that do not yet exist.  
3. **Strengthen the development process:** consolidate the existing stage-gate system, refining pass/fail criteria, decision traceability and documentation.  
4. **Bring AI into how the team works**, where it adds real value, leading by example. No top-down rollout.  
5. **Deliver the next major validation milestones** of the roadmap.  
6. **Build Kerionics' technical voice externally** and position it as a SOEC reference in Europe.

### **How we work**

We work **on-site** at Parque Tecnológico de Paterna (Valencia), close to the product: lab, workshop, prototypes and test benches. We usually start early (around 7:30), which leaves your afternoons free for sports, family or whatever you prefer.

### **What we ask for**

**Must-haves**

* Advanced degree in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Materials, Energy), Materials Science or Chemistry. A PhD will be highly valued.
* At least **5 years** in electrochemical or hydrogen technologies (electrolysis, fuel cells or equivalent). Direct SOEC experience is not required: we value deep knowledge of stacks, MEAs or systems that you can bring to ours.
* At least **3 years** leading product development from R&D toward industrialization.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams.
* Solid knowledge of at least one pillar: MEA and electrochemical materials, stack design and validation, or BoP in complex energy systems. We do not expect equal depth in all three, but you must hold demanding technical conversations across them.
* Fluent English, spoken and written, for technical discussions and for representing the company.
* Availability to relocate to Valencia within 2-3 months. If you need more time for family reasons, let's talk.
* Valid work permit for Spain, or eligibility to obtain one. For the right candidate, we support the paperwork.

**We are looking for someone who...**

* Has the judgment to say no to a good project that doesn't fit the strategy, and yes to a hard one when the evidence supports it.
* Decides under uncertainty without falling into paralysis or improvisation.
* Challenges the CEO with arguments when needed, while staying loyal to the agreed strategy.
* Leads through context and example, not micromanagement, and stays hands-on when needed.
* Stays current with AI and uses it critically.
* Can join an already formed team and earn its trust through knowledge and respect, not hierarchy.

**Not required, but you'll surprise us if you also...**

* Have direct experience with SOEC or SOFC, or high-temperature ceramic materials.
* Have been a CTO, VP of R&D or Head of Technology in a deeptech scale-up.
* Have lived a complete industrial scale-up (TRL 5-6 to TRL 8-9) in electrochemical, energy or advanced materials technologies.
* Know our target sectors (steel, cement, petrochemicals, ceramics, glass, paper).
* Speak Spanish.
* Have your own network in the European hydrogen, SOEC/SOFC or industrial decarbonization ecosystem.

**A note before you decide...**

This list describes an ideal profile, not a checklist. People from groups underrepresented in deeptech and engineering tend to be harder on themselves when reading job descriptions. Don't decide for us: send us your CV, and let us decide whether there's a fit.

### **What we offer**

* **€70-90K gross per year**, depending on experience and fit.
* **Variable bonus of up to €20K**, linked to the technical milestones of our roadmap. Details shared during the process.
* **Stock option plan.** Full terms shared during the process.
* **Permanent contract**, with a standard 6-month probationary period.
* Relocation support package for candidates moving to Valencia.
* 22 working days of holiday.
* Language lessons (Spanish or English) if you want to strengthen your language skills.
* Annual training budget tailored to your needs.
* A multicultural team: colleagues from India, the UK, France, Pakistan, Mexico, Uruguay, Colombia, Ecuador...
* Every Friday, 11:00 to 12:00, a good Valencian esmorzaret to disconnect and celebrate the week's small wins.

### **How our selection process works**

1. A video call with our Head of People & Culture.  
2. A video call with our CEO, to explore your technical vision and how it fits with Kerionics' strategy.  
3. A video call with an external expert.  
4. A video call with a member of our Board, focused on long-term vision and an independent view of strategic fit.  
5. A full-day visit to our facilities in Paterna (Valencia), where you will see the product and meet the MEA, Stack and BoP managers, your future direct reports. We cover your travel and accommodation.

We will update you within 5 working days after each step and treat your candidacy with full confidentiality.

title: Global Retail Health & Safety Manager
description:
Brand

Puig

City

Barcelona

Work area

Facility Management

Job type

Permanent

**Who we are**
--------------

Puig is a home of Love Brands within a family company that furthers wellness, confidence and self-expression while leaving a better world. For more than a century, our entrepreneurial spirit and passion for creativity have made us a challenger in the premium beauty industry.

With 17 Love Brands across Fragrance and Fashion, Makeup and Skincare, we create stories that connect with people’s emotions and are powered by a global team of over 13,000 passionate professionals. With products sold in more than 150 countries and €5,042 million in net revenue in 2025, and guided by strong values and sustainability commitments, Puig continues to grow as a Home of Creativity: an open-minded space where Creators Of All Kinds are empowered to thrive, innovate and express who they are.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Puig is looking for a Global Retail Health & Safety Manager to define, deploy and continuously improve the Health & Safety strategy across the Group's worldwide retail network, with particular focus on directly operated stores and guidance for concessions, joint ventures and partner-operated retail environments.

Based in Barcelona and reporting directly to the OHSE & Integrated Management Systems Director, you will provide global leadership, governance and technical expertise, working closely with Retail Operations, Local Markets, Human Resources and other key stakeholders.

**What you'll get to do**
-------------------------

* Review and deliver the global Retail Health & Safety strategy, roadmap, governance model and annual objectives in alignment with the Group OHSE and business priorities
* Develop, maintain and deploy global retail Health & Safety processes, standards, procedures, toolkits and minimum requirements, ensuring they are practical, scalable and adaptable to local legislation
* Establish and maintain a global risk profile and risk register for retail locations, using a risk-based approach to prioritise resources, controls and improvement plans
* Partner with Global Retail and Facilities teams to integrate Health & Safety requirements into new store design, fit-outs, refurbishments, pre-opening reviews, property due diligence and management of change
* Carry out Health & Safety risk assessments in flagship stores and other key or higher-risk retail locations, documenting findings, defining proportionate controls and supporting their implementation
* Plan and perform Health & Safety inspections and audits in stores, concessions and other retail environments, both independently and together with local teams
* Prepare clear inspection and audit reports, agree corrective actions with local owners, monitor deadlines and verify that actions have been effectively closed
* Deliver Health & Safety training, workshops and awareness sessions for store managers, retail employees and relevant contractors, in person and virtually
* Review, update and quality-check Retail Health & Safety training content, guidance materials, induction resources and operational communications before deployment
* Provide day-to-day technical advice and practical support to Retail Operations and country teams, helping resolve Health & Safety issues arising in stores
* Support and, when required, lead investigations of incidents and near misses, identify root causes, agree corrective and preventive actions and share lessons learned across markets
* Monitor Retail Health & Safety performance, maintain accurate data in corporate systems and prepare practical reports on incidents, findings, overdue actions, recurring risks and deployment progress

**We'd love to meet you if you have**
-------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree or equivalent qualification in Occupational Health and Safety, Engineering, Facilities Management or a related discipline
* Professional Health & Safety qualifications, such as NEBOSH, IOSH or an equivalent international credential, are strongly preferred
* At least 5 years of Health & Safety experience, including substantial responsibility in a global or multi-country retail, luxury, consumer goods, hospitality or similarly customer-facing environment. Experience managing a geographically dispersed network of stores is essential
* Strong knowledge of occupational Health & Safety management systems, ISO 45001, risk assessment, legal compliance, audits and inspections, incident investigation, contractor management, emergency preparedness and continuous improvement
* Technical credibility with strong stakeholder management, persuasion and coaching skills. You can influence without direct authority, build effective relationships across cultures and functions, and create shared accountability for Health & Safety performance;
* English and Spanish are a must; French or other languages would be an advantage
* Availability to travel internationally
  

We welcome Creators Of All Kinds. If you are unsure of meeting all the requirements but trust you have the transferable skills to excel in this role, complete the application and our teams will get in touch if you are selected for an interview.

**What you'll love about us**
-----------------------------

* An entrepreneurial, creative and welcoming work culture
* A range of learning and development opportunities
* An international company with plenty of opportunities to grow
* A competitive compensation & benefits package

Puig is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, ethnicity, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

At Puig, we are continually looking for enthusiastic and committed individuals from a broad range of backgrounds and experiences to join our team. We believe that creating an inclusive environment in which you feel welcomed, valued, engaged, and empowered strengthens our business and fosters a culture where we are inspired to work hard, challenge ourselves, and be innovative in our thinking. Additionally, we believe that the diversity of our employees makes us a stronger company and better able to serve our customers around the world.

title: General Ledger Accountant
description:
**Company Description**

SLS Barcelona, a five-star urban resort of extraordinary experiences, brings a new variety of seaside glamour, indulgence and excellence to Barcelona’s waterfront district of Port Forum. Here the hallmarks of an SLS wonderland – playful ambiance, VIP treatment, and theatrical experiences - meet idyllic views to set a lavish stage for the extraordinary to unfold. * Excellent discounts across the entire Ennismore family of brands.

title: Key Account Manager (Dairy and Beverages)
description:

We are Givaudan. Human by nature.

**Key Account Manager - Beverage/ Dairy**

As **Key Account Manager**, you will be at the heart of our commercial growth in Iberia. You will work closely with leading food and beverage companies, helping them turn consumer insights and market opportunities into innovative products that find their way into **supermarkets, restaurants and foodservice channels**.

This is more than an account management role. You will have the opportunity to **c-create customer strategies, identify new business opportunities and bring together commercial insight, creativity and flavour expertise** to create solutions that make a real difference for our customers and consumers.

You will join an international and collaborative environment where we encourage curiosity, challenge conventional thinking and give people the space to grow. We value different perspectives and believe that diverse teams create better ideas and stronger results.

You will be based in Sant Celoni and report directly to the **Commercial Director Iberia.**

**Your impact**

In this role, you will:

* **Own and grow key customer relationships** by developing a deep understanding of their business, challenges and ambitions, and turning these insights into profitable growth opportunities.
* **Drive commercial success** across both existing and new accounts, taking responsibility for sustainable top and bottom-line growth.
* **Become a trusted business partner to your customers.** Using a consultative selling approach, you will look beyond the immediate request to uncover opportunities and create additional value.
* **Build new business.** You enjoy opening doors, identifying promising leads and turning opportunities into long-term customer partnerships.
* **Shape customer and account strategies** based on your knowledge of the Iberian food and beverage market, consumer trends and customer priorities.
* **Bring the best of our organization to the customer.** You will work closely with our Flavor Creation, Application, Marketing and other expert teams to develop compelling solutions and deliver successful customer projects.
* **Turn ideas into action.** You combine strategic thinking with a practical, entrepreneurial mindset and have the energy to move opportunities forward.
* **Continue to grow yourself.** You will work in an environment where commercial insight, creativity, science and technology come together, creating plenty of opportunities to learn and develop.

**What you bring**

You are an experienced commercial professional who combines **strong customer orientation with a genuine drive to grow the business**. You are curious about what makes customers and consumers tick and know how to translate that understanding into commercial opportunities.

Ideally, you bring:

* A **proven track record of commercial success in the B2B beverage and dairy industry**.
* Around **7+ years of commercial experience**, ideally within flavours, food ingredients or another innovation-driven part of the food industry.
* A **strong understanding of the Iberia food and beverage market** and the ability to turn market and customer insights into business opportunities.
* A **growth and acquisition mindset**. You are energized by identifying new opportunities, building relationships and converting prospects into sustainable business.
* Strong **commercial judgement and negotiation skills**, with the confidence to manage complex customer relationships.
* The ability to operate both **strategically and hands-on**, moving comfortably from developing an account strategy to driving the next concrete action.
* Excellent **communication and relationship-building skills**. You connect easily with different stakeholders, influence effectively and know how to build trust, both internally and externally.
* A **collaborative mindset** and the ability to bring together technical, creative and commercial experts around a common customer opportunity.

**What will make you successful?**

You are someone who doesn't simply manage accounts. **You create opportunities.** You are commercially ambitious, genuinely curious about your customers and enjoy connecting the dots between **consumer needs, customer challenges and what our innovation teams can make possible**.

If you enjoy building relationships, winning new business and seeing an idea develop into a product that eventually reaches consumers, **we would love to meet you.**

**What we offer:**

* **Annual Bonus:** We recognize and reward your hard work and contributions with an annual bonus.
* **Home Office 1/week:** Work-life balance is important; you can work from home up to one day a week.
* This is a full-time position - 5 days per week (Monday-Friday)
* **Lease Car**
* **Health Insurance Contribution:** Your health matters to us; we provide a substantial contribution to your health insurance.
* **Pension support and yearly bonus payment**
* **Vibrant Collaborative Culture:** We celebrate diversity and teamwork, creating a dynamic space where every idea matters.

At Givaudan, you contribute to delightful taste and scent experiences that touch people’s lives.

We value the different perspectives that come from diverse cultures, backgrounds, and experiences.

Everyone — regardless of race, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, culture, religion, or any personal circumstances — is warmly welcomed at Givaudan, a place where we all love to be and grow.

Every essence of you enriches our world. Join us in making a difference together.
