title: PICs@ICFO Strategic Initiative: Postdoctoral Researcher in TGV Metallization and Seed-Layer Processes
description:
As part of the **PICs@ICFO Strategic Initiative**, ICFO coordinates PIXEurope, a flagship **Pilot Line funded under the European Chips JU program**, focused on Advanced Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs) through which ICFO is advancing frontier technologies, including optical interposers for Co-packaged optics for next-generation optoelectronic and photonic devices.

To strengthen this initiative, ICFO is seeking a highly motivated Engineer/Scientist with strong expertise in thin-film deposition and metallization of high-aspect-ratio Through-Glass Vias (TGVs).

**Position Overview:**,

We offer a post-doctoral position to a scientist with hands-on experience in thin-film deposition, surface preparation, and metallization for semiconductor, MEMS, or advanced-packaging applications. The successful candidate will develop, optimize, and scale reliable adhesion, barrier, and conductive seed layers inside high-aspect-ratio glass vias, ensuring continuity and compatibility with subsequent copper plating and interconnection processes.

**Key Responsibilities:**,

The selected candidate will be expected to:

* Develop and optimize seed-layer deposition processes for high-aspect-ratio Through-Glass Vias
* Develop substrate cleaning, glass-surface activation, and adhesion-promotion processes
* Develop adhesion, barrier, and conductive seed stacks such as Ti/Cu, Cr/Cu, TiW/Cu, and related systems
* Optimize sputtering, evaporation, electroless, ALD or CVD-assisted, and hybrid deposition approaches
* Achieve continuous and conformal seed coverage along via entrances, sidewalls, and exits
* Characterize thickness, morphology, resistivity, adhesion, continuity, and wafer-level uniformity
* Identify and mitigate shadowing, seed discontinuity, oxidation, delamination, and cracking
Coordinate with the laser and glass team to align via geometry and surface condition with seeding, plating, and interconnection requirements  

  
This position will report to the **Prof. Dr. Valerio Pruneri, Director of the European Chips JU Pilot Line PIXEurope.**

PIXEurope is co-funded by the Chips Joint Undertaking and national funding authorities of the Participating States, Spain, Ireland, The Netherlands, Finland, Belgium, Portugal, Poland, Austria, France, Italy, United Kingdom. In particular, it is co-funded by Spain through the Ministry for Digital Transformation and Civil Service under reference CJU-010000-2025-0005, as part of the Recovery, Transformation and Resilience Plan (PRTR).

Applicants must hold a PhD in materials science, chemistry, chemical engineering, electrical engineering, microelectronics, physics, microengineering, or related fields, or equivalent research experience.

Candidates should demonstrate expertise in the following areas (not all mandatory, but strongly preferred):

* Thin-film deposition by sputtering, evaporation, ALD, CVD, or electroless methods
* Metallization processes for semiconductor, MEMS, microfabrication, or advanced-packaging applications
* Surface preparation, activation, and surface chemistry of glass or dielectric materials
* Metal-to-dielectric adhesion and adhesion/barrier/seed-layer material systems
* Metallization or coating of high-aspect-ratio three-dimensional structures
* Redistribution layer patterning and fabrication
* Electrical and structural characterization of thin films and interconnects
* Cleanroom processes, safety procedures, and fabrication protocols
Process optimization, reproducibility, failure analysis, and wafer-level uniformity  

Desired (but not required):

* Direct experience with Through-Glass Via or Through-Silicon Via metallization
* Experience with FIB/SEM cross-sections, X-ray inspection, four-point-probe measurements, or via-resistance testing
* Experience with reliability testing, thermomechanical stress, process scale-up, or wafer-level packaging
* Experience with glass surface processing will be evaluated as a strong asset
Experience with electroless deposition, ALD-assisted seeding, or electroplating  

**What We Offer**

* Full time contract up to 3 years (ASE (Accés al Sistema Espanyol de Ciència i Innovació) contract pursuant to Spanish Law 14/2011)
* Access to state-of-the-art microfabrication and characterization facilities
* A dynamic and interdisciplinary research environment
* Opportunities to work on high-impact projects bridging fundamental research and real-world applications
A family allowance may be granted to candidates with dependents, according to ICFO policies.  

**Equal Opportunity**

ICFO is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based solely on merit and potential, regardless of gender, nationality, or disability. ICFO fully endorses the European Charter for Researchers and Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers, ensuring a transparent and supportive recruitment process.

To apply, please submit your:

* resume,
* a cover letter outlining your experience,
contact information for 2 professional references.  

  
Applications should be submitted via the ICFOjobs platform http://jobs.icfo.eu.

The selection process is conducted in accordance with ICFO’s Open, Transparent and Merit-based Recruitment (OTM-R) Policy, ensuring equal opportunities, transparency, and fair treatment for all applicants. Candidates are assessed exclusively on the basis of their qualifications, experience, skills, achievements, and potential in relation to the requirements of the position. Further information on the recruitment principles and procedures, conflict of interest and the appeals mechanism available to candidates, can be found in the OTM-R Policy.

The selection process will consist of:

1. Eligibility check of applications
  
2. Assessment of merits (education, experience, and language)
  
3. Interview with shortlisted candidates  
  

The Evaluation Committee will include at least three members and ensure gender balance and impartiality.
  
Each phase will be documented, and candidates will be notified of the outcome within 15 days of the interview.

For formal enquiries regarding the application process, please contact: jobs@icfo.eu

For project and technology enquiries, please contact: valerio.pruneri@icfo.eu.

For more information about ICFO, visit: https://www.icfo.eu.

**Data Protection**

In accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Organic Law 3/2018, ICFO informs applicants that their personal data will be processed exclusively for recruitment purposes.

title: Senior Principal, Talent Marketing
description:
**About us**
------------

Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times as Africa's fastest-growing fintech, Moniepoint is trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of dollars in transactions monthly. Having built resilient, high-volume financial infrastructure that powers commerce across emerging markets, Moniepoint is embarking on its next phase of global scale.

**About this role**
-------------------

As our Senior Principal, Talent Marketing, you will be the strategic architect responsible for establishing Moniepoint's talent brand and candidate pipeline in new markets from scratch. Where Moniepoint is not yet an established consumer brand, you will solve complex talent acquisition problems by understanding how senior engineers, engineering managers, and technical leaders think, connect, and evaluate career moves across Europe. Working from a blank piece of paper with high autonomy, you will translate our global Employer Value Proposition (EVP) into localized, high-converting talent marketing strategies. You will bridge the gap between Talent Acquisition, Engineering Leadership, and Brand - combining developer community immersion, high-touch physical events, and targeted campaigns that turn brand discovery into qualified, closed engineering hires.

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **1. Zero-to-One Market Entry & Tech Hub Architecture**

* **Define European Hub Talent Strategy:** Architect and lead the talent go-to-market strategy for Moniepoint's newest engineering hubs (principally Poland and Spain), crafting localized narratives that appeal to discerning software engineers.
* **Anchor the 'Founding Team' Narrative:** Position early European engineering cohorts as foundational builders, creating compelling narratives around technical scale, system complexity, and ownership that resonate with elite technical talent.
* **Navigate Market Nuances:** Diagnose and navigate country-specific developer dynamics—recognizing that developer communities in Poland, Spain, and the UK behave differently and require tailored engagement models rather than copy-pasted playbooks.

### **2. Developer Community, Ecosystem & Event Activation**

* **High-Impact Physical & Virtual Presence:** Conceive, curate, and lead our physical presence at key developer conferences, engineering meetups, hackathons, and university partnerships across target markets.
* **End-to-End Pipeline Activation:** Ensure events are never vanity exercises; architect end-to-end follow-up systems and talent nurture funnels that convert event attendees into active, screened pipelines for our TA partners.
* **Developer Platform Immersion:** Leverage deep knowledge of where engineers consume information (e.g., GitLab/GitHub communities, tech forums, Discord/Slack groups, Meetup, Eventbrite) to drive authentic engagement.

### **3. Strategic Hiring Campaigns & Technical Enablement**

* **Targeted Campaign Architecture:** Partner with TA leads and Engineering Directors to identify acute hiring bottlenecks and build agile, multi-channel marketing campaigns that address specialized, hard-to-fill tech disciplines.
* **Technical EVP Translation:** Translate technical architecture, distributed systems challenges, and fintech infrastructure realities into authentic, intellectually rigorous technical messaging that outshines local competitors.
* **Recruiter Enablement & Narrative Toolkits:** Equip our technical sourcing and recruitment teams with high-leverage narrative assets—outbound pitch decks, technical one-pagers, culture collateral, and messaging sequences that double recruiter outreach conversion.

### **4. Performance, Analytics & Optimization**

* **Hiring-Centric Metrics:** Discard vanity metrics. Evaluate every initiative against pipeline contribution, qualified applicant rates, candidate quality score, cost-per-hire, and time-to-fill.
* **Budget Oversight:** Own and allocate dedicated talent marketing budgets with extreme commercial discipline—scaling programs that drive measurable hires and rapidly decommissioning initiatives that underdeliver.
* **Paid Acquisition (Tactical Lever):** Oversee and strategically deploy paid recruitment marketing spend across relevant technical platforms and channels when targeted outbound and community channels require acceleration.

### **5. Strategic Leadership & Scalability**

* **Strategic Thought Partnership:** Serve as the trusted advisor to the Head of Talent Acquisition, VP of Engineering, and Brand Leadership on talent market intelligence, competitor positioning, and developer sentiment.
* **Playbook Documentation:** Establish and document Moniepoint's global talent expansion playbook, creating scalable frameworks that will be deployed across future international markets.
* **Mentorship & Functional Growth:** Provide strategic guidance to broader TA and brand team members, with the opportunity to mentor or direct junior talent marketing specialists as the function scales.

**Experience & Background**
---------------------------

* **8+ Years of Talent Marketing Leadership:** Experience leading talent marketing, technical recruitment marketing, or developer relations/advocacy, with substantial time dedicated to hiring software engineering and product disciplines.
* **European Market Expertise:** Demonstrated experience building talent brand presence and hiring pipelines across European tech ecosystems (particularly Central/Eastern Europe such as Poland, and Western/Southern Europe such as the UK or Spain).
* **Zero-to-One Market Entry Track Record:** Proven success entering new geographies or scaling talent brand where the employer brand was nascent or non-existent, creating playbooks from a blank sheet of paper.
* **Fintech & Scale Exposure:** Experience in hyper-growth fintech, high-frequency/payments infrastructure, or high-scale distributed systems environments.
* **International Collaboration:** Experience collaborating with international founding teams or distributed tech hubs across emerging and mature markets.

**Skills & Competencies**
-------------------------

* **Mastery in Event-Driven Pipeline Activation:** Extensive hands-on experience designing and executing physical and digital developer events and architecting the subsequent candidate nurturing journey that yields hires.
* **Deep Engineering Domain Fluency:** Genuine understanding of software engineering culture, tech stacks (distributed systems, backend, infra, DevOps), and developer channels (Meetup, Eventbrite, GitLab/GitHub, Reddit, tech conferences).
* **Comfort with Substantial Ambiguity:** High agency and entrepreneurial drive; ability to make decisive bets, test hypotheses, and build structure in fast-moving, high-growth environments.
* **Strategic Campaign Design:** Ability to connect high-level EVP strategy to pragmatic, sprint-based talent acquisition sprints that deliver on an aggressive hiring plan (500+ tech hires).
* **Paid Digital Campaign Optimization:** Direct experience running and optimizing paid digital recruitment advertising campaigns independently across social and developer networks.

**What success looks like in this role**
----------------------------------------

* **First 30 Days (Discovery & Immersion):** Map the competitive landscape and developer talent dynamics in Poland and Spain. Establish alignment with technical hiring leads (PEP, Engineering Directors) and TA leads to define immediate priority pipelines. Audit existing employer brand collateral and identify localized messaging gaps for European tech hiring.
* **First 90 Days (Initial Market Entry & Quick Wins):** Launch the first pilot physical event / developer meetup presence in Poland with a complete post-event pipeline conversion funnel. Roll out the European Recruiter Enablement Toolkit (localized pitch decks, outreach sequences, and technical one-pagers). Launch targeted marketing sprints for top 3 hardest-to-fill senior technical roles.
* **First 6 Months (Hub Establishment & Pipeline Ramp):** Position Moniepoint as a recognized, compelling engineering hub in Poland, supporting the identity and pride of the founding engineer cohort. Consistently contribute qualified, pre-warmed candidate pipelines directly supporting the ramp toward 500 tech/product hires. Prove multi-channel attribution showing which community and marketing initiatives are yielding quality hires.
* **Year One (Global Expansion Playbook):** Complete Moniepoint's International Talent Expansion Playbook, ready to be deployed across future tech hubs. Measurably decrease time-to-fill and increase direct outbound response rates across all European technical roles. Solidify Moniepoint's reputation as an employer of choice for Europe's most ambitious engineers.

**Why join us**
---------------

* **High-Impact Mission:** Play a career-defining role in building the engineering backbone of Africa's fastest-growing fintech as it scales globally.
* **True Ownership & Dedicated Resources:** Autonomy to build from scratch with dedicated budget backing and direct executive sponsorship.
* **Front-Row Seat to Tech Hub Creation:** Help build engineering hubs from their inception, shaping culture, talent standards, and brand identity.
* **Competitive Executive Package:** Competitive base salary (calibrated for Senior Principal level), performance bonuses, comprehensive private healthcare, and pension schemes.

#### Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

title: Head of CRO
description:
KittySpout / DoggySpout is looking for a hands-on **CRO Lead** to join our team! You will own every conversion test across our site, landing pages, paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells. This is an all-in-one role: you set the strategy and you do the work – building the backlog, briefing and QA-ing tests, launching them and shipping the winners.

We spend **$2,000,000+ per month on Meta**, so your tests reach significance fast. We are looking to hire someone with **3–4+ years** running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands. The ideal candidate has deep hands-on Intelligems experience, has built and tested paid-acquisition funnels, and can show the data behind tests that lifted conversion rate, AOV or revenue per visitor.

### **The mission of this role**

Own every conversion test on both of our brands (site, landing pages, funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells) so each visitor is worth more every month. Success is a steady, well-run test program that lifts conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor across every page, funnel and offer.

### **Who are we?**

KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.

### **What is our culture like & who is a good fit?**

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:

* **Better Everyday** – keep a live test on each brand, write down the learning from every result, and improve the test plan, QA checklist and agency process after every round.
* **Speed Is King** – move from idea to live test in days, call finished tests on time, ship winners the week they win, and flag a conversion drop the same day.
* **Work Smart** – AI and automation first. Use Claude to turn Clarity recordings, reviews and surveys into test ideas and draft test briefs; automate reporting and drop alerts.
* **Overdeliver** – catch a conversion problem before anyone asks, bring the cause and the fix, and reuse winning patterns across both brands without being told.

**If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it.**

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place.

### **Outcomes (what success looks like)**

90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.

* Conversion rate and revenue per visitor rise on both brands – measured weekly by brand (Intelligems, Shopify)
* Paid-acquisition landing pages and funnels that convert – CVR and RPV per funnel (Intelligems, Northbeam)
* Continuous improvement across the website – tests live every week; winners shipped
* AOV and post-purchase upsell take rate rise – AOV (Shopify), upsell take rate (AfterSell)
* No conversion drop goes unnoticed – drops caught and raised the same day

### **Key Objectives**

* Own the CRO test plan and backlog for both brands, ranked by expected impact, so the biggest wins run first.
* Build, test and launch paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells.
* Brief, QA and launch tests every week – then call results honestly and ship the winners.
* Drive measurable lifts in conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor.
* Catch conversion drops the same day and bring the cause and the fix.
* Manage our CRO agency and decide with the Head of Growth when work moves in-house.
* Report CRO KPIs weekly and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting.

  
**Requirements**  

* Fully remote, full-time
* Fluent in English
* CRO Experience: 3–4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands is a must.
* Proof of Results: A record of tests and funnels that lifted CVR, AOV or RPV – with the data to back it up.
* Funnels: Experience building and testing paid-acquisition funnels and landing pages.
* Tools: Deep hands-on Intelligems experience, plus AfterSell (or similar), Microsoft Clarity and Shopify analytics. You can set up and QA a test without help.
* Briefing & Agencies: Experience briefing developers and designers, and managing a CRO agency.
* Experiment Design: You write clear hypotheses, size tests properly and call results on an agreed significance rule.
* Offer Sense: You know how bundles, discounts, subscriptions and upsells change conversion, AOV and margin.
* No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work.
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
* Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder.
* Bonus points: subscription or pet brand experience.

### **Accountabilities**

What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.

* CRO test plan and backlog – Keep one ranked test plan per brand, scored on impact, confidence and effort, so the highest-impact tests are always briefed and run next.
* Funnels – Run split tests on every paid-acquisition funnel each week, and build new funnels and landing pages that match our ad angles to lift conversion rate and RPV.
* Build, QA and launch tests – Brief our web developer and designer, QA every variant (tracking, prices, discount codes, mobile and desktop) and launch tests on time, every week.
* Results, winners and conversion monitoring – Call finished tests honestly, ship the winners, and catch any conversion drop the same day.
* CRO agency – Manage our CRO agency's test list, targets and results, and decide with the Head of Growth when the work moves in-house.
* CRO reporting and meetings – Report conversion rate, RPV, AOV, tests live and win rate weekly, and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting.

### **How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate**

(1) Application + Screening

(2) Test Project

(3) Technical Interview

(4) Culture Fit Interview

### **Salary Expectation**

**USD $4,000 – $6,000+** per month (based on experience and expertise).

title: Head of Global Events and Travel (100% REMOTE)
description:
The Head of Global Events & Travel leads the strategy, governance, and execution of our global events and corporate travel function. This role oversees three interconnected areas:

* **Flagship, VIP, High-Complexity & Client/client’s customers-Facing Events** (client and client’s customers events, executive dinners, and high-touch VIP gatherings);
* **Internal Meetings & Corporate Travel** (global gatherings, executive offsites, collaborators travel program); and
* **Dedicated Financial Control & Commercial Management**.

The Head is accountable for the full events and corporate travel portfolio, consolidated budgets, strategic supplier agreements, service standards, and duty-of-care governance. Serving both internal teams and external stakeholders (clients, prospects, and partners), the Head sets priorities, builds team capability, and manages major commercial decisions and C-level/client escalations. Financial oversight is supported by the Event & Travel Finance Lead in alignment with central Corporate FP&A.

A key initial priority is leading the implementation and transition to our enhanced travel operating model. Once established, the Head provides oversight through periodic performance reviews and exception management, delegating routine operations to the team and Travel Management Companies (TMCs).

**Responsibilities**

* **Function Leadership:** Lead and develop the Team. Recruit open roles, establish team cadence, and build capabilities across the function. Strategic resource planning across agencies, production vendors, and internal talent to execute both internal and client-facing events seamlessly.
* **Flagship, VIP & Client/client’s customers-Facing Events:** Execute on objectives, budgets, and brand standards set by C-Level leadership for 5,000-attendee conference, VIP executive receptions, and regional customer summits. Manage delivery through the internal Team, supported by event specialists and external agencies. Lead venue selection, production, security, contract negotiations, and attendee experience for both internal and external audiences.
* **Internal Meetings & Offsites:** Oversee the internal gathering strategy and delivery. Standardize playbooks for routine company meetings and regional leadership offsites.
* **Travel Operating Model Transition:** Lead the implementation of our approved global travel operating model, including RFPs and contracts for multi-region TMCs, unified policy and expense frameworks, approvals, reconciliation, and dual quoting. Coordinate phased migration corridor-by-corridor, validate vendor acceptance, protect service continuity, and establish an operational handover once stable.
* **Corporate Travel Oversight:** Own global travel strategy, master agreements, and major operational escalations. Oversee daily fulfillment, group flights, hotel blocks, rebooking, and high-touch support for executives, clients, and guest speakers managed by TMCs and the Travel & Logistics Coordinator.
* **Budget Accountability & Resource Stewardship:** Own the consolidated events and travel budget, as well as revenue/cost-recovery models for sponsored or client-facing events. Act as a steward of company resources, prioritizing expenditure against strategic business objectives, maximizing ROI on client events, identifying cost-saving opportunities, and escalating forecast overruns early with mitigation plans.
* **Financial Governance & Client Billing:** Work through the Team to manage annual budgets, rolling forecasts, vendor deposits, event ledgers, cross-charging/client billing, invoice reconciliation, and post-event financial reviews. Maintain strict approval thresholds, separation of duties, purchase orders, payment terms, and international VAT/GST recovery.
* **Strategic Suppliers & Commercial Partnerships:** Lead major RFPs and negotiations with TMCs, airlines, hotel chains, event venues, registration platforms, and production partners. Maintain competitive discipline, set service expectations, and delegate routine vendor management while remaining the key point of contact for material escalations.
* **Policy, Duty of Care & Risk Management:** Own the global events and travel policy. Establish traveler assistance, emergency response, data privacy, and incident escalation frameworks in coordination with People Ops, Legal, IT, and Security, ensuring comprehensive coverage for collaborators, clients, and external VIP guests.
* **Cross-Functional & Client Partnership:** Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success on client event revenue targets, sponsorships, client experience, and commercial outcomes. Collaborate with C-Level executives on internal event agendas, keynotes, and executive participation. Partner with Finance, Legal, and People Ops to streamline global delivery.
* **Events & Travel Leadership:** 8+ years leading corporate events and managed travel programs, including 3+ years leading a global function in a fast-growing, international environment.
* **Client & Internal Event Expertise:** Proven track record running both internal company meetings/offsites and high-impact, client- or customer-facing events (e.g., user conferences, client advisory boards, sponsored summits, roadshows).
* **Large-Scale Event Execution:** Proven experience directing large conferences (5,000+ attendees) end-to-end, covering budgets, venue sourcing, registration tech, production, speaker/VIP management, and vendor teams.
* **Travel Program Transformation:** Hands-on experience implementing or re-platforming corporate travel frameworks (TMC selections, booking/expense integrations, phased migrations, and duty-of-care rollouts). Multi-TMC or hybrid experience preferred.
* **Travel Industry & Commercial Fluency:** Strong understanding of airline/hotel distribution economics (GDS, NDC, dynamic pricing, corporate direct programs) and commercial contracting for high-value event venues and suppliers.
* **Financial & Commercial Acumen:** Demonstrated budget ownership, financial forecasting, ROI tracking, vendor negotiations, and client event billing/cost recovery. Experience with virtual-card systems or modern payment settlements is a plus.
* **Executive & External Presence:** Exceptional communication and presentation skills; comfortable engaging directly with C-Suite executives, enterprise clients, sponsors, and key industry partners.
* **Data Privacy & Duty of Care:** Solid understanding of global travel safety protocols, crisis management, GDPR compliance, vendor DPAs, and attendee data privacy standards.
* **Language & Mobility:** Professional fluency in English (Spanish and/or Italian are strong pluses). Willingness to travel internationally up to 40% and operate across European, Middle Eastern, and Americas time zones.

**Important information for candidates**  
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**

description:
**Who are we**

At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.

### **About the Team**

We are looking for a **Senior Account Manager to join our EMEA team**, which focuses on strengthening relationships with existing customers and driving sustainable revenue growth through retention, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling.

In this role, you will own the commercial outcomes and full commercial lifecycle of your assigned enterprise accounts. This includes protecting customer retention, supporting successful renewals, identifying expansion opportunities, and ensuring customers continue to realise value from Lokalise over time.

You will manage a portfolio of strategic customers. You will act as a trusted commercial partner, helping customers connect Lokalise's capabilities to their business objectives, localisation workflows, and international growth plans.

You will report to the Director of Sales EMEA and work closely with Customer Success, Solutions Architecture, Product, Finance, and Legal. You will be measured primarily on **account expansion through upselling, cross-selling, and broader customer adoption and gross revenue retention across your portfolio** .

  

### **What You Will Do**

* **Own account commercial outcomes:** Take responsibility for the full commercial lifecycle of your assigned enterprise accounts, including retention, renewals, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling.
* **Protect retention and renewal outcomes:** Monitor account health, customer engagement, product value, and commercial risks to identify potential retention challenges early and coordinate effective action with internal teams.
* **Drive account expansion:** Identify and execute upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities, leading commercial conversations and negotiations with a focus on achieving and surpassing sales quotas.
* **Develop account strategies:** Create and maintain clear account plans based on customer goals, stakeholder priorities, product adoption, business risks, renewal plans, and opportunities for broader collaboration.
* **Lead consultative customer conversations:** Advise customers on how to improve their localisation and content workflows, connect their needs to Lokalise's solutions, and articulate clear business value and return on investment.
* **Navigate complex enterprise sales processes:** Coordinate multi-stakeholder opportunities, procurement activity, contract negotiations, and legal discussions, ensuring progress toward successful commercial outcomes.
* **Partner cross-functionally and maintain accurate reporting:** Work closely with Customer Success and Solutions Architecture to support retention and expansion, collaborate with Product, Finance, and Legal to resolve customer needs, and maintain accurate CRM records, account plans, pipeline updates, and forecasts.
* **Use AI to elevate your work:** Proactively explore and apply AI tools and approaches to improve customer research, account planning, decision-making, productivity, and go-to-market impact.

  

### **What You Must Have**

* **Full account lifecycle ownership:** +5 years of experience owning the commercial lifecycle of strategic or enterprise customer accounts, including retention, renewals, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling in a B2B SaaS environment.
* **Proven commercial outcomes:** A track record of protecting customer revenue, achieving gross revenue retention or comparable retention targets, and generating measurable account expansion.
* Ability to understand complex SaaS products, with **experience selling to business, marketing, and sales stakeholders**, and translating product capabilities into clear commercial value.
* Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to collaborate effectively across a remote, international organisation.
* Experience engaging and influencing C-level and senior stakeholders, including the ability to lead strategic conversations and align solutions with business priorities.
* Strong commercial skills, including experience identifying growth opportunities, negotiating contracts, and navigating complex procurement or legal discussions.
Competency using AI tools to accelerate customer research, synthesis, account planning, and decision-making, with a proactive mindset toward adopting new AI-enabled ways of working.  

### **It's a Plus If You Have**

* Experience engaging technical stakeholders (e.g., IT, engineering, product) in addition to business buyers.
* Experience selling localisation, translation management, or other workflow software.
* Experience working with procurement processes such as RFPs, security reviews, or complex enterprise buying committees.
* Familiarity with structured sales methodologies or account planning frameworks.

Competitive salary and employee stock options.

Fully remote setup with flexible working hours.

Co-working budget for those days you want a change from your home office.

Flexible vacation policy to recharge when you need to.

️ Home office setup budget: monitor, desk, ergonomics, whatever helps you do your best work.

Learning & development budget to grow your skills and career.

Health insurance to keep you covered.

Wellness allowance to support your mental and physical well-being.

Great startup culture: remote but close-knit, with regular retreats and social events to stay connected.

title: Head of YouTube (Strategy, Scripting & Team Lead)
description:
We're hiring a Head of YouTube to lead Richard Yu's channels and creative team. Richard teaches people how to build businesses selling digital and physical products through "AI Arbitrage"

### **The challenge**

Our immediate goal is to grow the business channel to 200,000+ subscribers in six months and bring average views per video above 100,000. These are aggressive goals. We want someone excited by that challenge, with a clear approach to choosing what to make, testing ideas and getting good videos out consistently.

You'll grow the top of the funnel by reaching new viewers who fit our audience. You'll also plan content for viewers who are getting to know Richard, learning about our offers and deciding whether to buy. Ultimately, we want this channel to grow the business, so views and subscribers need to translate into an audience we can serve.

You'll be responsible for what we make, why we make it, how we package and produce it, and whether it worked. You'll work directly with Richard and the leadership team to set direction, goals and KPI's and lead, hire and manage a creative team underneath.

**This is a senior creative strategist and operator role**.
  
You will write first-person, long-form scripts yourself, as well as review and improve other writers' work. You should be equally comfortable setting channel direction, giving specific feedback and getting videos published.

### **What you'll own**

* **Strategy and ideation:** own the channel's growth goals, metrics and KPIs. Turn them into a clear plan for topics, formats and ideas, based on what our audience cares about and what we can learn from videos that perform well above their channel's usual results. Plan videos that bring in new viewers, build trust and help the right people take the next step.
* **Testing and learning:** build structured tests with a clear hypothesis, a useful comparison and defined success measures. Decide which tests are worth running, make sense of the results and apply what you learn to the next videos.
* **Packaging:** titles, thumbnail concepts and briefs, A/B tests, and repackaging decisions informed by CTR, retention and traffic sources.
* **Scripting:** write full scripts when needed, and edit and quality-check every script before Richard films it. Build strong hooks, story structure, pacing, curiosity and payoffs that keep people watching. Deliver the title's promise in a natural voice, with concrete examples and verified claims.
* **Production:** give editors specific feedback from the first cut, set clear standards and make sure each video meets them.
* **Analytics:** review what worked, what didn't and what to change next. Track subscriber growth, views and audience quality alongside the channel's contribution to leads and sales, working with the wider marketing team. Be clear about which results we can attribute to YouTube and where we’re still making assumptions.
* **Team:** hire, onboard and manage editors, designers and writers. Coach people to improve and write procedures and checklists that help the team make good decisions independently.

### **Who will do well here**

You have a deep passion for YouTube (storytelling and psychology), and an understanding of channel growth. You can explain why a topic, format, title, thumbnail or script works: what earns the click, what keeps someone watching and what makes them return. You can turn that understanding into work that performs.

You are excited about taking on ambitious goals and being responsible for the results. You track progress honestly, work out what's holding us back and come with ideas for fixing it. You learn quickly, ask for feedback and change your approach when the evidence calls for it.

Strong business judgment, an understanding of marketing funnels and experience in Infopreneurship, online education or Edutech are major advantages. We’ll weigh that experience heavily. We’ll also consider an exceptional YouTube leader who can learn our audience, offers and funnel quickly.

This is a full-time role for someone who wants to focus on one business and take responsibility for both the creative work and the team.

### **Hiring process**

Application, Zoom call, paid test project, final interview, offer. For your application, share existing work you are allowed to share; no new script or channel audit is required at this stage.

### **How to apply**

Review Richard’s business YouTube channel and browse the other channels/accounts linked there for context. Share a 3–5 minute Loom covering:

**1. Your background and motivation:** Briefly introduce yourself, your role on the YouTube channels you’ve worked on and the results you’re most proud of. What excites you about this opportunity, and why do you want this particular role working with Richard Yu?

**2. Your growth philosophy:** How do you approach growing a business YouTube channel like ours? Which metrics matter most, and why?

**3. Your read on our channel and your first 30 days:** What are we doing well, and what most needs to improve to reach 200k+ subscribers in six months and average over 100k views per video? Briefly explain your reasoning and what you would focus on in your first 30 days. Tell us what you can judge from the public channel and what you’d need to learn from our analytics or team. One or two meaningful observations are enough.

**4. Your leadership:** What creative teams have you led? Share one brief example of a difficult leadership decision, how you handled it and what happened.

Keep it conversational and focus on what matters most. You don’t need slides, a detailed audit or a strategy deck. We want to understand you, your judgment and how you work. Please check that your Loom link is accessible.

 **Requirements**  

* + - * + - * + Deep passion for YouTube and demonstrated understanding of storytelling and channel growth. Show us published long-form work and explain what you contributed.
              + Strong creative judgment across topics, formats, ideation, titles and thumbnails. You can explain why people click, keep watching and return.
              + Deep understanding of a winning script: hooks, narrative structure, pacing, curiosity, clear explanations and satisfying payoffs. Ability and willingness to write complete first-person, talking-head scripts and improve another writer's work.
              + A structured approach to testing: clear hypotheses, useful comparisons, defined success measures and sound interpretation of results.
              + Ownership of goals, metrics and KPIs. Strong command of CTR, average view duration, retention graphs, traffic sources and channel growth metrics, with examples of how you used them to make decisions.
              + Experience managing editors and/or designers, setting clear standards, giving specific feedback and helping people improve.
              + You learn quickly, ask good questions and take direct feedback well. You can get up to speed on a new audience, subject and business model.
              + Strong business judgment and experience with marketing funnels, infopreneurship, online education or edusoftware are highly valued. A record of connecting content to leads or sales is a strong advantage. These are not prerequisites for an exceptional YouTube candidate who can learn this side quickly.
              + Fluent spoken and written English is essential. You must be able to write natural, compelling English scripts and communicate clearly with Richard and the team.
              + Confidence using without over-reliance on AI tools, particularly Claude/Codex. You still take responsibility for the voice, accuracy and claims in the finished work.
              + Full-time availability and at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern working hours.
              + Remote: we welcome candidates across the United States, Canada, the UK, Europe, Mexico, Central America and South America, including Spain, Portugal, France, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, Brazil, Panama, Colombia, Argentina and Costa Rica. Exceptional candidates elsewhere are also welcome. What matters is strong YouTube judgment, fluent English and reliable overlap with US Eastern working hours.

  
**Benefits**  

* + **A meaningful challenge.** Help grow a brand with audacious goals, including taking our business channel to 200k+ subscribers in six months and averaging over 100k views per video. Your work will directly shape how we reach people, earn their trust and grow the business.
  + **Real ownership and influence.** We value input from everyone, and few things are off-limits to thoughtful questioning. Bring your perspective, question assumptions and propose better approaches. We listen to good reasoning and are willing to change direction when the evidence supports it. Your ideas and what you learn through testing can influence the broader business.
  + **A team invested in your growth.** We want this to be one of the biggest personal and professional growth experiences of your life. You’ll work directly with Richard and the rest of the leadership team, get honest feedback and take on challenges that stretch your thinking, creative judgment and leadership. We set high standards, and we’re here to help you reach them.
  + **$75,000–$150,000 USD annually plus performance bonuses for exceptional results, in a fully remote, full-time role with reliable overlap with US Eastern working hours.**

title: Senior UX/UI Designer
description:
Terra’s Creative team is a tight-knit, collaborative group that thrives on solving diverse creative problems for our clients. We are seeking an experienced Senior UX/UI Designer with a strong portfolio, exceptional design skills, and a passion for creating intuitive, engaging, and visually compelling digital experiences.

This role is ideal for a designer with 5+ years of professional experience who is ready to take greater ownership of complex website projects, contribute to strategic design decisions, and help elevate the quality of work across the team.

As a Senior UX/UI Designer, you will independently lead the design execution of assigned projects, from initial concepts and wireframes through high-fidelity designs and developer handoff. You'll collaborate closely with creative leadership, project managers, developers, and other designers to deliver thoughtful, user-centered solutions that balance functionality, aesthetics, and client objectives.

You will also play an important role in maintaining high design standards, contributing to client presentations, and providing guidance and constructive feedback to fellow designers, without formal team management responsibilities.

Portfolio required for consideration.

### **Who You Are**

* You have 5+ years of professional experience in a UX/UI design role, ideally at an agency or in a fast-paced, client-focused environment, with a strong portfolio showcasing intuitive, visually compelling, and user-centered digital experiences.
* You are proactive, highly organized, and capable of independently managing complex design assignments, balancing multiple priorities, and meeting deadlines.
* You have strong communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to articulate design decisions and explain your creative rationale to internal stakeholders and clients.
* You have a proficient level of English and Spanish, both written and spoken.
* You are highly proficient in Figma, with extensive experience in wireframing, prototyping, high-fidelity UI design, and scalable design systems.
* You have a strong understanding of UX/UI principles, information architecture, interaction design, and responsive design, paired with a keen eye for typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and detail.
* You have a solid understanding of web development principles, including HTML5, CSS3, front-end capabilities and limitations, and web accessibility standards (WCAG AA).
* You are a strategic and creative problem solver who can balance user needs, business objectives, and technical requirements to develop thoughtful design solutions.
* You thrive in a collaborative environment, enjoy giving and receiving constructive feedback, and are comfortable guiding fellow designers while remaining adaptable to other creative disciplines, including graphic and editorial design.

### **What You'll Do**

* Take ownership of the UX/UI design process for assigned website and digital projects, from initial discovery and concept development through final execution and developer handoff.
* Collaborate with creative leadership, project managers, strategists, designers, and developers to translate client objectives, project scopes, brand guidelines, and technical requirements into effective design solutions.
* Conduct design research and develop information architecture, user flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes to explore and validate design concepts.
* Design responsive, intuitive, and visually compelling websites and digital interfaces that balance usability, accessibility, visual storytelling, and business goals.
* Develop, maintain, and improve UI design systems, component libraries, and design patterns to ensure consistency, scalability, and efficiency across digital experiences.
* Work closely with developers throughout implementation, providing clear design specifications, supporting handoffs, and resolving UX/UI challenges to ensure design quality and feasibility.
* Participate in and help guide internal design reviews and client presentations, communicating design concepts, rationale, and recommendations.
* Guide fellow designers through specific projects or design challenges, providing constructive feedback and helping maintain high standards of design quality and consistency.
* Proactively coordinate with project leads to manage timelines, communicate progress, identify potential challenges, and ensure deliverables meet project requirements and client expectations.
* Stay current with emerging UX/UI trends, tools, and technologies, sharing inspiration, best practices, and opportunities to improve design processes and workflows.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

* 15 observed holidays + 23 PTO days per year
* Indefinite contract following a trial period of 6 months
* Permanent remote work
* Dedicated team budget for professional development
* Compensated onsite retreats at our Bilbao HQ
* Access to Wellhub – a wellness benefit with access to thousands of gyms and studios and online classes
* The opportunity to join a dynamic, close-knit team that loves going to work with and for each other every day

title: Senior eCommerce Content Strategist
description:
**About Us**  
Since 2003, Luzern eCommerce has been helping leading global brands grow their online business. We partner with brands including Panasonic, Reebok, Stokke, KIKO, Next, Twining's, Canon, Bondi Sands and Philips, helping them accelerate growth and deliver exceptional customer experiences across major marketplaces including Amazon and Zalando, branded webstores and social platforms.

Backed by significant investment, Luzern is an international, technology-led eCommerce business with anambitious growth strategy. Our AI-enabled Channel Optimizer platform, combined with our eCommerce expertise, helps brands manage and grow their presence across increasingly complex digital channels.  
As we continue to grow and evolve, we are looking for talented people who enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to play an active role in the next stage of Luzern's development.

The Senior eCommerce Content Strategist owns content strategy and execution across Amazon and the wider commerce ecosystem for Luzern's enterprise brand clients. Amazon is the primary focus — listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related content — but the role is deliberately platform-agnostic in outlook, extending strategy and content guidance to other marketplaces, retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando,Otto) and D2C.

The role is audit-led: content strategy is built from a structured read of customer and platform signals — reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers put to AI assistants and platform agents — combined with a quality assessment of current content (using a framework such as IDQ or equivalent) against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements. Strategy, messaging and content requirements follow from that evidence base, rather than from assumption.

A defining part of the role is thinking beyond traditional platform search: strategies must consider how content needs to be structured and prepared to be discovered and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g. Amazon's Rufus), alongside conventional marketplace and retailer search algorithms.

The role sits as the senior content specialist within a small delivery pod, working alongside an SEO Executive and Designers. It carries direct client-facing responsibility: estimating, briefing, managing feedback and contributing to proposals and is responsible for reviewing the pod's output before it reaches the client. It does not carry resourcing, project management or formal line management responsibility.

**Tasks**
---------

**What You’ll Be Doing**

**Content Audits & Quality Assessment**  

* Signal analysis: analyse customer reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers and AI agents put to platforms (e.g. Rufus prompts), to understand what content needs to do and where current content falls short.
* Quality benchmarking — review current platform content and score it against a content quality framework (e.g. IDQ or equivalent), benchmarking against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements.
* Findings to action — translate audit findings into a clear, prioritised view of content requirements that feeds directly into strategy.

**Content Strategy Development**  

* Amazon content ownership- develop and own content strategy and execution for listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related Amazon content, as the role's primary focus.
* Cross-platform extension — extend strategy and content recommendations to other marketplaces,retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C storefronts, adapting to each platform's content rules, algorithm and customer behaviour.
* Strategic framework - from audit findings, develop comms objectives, key messages and a messaging hierarchy for each client or category.
* Content requirements - define the content requirements, imagery and copy needed to deliverthe strategy, and the frameworks/guidelines the team and client can act on.
* Wireframes & mock-ups - develop A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups in collaborationwith the Designer, turning strategy into an executable creative direction.

**AI & Agentic Discoverability**  

* AI-ready content — build content strategies that account for how product and brand content is read, ranked and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g. ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g Rufus), alongside traditional search.
* Point of view — keep Luzern's thinking on AI/agentic discoverability current, and translate emerging platform and LLM behaviour into practical, sellable content recommendations.
* Alignment with SEO — partner with the SEO Executive so keyword and search strategy and content structure are aligned across traditional and AI-mediated discovery.

**Testing & Performance Monitoring**  

* A/B testing — recommend and run A/B tests (e.g. on A+ Content, Brand Store, imagery and messaging) to determine the most effective executional approach, rather than relying on opinion or precedent.
* Monitoring set-up - set up monitoring using Compass (or equivalent) to measure content effectiveness and implementation.
* Reporting on impact — track and report on content performance against strategy objectives, feeding learnings back into future audits and strategy.

**Creative Briefing & Review**  

* Strategic foundation - develop the strategy and messaging that underpins paid social, display and

marketplace advertising content.  

* Creative briefs - write and own briefs for Designers producing static and video ad assets, translating strategy into clear creative direction.
* Creative review - review creative output against the brief, brand guidelines and platform requirements before client delivery.

**Client Management**  

* Client-facing delivery - present content strategy, recommendations and audit findings directly to client stakeholders.
* Estimates & scoping - prepare estimates and scopes of work for content workstreams.
* Briefs — shape and write content and creative briefs in response to client requirements.
* Feedback management — manage client feedback through to resolution, balancing client expectations against strategy and platform best practice.
* Proposals — contribute to and help prepare proposals and pitch content for new and existing client business.

**Quality & Output Review**  

* Senior review — review the SEO Executive's and Designers' work before it is sent to the client, checking it against strategy, brand guidelines and platform requirements.
* Direction — give feedback and direction to keep output consistent and on-strategy.

**AI-Enabled Working**  

* AI as a working method — use AI tools proficiently for content and competitive audits, for generating recommendations, and for producing or accelerating creative and written content — not only as a subject of strategy.
* Continuous improvement — identify and recommend where AI tools can improve the speed or quality of content production and audit work across the team.

**Requirements**
----------------

**What You Bring to the Role**

* Proven experience in Amazon content strategy and execution (listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store, Amazon Posts), ideally within an agency or managed services environment.

* Working knowledge of content requirements across at least one other marketplace or major retailer platform (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C.

* Experience running content audits — analysing reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries and customer/AI-agent queries — and scoring content quality (e.g. IDQ or equivalent) against best-in-Class standards.

* Experience translating audit findings into content strategy: comms objectives, key messaging, messaging hierarchy, and content requirements for imagery and copy.

* Experience developing or briefing A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups, working closely with designers.

* Experience designing and running A/B tests to determine the most effective executional approach, and setting up performance monitoring (e.g. Amazon Compass or equivalent) to track results.

* Strong understanding of how AI assistants and platform shopping agents (e.g. ChatGPT, Rufus)surface and rank product content, and how content should be structured to support this.

* Confident, credible client-facing communicator — comfortable presenting strategy, leading feedback conversations, and owning estimates and proposals.

* Experience briefing creative teams for paid social/display advertising, across both static and video formats.

* Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI tools for research, auditing and content production, not just familiarity in principle.

* Strong copywriting and content editing skills, with a close eye for brand and platform compliance.

* Comfortable reviewing and giving constructive feedback on the work of SEO and design peers.

**Desirable**

* Experience across multiple international marketplaces or retail media platforms.

* Familiarity with SEO fundamentals, to collaborate effectively with the SEO Executive.

* Experience contributing to new business pitches or proposals.

* Category experience relevant to Luzern's enterprise brand client base.

**Benefits**
------------

**What We Offer**  

* Competitive salary and benefits
* Hybrid Working Model
* Great working environment with a passionate, collaborative team
* Continuous learning & career development
* The opportunity to work with some of the world's leading brands across the most exciting marketplaces

We are committed to equal opportunities and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Youtube Strategist & Channel Manager
description:
**TheSoul Group** is a leading creator business platform positioned at the heart of the creator economy. Our original videos, animations, and editorial stories inspire audiences in **21 languages**, across **60 platforms** and **20 websites**.  
Together with our network of **talented creators**, we reach over **5 billion followers** and generate more than **100 billion monthly views** on social media.

As a global powerhouse in digital media, we drive viral success for creators and brands worldwide through a wide range of services, leveraging our expertise in content distribution, localization, and social media management. We’re a dynamic, remote-first global team, fostering award-winning creativity, a no-red-tape approach, and great vibes!  
  
TheSoul Group is launching the YouTube channel for an established TV series in the food and outdoor space, bringing its content to a new digital audience.

YouTube is the main stage, and **views and subscribers are the KPIs that matter most**. TikTok, Instagram and Facebook grow alongside it, both as channels in their own right and as a way to send viewers to YouTube.

As our **YouTube Strategist & Channel Manager**, you'll set the strategy and run the channel day to day. You read the data, decide what comes next, and work hand in hand with a dedicated editor so every new video builds on what performs.

**Strategy & data**

* Track channel performance weekly: views, subscribers, retention, CTR, traffic sources and returning viewers
* Turn insights into **clear, data-led briefs for the editor**: which topics and moments to use, which hooks to test, what length works best
* Find the formats and topics the audience responds to, and adjust the plan to match
* Lead the channel to **YouTube monetisation eligibility** and track progress against it

**Running the channel**

* Support the channel and account setup for a **US audience**; set up playlists, keywords and a standard for titles and descriptions
* Own the publishing calendar: **2 long-form videos and 14 Shorts a week** on YouTube, plus regular posting on TikTok, Instagram and Facebook
* Grow TikTok, Instagram and Facebook: adapt content per platform and test formats, posting times and captions
* Write titles, descriptions and captions; brief thumbnails and A/B test them every week
* Refresh underperforming videos with a new title, thumbnail or opening
* Spot trends early and bring relevant ideas into the plan
* Prepare cuts for client review and approval in Frame.io

**Community**

* Manage comments and messages across all platforms daily
* Build an engaged community and turn recurring questions and feedback into content ideas

  
**Requirements**  

* **3+ years growing YouTube channels hands-on**, both long-form and Shorts, with before-and-after numbers to show for it
* Strong analytics skills, and the ability to turn data into clear creative direction for an editor
* Comfortable owning both strategy and daily execution: posting, copywriting, titles and community management
* Hands-on experience growing **TikTok and Instagram** accounts, including setting up accounts for a specific country
* Highly organised: able to run a high-volume calendar with client approvals
* Senior enough to work directly with the client: explaining and defending decisions and handling feedback with confidence
* Available for a couple of hours' overlap with **US Pacific time** when needed
* Experience turning existing **TV, film or podcast content** into YouTube content (a strong plus)
* Background in **food, travel or outdoor** niches
* Knowledge of YouTube's advertiser-friendly guidelines for hunting, fishing and animal-processing footage
* Experience with brand integrations
* Fluent English

  
**Benefits**  

* **Flexible Engagement Structure:** This opportunity is offered under an independent service-provider agreement, giving you the freedom to shape how you deliver your expertise. You define your own working methods, organise your schedule independently, and contribute your skills to clearly scoped projects. Compensation is agreed individually and reflects your experience, capabilities, and the value you bring to each engagement.
* **Location Freedom:** You can deliver services from any suitable location that supports high-quality outcomes, whether that’s your home office, a co-working space, or wherever you feel most productive and inspired. What matters most is the impact you create and the reliability of your delivery.
* **Global Network and Inspiring Projects:** You’ll collaborate with a diverse international network of professionals across 85+ countries, contributing to projects that reach vast audiences and help shape the future of digital content. This is an opportunity to work alongside talented specialists, exchange ideas, and be part of meaningful initiatives with real global reach.
* **Smooth Collaboration and Project Support:** To enable efficient service delivery, we provide modern collaboration platforms, clear project coordination, and streamlined processes. This helps you focus your energy where it matters most, producing high-impact work and bringing creative solutions to life.
* **Make a Global Impact:** Your expertise will contribute to initiatives that influence audiences worldwide. Join projects that push creative boundaries and help build the next generation of digital experiences.

We appreciate your interest in our job opportunities and our company. Our team carefully evaluates each application to identify the most suitable candidates for the role. Due to the high volume of applications received, we may not be able to respond to every applicant. However, if your qualifications align with our requirements, we will contact you to discuss the next steps in the selection process.

title: Senior Lifecycle & Retention Strategist - Klaviyo & Shopify Agency (Remote)
description:
Paired is a global recruiting agency that pairs remote work with top-tier talent. We help individuals from around the world connect with great companies that are looking for their specific skill set. Our mission is to provide great jobs to talented people, no matter where they are located.

About Our Clients

*We are a recruiting partner representing* ***three leading, fast-growing e-commerce retention agencies*** *currently scaling their teams. By applying to this single role, you will be considered for three distinct agency dynamics depending on your background and career goals:*

They are looking for experienced **Lifecycle & Retention Growth Strategists** who can take ownership of customer retention, lifecycle marketing, and growth initiatives.

* **The Enterprise Scale Agency:** Best for strategists who love global teams, structured multi-person account pods, and managing high-profile global brand portfolios.
* **The Agile Boutique Studio:** Best for autonomous, execution-focused strategists who love working closely with founders and driving rapid list growth for 7-figure brands.

This is a strategic, hands-on role for someone who understands how to turn customer and performance data into actions that improve revenue, retention, engagement, and customer lifetime value.

Depending on the client, your scope may include email and SMS marketing, lifecycle automation, retention strategy, subscription growth, customer journeys, experimentation, and cross-functional team leadership.

Key responsibilities

* Own lifecycle and retention strategy across email, SMS, subscription, and other customer touchpoints based on business needs.
* Analyze customer, campaign, retention, and revenue data to identify opportunities and determine what should be tested or optimized.
* Develop and execute experiments around offers, messaging, segmentation, customer journeys, subscription conversion, retention, and lifecycle engagement.
* Build and optimize lifecycle programs, including campaigns, automated flows, onboarding, post-purchase, winback, cancellation/save journeys, and other retention initiatives.

* Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams including copywriters, designers, project managers, developers, and other marketing specialists.

* Monitor account/customer health and proactively identify risks, performance gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Help build scalable playbooks, processes, and best practices that improve lifecycle and retention performance across the business.

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of experience in lifecycle marketing, retention marketing, CRM, growth marketing, email/SMS marketing, subscription growth, or a closely related field.
* Strong understanding of DTC/ecommerce, consumer, subscription, or digital businesses and how customer retention contributes to revenue and profitability.
* Proven experience using data to make strategic marketing or growth decisions rather than simply executing predefined campaigns.
* Strong experience with lifecycle marketing platforms such as Klaviyo or comparable CRM/marketing automation tools.
* Hands-on understanding of customer segmentation, automated journeys/flows, retention programs, experimentation, and performance optimization.
* Experience owning measurable business outcomes such as revenue, retention, churn, LTV, conversion, subscription growth, or lifecycle performance.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate performance data into clear recommendations and next actions.
* Comfortable working directly with clients, founders, CMOs, or senior stakeholders and communicating recommendations with confidence.
* Strong project ownership and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing attention to detail.
* Able to work cross-functionally and direct or collaborate with creative, project management, development, and marketing teams.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills suitable for client-facing work.
* Self-directed, commercially minded, proactive, and comfortable operating in fast-moving environments.
* Strong attention to detail and ownership mentality; you check your own work and take responsibility for outcomes, not just assigned tasks.
* Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to improve marketing workflows, analysis, content development, or operational efficiency is a plus.

  
**Benefits**  

* Competitive USD compensation based on experience and client requirements.
* Remote flexibility – work from anywhere while collaborating with international teams.
* Opportunities to work with international companies across ecommerce, DTC, subscription, and digital businesses.
* High-ownership roles with exposure to strategy, experimentation, and business growth.
