title: Associate Director- Sustainability & Impact (Lyon, France)
description:
**Location : Lyon, France**

**About ARCHIMED:**

With offices in Europe, North America and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare industries. Its mix of operational, medical, scientific and financial expertise allows ARCHIMED to serve as both a strategic and financial partner to healthcare businesses. Prioritized areas of focus include Biopharma Products, Consumer Health, Healthcare IT, In Vitro Diagnostics, Life Science Tools & Biologic Services, MedTech, and Pharma Services.

ARCHIMED helps partners internationalize, acquire, innovate and expand their products and services. ARCHIMED manages €8 billion across its various funds, including the largest healthcare-only private equity fund raised by a European-based General Partner. Since inception, ARCHIMED has been a committed Impact investor, both directly and through its EURÊKA Foundation.

**The Team**

* An international team (with more than 30 nationalities) with complementary education and experience in the investment, medical, scientific, strategic and operational sectors
* Composed of alumni from: INSEAD, Berkeley, Georgetown, Bocconi, HEC Paris, Ponts et Chaussées, ESSEC, Imperial College, Dartmouth, etc.
* Professional backgrounds: Private Equity (3i, Siparex, USS Ltd, Barings, capiton), Consulting (A.T. Kearney, Bain, McKinsey), M&A (Lazard, EY, KPMG, PwC), Industry (Biotronik, Cerba, Pharmacy, Veterinary)

***Your Role***

Portfolio engagement and value creation

* Lead portfolio engagement on Sustainability and Impact (S&I), providing hands-on support to portfolio companies and tracking S&I progress across ARCHIMED’s portfolios through dashboards, KPIs, and supporting processes.
* Lead select portfolio value creation projects, collaborating with deal teams as well as guiding and project managing S&I interns where required.
* Develop and oversee the execution of actionable S&I roadmaps for each portfolio company, with targets and milestones based on the company’s materiality analysis and aligned with ARCHIMED’s S&I strategy, partnering with third-party technical experts when necessary.
* Influence portfolio company management to advance their roadmaps through technical guidance and sharing of best practices.

Investment process

* Act as the bridge between deal teams and external providers during due diligence, critically assessing findings to confirm that each target is consistent with ARCHIMED’s S&I strategy and fund obligations.
* Work with all ARCHIMED functions to review and improve how S&I is integrated into investment decision making.

Data, reporting, and compliance

* Establish the tools and framework to collect, monitor, and coordinate S&I data across funds, enabling timely, accurate, and consistent reporting, and select third-party technical experts when necessary.
* Analyze and interpret S&I data and substantially contribute to the production of ARCHIMED’s annual S&I report in line with industry standards and frameworks, turning data into clear narratives.
* Contribute substantially to regular reporting to investors and to mandatory disclosures on fund S&I performance, ensuring credibility and transparency.
* Monitor regulatory developments in ARCHIMED’s locations and sectors of focus, and help ensure compliance with sustainability-related requirements.

Center of excellence and capability building

* Establish an S&I center of excellence across funds and portfolio companies, with tools, reports, and training materials that share guidance and best practices.
* Provide expert guidance and S&I training to management, investment, and investor relations teams to deepen integration across the business.

  
**Requirements**  

* At least 10 years’ experience building and executing sustainability strategies, preferably in private equity.
* Proven hands-on leadership, initiative, and project management skills, with strong problem-solving ability.
* Robust knowledge of S&I frameworks and disclosures, including SFDR, SASB, CSRD, EDCI, PMDR, and the UN SDGs.
* Strong command of impact measurement methodologies, including developing and reporting on impact metrics.
* Strong attention to detail, with the ability to build coherent sustainability narratives and proofread content.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, with the adaptability to engage C-suite executives internationally.
* Proven team player, able to build working partnerships and promote collaboration with a wide range of stakeholders.
* Ability to coach junior team members, sharing knowledge and giving regular feedback.
* Pragmatic, constructive, creative, and solution-oriented, with a positive mindset and the ability to work under varied pressures.

title: General Manager
description:
**Company Description**

**SLS Residences Infantas Madrid** brings a new way of living to the heart of Madrid’s **Justicia** neighbourhood. Set within a 1920s neo-Baroque landmark, this very first standalone residence by the brand in Spain will unveil a bold, refined and sensory world where our guests take centre stage.

Comprising **33 exclusive residences,** it offers residents the intimacy of an exceptional home, paired with a complete range of services that are as exclusive as they are iconic, from dining spaces, wellness facilities and bespoke services to our residents-only **Social House**. Welcome to a new chapter in luxury residential living, where sophistication, playfulness and exceptional hospitality come together to bring the extraordinary to life.

 **Job Description**

As **General Manager** of **SLS Residences Infantas Madrid**, you will lead the opening and day-to-day success of our first standalone SLS residence in Spain. More than overseeing operations, you will shape a bold, refined and highly personalised residential experience where service feels effortless, community feels vibrant, and every detail reflects the spirit of SLS.

**What you’ll do…**

* **Lead the homeowner journey end to end.**

You oversee every stage of the residential experience, from handover and welcome to daily living, community integration and long-term homeowner satisfaction.

* **Deliver exceptional residential service standards**

You bring SLS service promise to life through clear procedures, elevated standards, and thoughtful training, and ensure a consistently distinctive and anticipatory homeowner experience.

* **Build trusted homeowner relationships, support HOA governance and alignment.**

You serve as the main point of contact for homeowners, creating lasting relationships built on empathy, discretion, responsiveness, and personalised care. Working closely with the Homeowners Association (HOA), you ensure transparent communication, compliance with bylaws, and active participation in community governance.

* **Oversee all residential operations and drive a seamless cross-functional collaboration to deliver exceptional residential service standards**.

With you onboard, you bring SLS service promise to life, and the residence will run smoothly across all departments, and also with external providers, delivering integrated residential operations. Our guest won’t see the backstage of the show.

* **Own financial performance.**

With your Director of Finance, you manage budgets, control costs, optimise resources and monitor performance with a sharp commercial mindset, while always protecting service excellence and homeowner satisfaction.

* **Lead, inspire and develop your team**.

You recruit, mentor and empower a high-performing team which goes through fostering a culture of accountability, warmth, and excellence in a residential environment.

* **Champion health, safety, and security within the residence.**

You make sure to align with local regulations and brand expectations, you guarantee the peace of mind for residents.

* **Create meaningful local connections & bring the community to life.**

You act as an ambassador of the residence within Madrid, you curate exclusive local partnerships and bespoke lifestyle offerings to enrich residents everyday living, foster connection, and express the unique energy of SLS living.

 **Qualifications**

**What you’ll bring to**

* 7–10 years of progressive **leadership experience** within ultra-luxury standalone residences, high-end residential environments, serviced apartments, or private members’ clubs.
* A proven ability to **deliver elevated, intuitive and highly personalized service**, with a strong track record of building trusted relationships with high-net-worth homeowners and residents.
* **Strong financial acumen**, with experience managing budgets, forecasting performance, optimizing resources and driving operational excellence within a luxury environment.
* **Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills**, with the presence, confidence and emotional intelligence to engage effortlessly with homeowners, teams, partners and executive stakeholders.
* A **natural leader** with a demonstrated ability to inspire, develop and unite cross-functional teams in a dynamic, detail-driven and service-focused setting.
* Strong command of property management systems, CRM platforms and Microsoft Office, with the agility to navigate both operational detail and strategic oversight.
* **Solid experience in luxury residential living** or similarly refined lifestyle environments, with a strong understanding of what defines exceptional service beyond a traditional hotel setting.
* Good knowledge of the **local luxury market**, including resident expectations, premium service providers and the competitive landscape shaping high-end living in Madrid.
* Sound understanding of HOA governance, residential compliance and the legal frameworks that support seamless and well-managed community living.
* Strong project management capabilities, with the ability to lead complex initiatives, balance multiple stakeholders and bring ambitious openings or enhancements to life with precision.
* Multilingual skills are a distinct advantage, reflecting the international profile of the resident community.
* Above all, a genuine passion for lifestyle, community and creating extraordinary moments — with the instinct to make everyday residential living feel both effortless and exceptional.

  
**Additional Information**

**What's in it for you...**

* Command the stage at SLS Madrid, where five-star hospitality meets audacious creativity.
* Lead a powerhouse team driven to outpace the competition and redefine what luxury feels like.
* Thrive in a culture that celebrates innovation, rewards relentless standards, and challenges the expected.
* Global growth opportunities, and the prestige of leading within Ennismore and Accor.
* Indulge in lavish perks, with exclusive access and benefits across our portfolio of iconic brands.

***SLS*** *is part of Ennismore, a creative hospitality company rooted in culture and community, with a global collection of entrepreneurial and founder-built brands with purpose at their heart.* ***Ennismore*** *is a joint- venture with* ***Accor****, formed in 2021.*

title: Social Media Lead - SportyTV & Sports Media Brands
description:
**About Sporty Group**
----------------------

Sporty Group is a global sports entertainment company, home to leading brands like **SportyBet**, **Football.com** and **SportyTV**. We operate at the intersection of **sports, content, community and technology**, building products and media experiences that connect fans with the moments that matter.

Our media brands, led by **SportyTV**, bring fans closer to the game through highlights, stories, analysis, personalities and football culture, across every major social platform.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We're looking for a **Social Media Lead** to drive social strategy and coordinate the social team behind **SportyTV and our sports media brands**. This role combines **team leadership**, a **sports journalism mindset** and **strong editorial judgement** to make our channels a go-to destination for football fans.

You'll set the editorial direction, run day-to-day publishing operations, and lead a team of social media managers, community managers and content creators, making sure our output is **fast, accurate, engaging and built for growth**.

You'll work closely with **Content, Video/Production, Design, Brand, Marketing, Partnerships, BI and Country teams**, and report to the Social Media Director.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Team Leadership & Coordination**

* Lead, coordinate and develop a team of social media managers, community managers and content creators across SportyTV and our media brands.
* Set priorities, assign coverage and run workflows and shift planning for match days, live events and breaking news.
* Give clear feedback, run regular editorial meetings and raise the team's creative and editorial standards.
* Build scalable processes (calendars, briefs, approval flows, playbooks) that keep the team fast and consistent.

### **Editorial Strategy & Sports Coverage**

* Define and execute the social and editorial strategy for **SportyTV and Football.com**, aligned with global brand guidelines and business priorities.
* Own the editorial calendar around major football and sports moments (EPL, UCL, LaLiga, AFCON, World Cup, transfer windows, etc.).
* Apply a journalistic approach to social: newsworthiness, storytelling, fact-checking, source verification and speed without sacrificing accuracy.
* Lead real-time and reactive coverage of match days, breaking news, transfers, controversies and trending moments.

### **Content & Formats**

* Oversee content across Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, YouTube (incl. Shorts), LinkedIn and Telegram.
* Develop and scale repeatable content series and franchises: highlights-led narratives, analysis, interviews, explainers, football culture and personality-led formats.
* Work with video, production and design teams to deliver platform-native content with strong hooks and retention.
* Ensure tone of voice, quality and brand consistency across all channels.

### **Community & Audience Growth**

* Drive follower growth, engagement and watch time across SportyTV and media brand channels.
* Oversee community management: comments, DMs, moderation, sentiment monitoring and escalation of sensitive issues.
* Spot local relevance opportunities across our key markets and global football audiences.

### **Talent, Creators & Partnerships**

* Work with presenters, journalists, pundits, creators and sports personalities to grow reach and credibility.
* Support partnerships, rights-holder relationships and co-branded activations with clubs, leagues and media partners.
* Coordinate with marketing teams on organic and paid amplification.

### **Reporting & Performance**

* Track KPIs: reach, views, watch time, engagement, follower growth, retention and sentiment.
* Deliver weekly/monthly reporting with clear insights and next actions for the team and leadership.
* Run testing frameworks to improve formats, hooks, timing and distribution.

**Requirements**
----------------

* **5+ years** of experience in social media, with at least **2 years coordinating or leading social media teams**.
* Background in **sports journalism, sports media or a sports newsroom** (degree in Journalism or Communications is a plus).
* Proven experience running social channels for **sports media brands, publishers, broadcasters, clubs or leagues**.
* Deep football and sports knowledge, with a strong news sense and love for the game.
* **Excellent English (C1/C2 or native)**: you'll write, edit and approve content in English and it's our main working language. Spanish or other languages are a plus.
* Strong editorial judgement: accuracy, fact-checking, tone and handling sensitive stories.
* Excellent platform instincts across TikTok, Instagram, X, YouTube and Facebook, and a good understanding of video-first content.
* Confident using analytics and social listening tools to guide decisions.
* Strong organisation, stakeholder management and the ability to lead a team in a fast-paced, high-output environment.

### **Nice to have**

* Experience with live coverage of major tournaments.
* Experience working with audiences in Africa, Latin America or other international markets.
* Hands-on video editing or production experience.

If you're interested, we encourage you to apply! Every application is reviewed by a member of our team (AI is not used in our recruitment process), and we aim to respond within 48 hours.

title: Wholesale Assistant
description:
### **Position**

**Being part of LOEWE** gives you the opportunity of learning new things every day and working with people passionate about what they do, in a fast moving and ambitious company.

As **Wholesale Assistant** , you will support the Wholesale Manager and Account Executives in the daily management of wholesale operations, ensuring clients receive exceptional service and accurate, timely communication throughout the order lifecycle. The role requires strong coordination across internal departments (Commercial, Operations, Logistics, and Finance) and proactive follow-up with external partners.

### **Job responsibilities**

**Your role will be:**  
  
Support the global Wholesale team in day-to-day account Management, assuring that clients are responded to in a timely manner and given the service needed to support their business.

* Oversee wholesale order management from placement to delivery, ensuring accuracy.
* Monitor order status, deliveries, and resolve logistical issues, aligning with internal teams.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Operations, Logistics, Credit Control, Finance, Merchandising, Product) to ensure smooth processes and data accuracy.
* Coordinate with credit control on payments, invoicing, and blocked orders.
* Act as the primary contact for wholesale clients, addressing operational queries and providing updates.
* Assist in onboarding new wholesale clients and manage client databases.
* Support sales reporting, data tracking, and client-facing report preparation.
* Maintain client files, communication trackers, and internal communication logs.
* Support with the management of RTV processes, quality issues, and credit notes.

### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a related field.
* At least one year of relevant work experience in a similar role.
* Fluency in both Spanish and English is required; additional languages are considered an asset.
* Strong analytical skills, excellent organisational abilities, and effective time management skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
* Previous experience with fashion or luxury brands is a plus, but not essential.

### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**
  
  
Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.
  
  
At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

title: Brand Partnerships Manager (12m FTC)
description:
**THE CARWOW GROUP**

Carwow Group is driven by a passion for getting people into cars. But not just any car, the right car. That’s why we are building the go-to destination for car-changing. Designed to reach drivers everywhere with our trail-blazing portfolio of personality rich automotive brands; Carwow, Auto Express, evo, Driving Electric and Car Buyer.

What started as a simple reviews site, is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe - over 10m customers have used Carwow to help them buy and sell cars since its inception. Last year we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia, doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with over 1.1 billion annual views, sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

**WHY JOIN US?**

Shortlisted in the prestigious Culture 100 list of the top Growth companies to work for by Hyer; we also recently raised $52m in funding led by global venture capital firm an early backer of LinkedIn and Shopify, Bessemer Venture Partners, to accelerate our growth plans!

As pioneers, we’re always driving for new territory and positive change, so our work as a group is never done. Where others see difficulty, it’s our responsibility to see possibility – building new experiences, launching new titles and listening to drivers.

Being a part of Carwow Group means championing drivers and the automotive industry, acting as a disrupter and never being afraid to fail (but learning fast when we do!).

Our team of 500 employees across the UK, Germany, Spain and Portugal are revolutionising car-changing and we are fast expanding our mission across every single brand and country we operate in, so jump in!

**THE ROLE**

This role is directly accountable for owning, building and developing our relationship with automotive brands in Spain. With a dedicated portfolio of brands, this role enables autonomy, responsibility and ownership. Tasked with continuing to build and grow both the breadth and depth of our relationships, the Brand Partnerships Managers are empowered to strategise, develop and execute individual strategies for each brand in their portfolio - tailoring both our proposition and approach to ensure we drive value for our partners and innovation between automotive brands and Carwow.

Relationship building, creative thinking and balancing short term milestones as well as a long term vision for each brand are critical in success. The role works closely with both a Head of OEM & Media and a wider team of Brand Partnerships managers, providing support and development.

Alongside the dedicated portfolio the role also plays a key part in paving the future of both the OEM & Media business and Carwow by providing critical feedback from our partners to ensure we continuously develop our products and propositions.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* This is a partnership focused role - Direct ownership of our partner relationships, new partner pitches and building rapport. The end goal is to expand the depth and breadth of carwow's partnerships with automotive brands in Spain
* Creation and delivery of coherent and professional partnership pitch decks
* Using data and insight to make your pitches come alive with client-relevant data and information
* Proactively managing our client partnerships and ongoing projects - from working with manufacturers to create and deliver marketing campaigns, brand experiences or retailer engagement.
* Working closely with our Commercial Team to ensure the effectiveness and success of our partner brand campaigns
* Ensuring successful delivery of projects by working collaboratively with other teams at carwow and spotting potential problems before they arise

**WHAT YOU'LL NEED**

* A natural ability to tell engaging and impactful stories
* Evidence and experience of sales & partnerships experience within Tech or Automotive industries (highly preferable)
* An eye for detail and a creative approach to solving challenges faced by car manufacturers and their partners
* Experience meeting and building rapport with C-Suite / Senior individuals both internally and externally
* Ability to manage projects and initiatives from start to finish, including the conceptualisation, implementation and reporting of concurrent projects
* Strong data analysis skills with the ability to build a cohesive story for our clients using carwow's vast reserves of data
* Incredible organisation skills - you'll be juggling lots of clients who are all in different stages and all require different approaches
* An understanding of the world of marketing and media would be a bonus, although not essential

**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU**

* Hybrid working that works around you
* Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali
* Share options - when we thrive, so do you!
* Private Healthcare, for peace of mind
* Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner
* Enhanced holiday package, plus bank holidays

  + 28 days annual leave
  + 1 day for your wedding
  + 1 day off when you move house - because moving’s hard enough without work!
  + On your third year anniversary, you get 30 days of annual leave per year
  + On your tenth year anniversary, you get 35 days of annual leave per year
  + Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year
* Work from abroad for a month (due to popular demand, this offer excludes the moon).
* Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies
* The latest tech (Macbook or Surface) to power your gif-sending talents
* Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about
* A generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft
* Regular social events:, tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for
* Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money
* Lunch & learns and Carwow Classrooms with expert speakers who are here for a free lunch

*Diversity and inclusion is an integral part of our culture. We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply for this position. We make recruiting decisions based on experience, skills and potential, so all our applicants are treated fairly and equally.*

title: Marketing Planning and Performance Manager
description:
Just imagine shaping how the LEGO® brand builds demand across Spain and Portugal. Then make it real.

  
  

**About the role**

As our Marketing Planning & Performance Manager for Iberia, you’ll lead insight-driven marketing planning, budget management and marketing effectiveness. You’ll translate global and Western Europe priorities into commercially grounded local plans. Working closely with Marketing and Finance, you’ll connect consumer, shopper and market insights with investment decisions, monitor performance and recommend action when results move off track. The position will belong to the marketing leadership team reporting directly to the Head of Marketing.

  
  

**Required Qualifications**

* Proven experience in coordinating planning cycles, tracking spend and forecasts, investigating variances and supporting month-end and year-end financial processes.
* Strong ease working with figures and complex datasets; ability to check data accuracy, identify trends and variances, interpret marketing, consumer, shopper and commercial data, evaluate effectiveness and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Advanced Excel, strong PowerPoint and confidence working with reporting and planning systems to produce accurate analysis and clear decision-ready presentations.
* Stakeholder influence and collaboration: build strong relationships across Marketing, Finance and regional teams
* Being able to connect analysis to business priorities, communicate a clear storyline and present practical recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Prioritisation, ownership and adaptability: focus on the highest-impact priorities - make trade-offs, anticipate risks, maintain attention to detail and deliver reliably under pressure
* Professional fluency in English and Spanish
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Applied marketing mix modelling, campaign evaluation, or consumer and shopper research to guide media and marketing investment decisions.
* Coordinated integrated marketing plans across multiple markets, aligning local priorities with regional direction.
  

**What you'll build**

* Coordinating the marketing contribution to Iberia’s annual strategy, bringing together insights and priorities to shape a coherent plan aligned with business objectives and Western Europe direction.
* Optimising marketing budgets throughout the year, allocating and reallocating investment in line with strategic priorities and business performance to focus resources where they can have the greatest impact.
* Balancing brand-building priorities, commercial objectives and budget constraints, including recommendations to address gaps to target.
* Translating complex performance data and marketing effectiveness findings into practical investment choices and clear stakeholder narratives.
* Improving planning tools, data quality and ways of working while building shared ownership of performance and continuous learning.
  

  

If you’ve owned a marketing budget or planning cycle and used performance data to change an investment decision, you’ll feel at home here. What matters most is making complex findings clear, practical and useful.

  
  

**Life on the team**

You’ll join the Iberia Marketing team, which creates demand through locally relevant programmes grounded in consumer, shopper and commercial understanding. You’ll collaborate across Brand Marketing, Digital Media, Brand Relations, Trade Marketing and Finance. You’ll take ownership, manage competing priorities and communicate clear storylines, while constructively challenging requests when focus is needed.

  
  

**What success looks like**

You’ll create transparent budgets, reliable planning routines and timely performance reviews that lead to action. As the team strengthens integrated planning across Spain and Portugal, you’ll help embed marketing effectiveness and consumer insights into investment discussions. You’ll work closely with the Head of Marketing, the Marketing Leadership Team, Finance, Western Europe peers, insight specialists, the Marketing Effectiveness team and external agencies.

Here is what you can expect:

title: Regional People Partner - Europe Major Markets
description:
### **Description**

**Diversity matters**

We are building a brand that represents the people of the world. It’s what you do that counts, and we are always looking to expand perspectives and voices to shape our future.

We see you, we celebrate you, we want you!

**Who we are**  
You might know us as the inventors of the bath bomb, but there’s more to this great-smelling, partly employee-owned, family-run company than pioneering cosmetics. We believe our business should put more back into the world than it takes and demonstrate that capitalism can be a force for good.  
  
The Living Wage Foundation’s statement 'a hard day's work deserves a fair day's pay' is one that we are proud to commit to in the UK. As an accredited Living Wage employer, we put our people first and fight cruel practices like animal testing, promote regeneration, and show that it is what’s inside that counts - whether that’s an ingredient in a product, or the minerals in a smartphone.  
  
Want to see where a career at Lush could take you? Head over here to explore real stories of growth and development across the business.  
  
Lush is committed to pay transparency and equal pay for equal work or work of equal value. Pay decisions are made objectively based on role scope, geographic market data, experience, and capability, without regard to gender or protected characteristics.  
  
**Role overview:**

Develop meaningful and mutually beneficial relationships between people practices and commercial business success across our European major markets. Engage with regional leaders, country managers, and business partners. Deliver change and transformation, taking the lead in people related projects with a broad and objective view of the impact across diverse business areas and geographies within the region.

This role involves direct line management and leadership of People Leads across our European entities. Driving regional alignment, operational consistency, and team development. You will utilise sound knowledge of Lush people principles and best practices, working collaboratively and proactively with other members of the global and regional people team on cross functional projects, in support of colleagues doing their best work across multiple markets.

**Office Location:** This role will support our colleagues in France, Germany, Italy and Spain and ideally you're main location of work will be Paris, Berlin, Milan or Madrid.

**Business Travel:** As this role will be supporting France, Germany, Italy and Spain, travelling will be a requirement.  
  
**Please note: We may close this vacancy early if we receive an overwhelming response or our business requirements change.**

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Directly line manage and empower the People Leads across European entities, fostering their growth, setting clear operational standards, and ensuring strong local HR delivery.
* Work alongside the Leader/Director, FBP, and their team on a wide range of topics, such as change management, projects, organisational design, recruitment, training and development, and communications.
* Provide tactical advice and guidance to the management of your business areas on all people matters relating to capability, skills required, and performance output.
* Connect regularly with the People Discipline Leads creating alignment in standards of staff experience in recruitment, onboarding, training, pay, and development while respecting and adapting to local cultural and regulatory nuances within the region.
* Deliver organisational development projects and support organisational change initiatives within the business entities. Establishing needs, proposing solutions, and monitoring effectiveness to get the best possible return for the business area while managing regional complexity and local implementation.
* Navigate local employment law landscapes across major markets, partnering with local experts and employee representative bodies such as Works Councils and Trade Unions to ensure fair, compliant, and culturally sensitive operations.
* Build relationships of mutual learning and trust with regional peers and stakeholders and have a good understanding of individuals' working styles and team dynamics.
* Assess and review team structures & development pathways. Identify skills gaps, succession planning, talent, and performance management opportunities across your team and European entities.
* Clearly communicate guidance to staff at all levels on change management and restructures, with emphasis on the how, ensuring compliance with all relevant jurisdictional requirements by working with local experts.
* Proactively anticipate issues before they happen and act for prevention, particularly regarding cross border people movement and regulatory changes across European markets.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* Minimum of 5 years of HR/People Partnering experience, ideally within a multi site retail, commercial, or multinational environment.
* Proven track record in line managing, coaching, and developing HR/People leads across international or multi entity business models.
* Broad understanding of the commercial landscape within Europe with a drive to help others understand it too.
* Solid working knowledge of French employment law is highly beneficial. Familiarity with employment law in other key European markets is desirable, though core knowledge across other jurisdictions can be taught and supported by local specialists.
* Experience in, or strong capability to navigate:
  + Works Councils (Comité Social et Économique / Betriebsrat) in France and Germany.
  + Trade Unions & Collective Bargaining Agreements (CBA / CCN) in Spain and Italy (e.g., *Convenio Colectivo*, *Contratto Collettivo Nazionale di Lavoro*).
* Trusted relationship with the Director/s, with a track record of providing useful advice and recommendations on people matters.
* Act with kindness, integrity, and respect.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to make decisions independently.
* Informed, relevant, and up to date with the business and team sentiment across the region.
* High emotional intelligence with the ability to think quickly and sensitively in a culturally diverse environment.
* Demonstrable ability to influence, challenge, and negotiate with management at all levels and execute with excellence.
* Excellent ability to navigate multiple perspectives and stakeholders to deliver action that works for everyone.
* Desire to represent a professional and fair approach.
* Strong ability to constantly assess and prioritise the needs of the business and individuals.
* Positive attitude, motivated, action oriented.
* Able to support the growth and development of individuals at all levels.
* Competent in recruiting, interviewing, career conversations in addition to performance management, sensitive feedback, or exit conversations.
* Commercially minded, analytical, and objective, with a strong grasp of regional market data and trends.
* Collaborate closely with other People disciplines to ensure support for all employees, including Talent, Global Mobility, Pay and Benefits, ED&I, People Support, and L&D.

**Languages**

* Professional fluency in spoken and written English is required.
* Professional fluency in one or more major European languages (French, German, Spanish, or Italian) is strongly preferred to effectively manage localised People Leads and partner with regional stakeholders across key entities.

  

### **Benefits**

  

* Bonus scheme
* Day off for weekday birthdays
* A generous discount on Lush products and spa treatments
* Employee assistance programme
* We’re 10% Employee Owned - all colleagues play a role in protecting our ethics, our independence, contributing ideas for the future and share in the rewards of success when the company is doing well.
* Access to employee-led Community Networks, including Disability and Chronic Illness, Family Support, Global Majority (Race and Ethnicity), LGBTQIA+, Menopause and Neurodiversity communities.

Localised benefits can be discussed in more detail during the recruitment process.

We believe that your information is yours and that it is Lush's responsibility to process your personal information in a secure, fair and accurate manner. Every individual processed by LUSH has certain rights over their data, which are detailed in our Privacy Notice here.

### **About Lush**

Since establishing in 1995 in Poole, Dorset, Lush has been driven by innovation and its ethics.  
Creators of pioneering beauty products such as the fizzing bath bomb, shower jellies and solid shampoo bars, we place emphasis on fresh ingredients like organic fruits and vegetables, fight against animal testing and combat over-packaging by developing products that can be sold ‘naked’ to the customer without any packaging.  
  
We currently operate in 52 countries with 928 global shops. Through our separate business divisions we invent, manufacture and sell our handmade products direct to our customers through our own shops and online. The fact that we make all our products by hand is something we are really rather proud of!  
  
Lush is 10% Employee Owned since 2017 and our people are the heart and soul of our business.

title: RGM & Planning Manager - FTC (Hybrid)
description:
**The Role**

**Shape commercial strategy. Turn insights into action. Lead with impact.**

Are you a commercially minded, analytical leader who thrives on turning complex data into winning business strategies?

At **Imperial Brands**, we're looking for an **RGM & Planning Manager** to play a pivotal role in shaping our commercial performance across Iberia.

This is an exciting opportunity to combine Revenue Growth Management (RGM), strategic pricing, business forecasting, and people leadership in a role with significant cross-functional exposure and influence.

Reporting to the Head of Insights & Intelligence Iberia, you'll lead a team of two professionals and work closely with Finance, Marketing, Sales and our global RGM community to drive data-led commercial decisions.

Type of contract: **Fixed-term contract, maternity leave coverage.**

Location: **Madrid, Hybrid work setup**

**Principal Accountabilities**

* **Lead forecasting and business planning** for the Spanish combustibles market, driving accurate market projections, scenario planning, and identification of risks and opportunities.
* **Develop and execute** **SKU-level pricing initiatives** to optimize market share, identify growth opportunities, and assess pricing elasticity.
* **Drive the Revenue Growth Management (RGM) agenda** across Iberia, developing the RGM roadmap, tracking key performance indicators and implementing strategic initiatives.
* **Translate market intelligence into actionable insights**, monitoring market size, competitive dynamics, market share evolution and portfolio performance to support commercial decisions.
* **Partner with key stakeholders** across Finance, Marketing, Sales and the global RGM Center of Expertise to align commercial strategies and maximize business performance.
* **Lead, coach and develop a team of two professionals**, fostering analytical excellence, strategic thinking and effective execution of business priorities.
  

**Skills and Experience Required**

* Relevant professional experience in Revenue Growth Management, Business Analysis, Commercial Planning, Performance Analysis, or similar analytical and strategic roles.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to interpret complex data, identify business opportunities, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
* Excellent commercial acumen, with an understanding of pricing strategies, market dynamics, forecasting, and business performance drivers.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, ideally including Think-Cell, combined with knowledge of business intelligence tools such as Power BI or MicroStrategy.
* Proven leadership and stakeholder management capabilities, with strong communication, collaboration, and influencing skills across cross-functional teams.
* High-level written and spoken English.

  

**What We Offer**

In return for playing your part in building our future, you will receive a comprehensive compensation package with salary, bonus scheme and further benefits as well inspiring places to work and collaborate with purpose. Here at Imperial we will give you the opportunity to grow and learn, innovate at pace and be a part of our purpose to forge a path to a healthier future for moments of relaxation and pleasure for our consumers.

**Everyone Belongs**

Everyone belongs in Imperial. We are proud of being a truly inclusive organisation. We encourage and welcome applications from people of all ages, genders, ethnicities, nationalities, disabilities, sexual orientation, religions or beliefs and of neuro divergence. We give fair and equal consideration to all our applicants. Please contact us at recruitment@impbrands.com to let us know if we can provide support in helping you complete an application and/or attend an interview.

We're a truly international company, fourth largest in our industry and operating across 120 markets. An inclusive, innovative global FMCG business supported by 25,000 employees. As we embrace a new era of growth, we are transforming. Our ways of working and culture are driven by a challenger mindset, constantly questioning the status quo where people can bring their best selves to work. Our agility and collaboration are driving our ambitions, innovation and success all supported by our award-winning development programmes that creates exciting and rewarding career opportunities for all. Encouraging inclusion at local levels and supporting a developing and robust diversity agenda globally, we’re fully committed to creating and maintaining an environment that celebrates and respects difference.

**Role highlights:**

* Department: Global Supply Chain
* Reports to: Global Director Supply Chain
* Employment type: Permanent
* Workplace model: Hybrid
* Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

**Why this role matters - The mission**
---------------------------------------

We are seeking a strategic, commercially and legally strong Director, Supply Chain Strategy to shape how ICEYE secures, de-risks and scales the supply base behind the world's largest multisensor satellite constellation.

You will own ICEYE's global supply chain strategy: how we assess and manage supplier risk, which suppliers we develop as long-term partners, and where we vertically integrate through partnerships, licensing, joint ventures or acquisitions. You will also define and own our supplier portal landscape, the digital backbone of how we collaborate with suppliers. Finally, you will own how ICEYE meets local content requirements, supporting our local entities as they select and onboard in-country suppliers.

This role is for a leader who moves comfortably between the boardroom and the engineering bench: credible with executives, investors and partners, and equally credible with electrical, mechanical, manufacturing and supplier engineers.

**Who we are**
--------------

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defense and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

**Your day-to-day responsibilities**

### **1. Global supply chain strategy**

* Define and own ICEYE's global supply chain strategy, aligned with company, program and production roadmaps, and translate it into a multi-year plan with clear priorities, targets and KPIs.
* Establish and run a structured supplier risk assessment framework covering financial health, capacity, single and sole sourcing, geopolitical and export control exposure, security and compliance.
* Build and maintain a supplier risk heat-map across all critical commodities and suppliers, and use it to drive mitigation plans, dual sourcing and inventory strategies.
* Own supplier due diligence for new and strategic suppliers, including ownership and security screening, ESG and compliance checks, in close cooperation with Legal, Security and Quality.
* Lead supplier development programs that lift capability, quality and capacity of strategic suppliers, and grow a resilient, sovereign-capable supply base for defense and dual-use customers.

### **2. Strategic partnerships & ventures**

* Identify, evaluate and execute vertical integration opportunities where owning or controlling critical technologies, processes or capacity creates strategic advantage.
* Support the negotiation of long-term and strategic supply agreements, including pricing, capacity reservation, IP, liability, security and exit terms.
* Structure and negotiate license agreements and joint venture agreements with industrial and technology partners.
* Act as the M&A lead in the vertical integration domain: build the target pipeline, lead technical and operational due diligence, shape business cases and drive post-merger integration of acquired capabilities into the supply chain.
* Work closely with Corporate Development, Finance and Legal, and present recommendations to the executive team and board.

### **3. Supplier portals**

* Define and own ICEYE's supplier portal strategy, roadmap and architecture.
* Lead the selection, implementation and continuous improvement of supplier portals for onboarding, qualification, forecasting, order collaboration, document exchange and performance scorecards.
* Ensure portals integrate with ERP and PLM, and meet ICEYE's information security and export control requirements.
* Drive supplier adoption and use portal data to improve visibility, risk monitoring and decision making.

### **4. Local content & local supply**

* Own ICEYE's approach to local content, industrial participation and offset requirements in customer programs and sovereign missions.

* Build, lead and develop a team of supply chain strategy, strategic sourcing and supplier management professionals, including managers.
* Define the operating model, workflows and governance for strategic sourcing and supply continuity across electronics, mechanical, electromechanical and specialty process categories.
* Develop hiring profiles, succession plans and long-term talent strategies to scale the organization.
* Foster a culture of urgency, technical rigor, proactive risk management and high accountability.

* Partner with the Supply Chain Category Managers, who own category strategies and day-to-day supply continuity for serial production, and ensure the supply chain strategy actively supports their goals.

* Translate evolving technical and business requirements into executable supply chain strategies across electronics, mechanical and system-level builds.
* Communicate risks, mitigation plans and critical dependencies proactively to leadership and program teams.

As part of the Omnicom Agencies Group, the 14 Agency network handles all global advertising for CUPRA and SEAT car brands. With offices in 11 countries and counting, 14 is a place for those who like to bend the rules. It's a place for rock'n'roll. At the heart of Barcelona, and beyond.

We are looking for a Social Media Strategist to join the CUPRA Global Social Strategy team. Someone with an insatiable curiosity about digital culture, platforms, and communities, and the ability to translate all of that into strategy.

Someone who experiences the internet beyond their feed; who understands the lore, knows what's behind the screenmaxing, and recognizes when something is "that's so AI." Someone who scrolls with curiosity, knows how to separate the noise from the signals that matter, and connects what's happening online with what's happening in the real world.

Your challenge will be to transform this constant reading of culture into strategic opportunities for CUPRA. Because knowing what's happening online is good; understanding what it means for the brand and what to do with it is what makes the difference.

**Responsibilities**

***1. Social Media Strategy***

Develop social strategies aligned with CUPRA's positioning and objectives.

Define opportunities, territories, and strategic approaches to build a relevant and distinctive social presence.

Translate brand and business challenges into actionable strategies, briefs, and recommendations.

Contribute to evolving the role of social media within CUPRA's global strategy.

***2. Cultural & Audience Intelligence***

Identify cultural shifts, behaviors, communities, and conversations relevant to the brand.

Analyze platforms and audiences to understand what motivates them, how they engage, and what they expect from brands.

Transform cultural and social insights into strategic perspectives and opportunities for CUPRA.

Distinguish between a trend that deserves attention and an opportunity that warrants a brand response.

***3. Strategic Development & Measurement***

Develop strategic frameworks and criteria to guide social media decisions.

Work with Social Creative, Content Planning, and Data to connect strategy, ideas, and results.

Evaluate the contribution of social media initiatives to brand objectives, incorporating lessons learned into future strategies.

Present and defend strategic recommendations to teams and stakeholders.

***Profile we are looking for:***

Experience in Social Media Strategy, Digital Strategy, or brand and communications strategy.

Solid knowledge of the main social media platforms and their codes.

Curiosity about contemporary culture, communities, entertainment, and audience behavior.

Ability to transform information into insights and insights into a clear strategic direction.

Critical thinking, independent judgment, and the ability to construct and defend a point of view.

Ability to connect brand, business, culture, and social media without resorting to generic approaches.

Good communication and presentation skills, autonomy, and the ability to work in a team.

Advanced English; experience with global brands is a plus.

Demonstrable experience understanding social media and internet culture.

**In short**: someone who not only understands what's happening on social media, but also what it means for CUPRA and what the brand should do about it.

description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you're a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we'd love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

**FX Senior Product Manager - Hedging conversion**

**Ebury Madrid Office - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week**

As Ebury scales globally, we are evolving from a delivery-led organisation into a **platform-led product** company - building shared foundations that allow teams to move faster, operate safely in regulated environments and deliver high-quality client experiences across channel

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to own one number: the share of Ebury's clients who convert into hedgers — and to build the journeys, workflows and decision tools that get them there.

Ebury has a real hedging business. Thousands of clients already hedge with us, they're our most valuable and stickiest, and Hedge works. The problem isn't proof of concept — it's rate. For every client who converts, several more carry the same currency exposure, would benefit from the same forward, and never get there.

Here's the honest reason why. Hedging isn't a product you sell; it's a conclusion a client reaches once they can see what their international business is actually exposed to. Today that seeing happens in a CPM's head and a spreadsheet, one client at a time. The client can't see their own exposure clearly, the CPM can't see it at scale, and so the conversation that should be obvious either happens late or never happens at all.

This role builds the layer that changes that: guided journeys and lifecycle workflows that carry a client from unaware exposure to a first hedge to a standing policy — and the decision tools that let both the client and their CPM understand the client's international business well enough to make the right call, not just the next call.

You'll sit at the intersection of product, data, and commercial, working closely with:

* CPMs and Sales teams who convert clients today
* Data and Analytics
* Design and Engineering
* Compliance and Risk
* Clients directly

**What you'll do**

You will own the end-to-end conversion journey into hedging, backed by a dedicated squad of developers, including:

**Journeys & Lifecycle Workflows**

* The path from spot client Hedge-active policy client, and every drop-off point along it
* Guided, staged journeys rather than one-off prompts: the right message, to the right client, at the moment their exposure is real to them
* Triggered workflows off real events, a new currency pair, a large invoice, a rate move against them, a forward maturing
* Understanding what separates the clients who convert from the ones who don't, and building for the difference

**Decision Tools for Clients**

* Showing a client what their international business is actually exposed to, in their own numbers and their own currencies
* Exposure views, scenario and impact modelling, MTM and forward comparisons a finance lead can act on without training
* Turning "should I hedge?" into a question the client can answer for themselves, with confidence
* Balancing honesty about risk against simplicity of decision, the goal is a well-made decision, not a sold one

**Tooling for CPMs**

* Giving CPMs a portfolio-level view of client exposure, trades and performance, so they know who to talk to and what to say before the client asks
* Surfacing the signals that make a conversation timely: unhedged exposure, changing trade patterns, policy lapses
* Learning from the conversations that already convert clients, and productising them

**Repeat Hedging & Policy**

* Turning a first hedge into a second and a third
* Moving clients from ad-hoc trades onto a standing hedging policy they run every month
* Statements, notifications and review moments that build the habit and prove the value after the fact

**Experimentation & Measurement**

* A cadence of A/B tests across the journey, not a feature backlog
* Reading results honestly, including the ones that kill your own ideas
* Building the measurement so conversion, and what's driving it

**What success looks like (12-18 months)**

* Spot-to-hedger conversion rate is measurably higher, and you can attribute the lift
* A meaningful share of new hedgers convert through product journeys rather than a CPM conversation
* CPMs work from exposure signals in a tool instead of instinct and spreadsheets, and cover more clients as a result
* Clients can articulate their own FX exposure — and clients who hedge once come back without being called
* More hedgers move onto hedging policies rather than trading ad hoc
* Product — not people — becomes the primary driver of hedging conversion

**What makes this role hard**

* You're changing behaviour, not shipping features. The instrument already exists and works; the reason more clients don't use it is understanding, trust and habit.
* It's a two-sided problem. Clients and CPMs need different views of the same truth, and building for one badly makes the other worse but the CPMs must know what the client can see to have consultative conversations
* The baseline isn't zero. There's an existing business and an existing way of converting clients, you have to improve on it without disrupting it.
* Exposure is genuinely hard to model. Client data is incomplete, trade history is a proxy for intent, and being confidently wrong about someone's exposure destroys trust instantly.
* You're helping non-experts make decisions with real financial consequences. Oversimplify and you mislead; don't simplify and nobody acts.
* You'll navigate real-world complexity: regional and regulatory nuance, credit and margin implications, and client segments with genuinely different needs.

**Who we are looking for**

Prior FX or hedging experience is a plus, not a requirement. We're looking for someone who can move a hard conversion number in a complex, regulated environment — with strong agency, sharp analytical instincts, and a real feel for why people do and don't act.

**Must-have:**

* 4+ years of product management experience, including at least one role owning conversion, adoption or engagement outcomes end-to-end
* Strong analytics and experimentation skills — funnel analysis, cohort and retention analysis, designing and interpreting A/B tests
* Experience designing lifecycle journeys or triggered workflows, and the messaging that carries them
* Fluent English (daily collaboration with global commercial, tech and Legal/Compliance/Risk stakeholders)

**Nice-to-have:**

* Familiarity with foreign exchange, hedging or other asset classes
* Experience in fintech or regulated financial products
* Experience building internal or advisor-facing tooling alongside client-facing product
* Localisation awareness

**Core Capabilities**

* **Strong Product Fundamentals** — breaks down ambiguous problems into clear product opportunities; comfortable working across UX, data and operations; focused on outcomes, not just delivery.
* **Funnel & Journey Thinking** — instinctively looks for where clients fall out and why; designs staged journeys rather than isolated features; sizes the opportunity before designing the fix.
* **Two-Sided Design** — builds for clients and the internal teams serving them at once; understands the trade-offs between automation and human judgement.
* **Behavioural Instinct** — thinks in triggers, incentives and habit loops; understands that conversion is earned, not shipped.
* **Analytical Depth** — partners with Data rather than outsourcing the thinking; can build the exposure and funnel view themselves and defend it.
* **Commercial Awareness** — understands how product decisions land in revenue and margin; prioritises on business impact, not just user feedback.
* **High Agency & Pragmatism** — comfortable operating in under-defined environments; bias to action; doesn't wait for perfect structure.
* **Deep Customer Curiosity** — regularly speaks to clients and CPMs; uses it to inform decisions, not just validate them.

**Why Ebury?**

* **Competitive Starting Salary** with an **annual discretionary bonus**that truly rewards your performance from day one.
* **Dedicated Mentorship:** Learn directly from experienced managers who are invested in your success.
* **Cutting-Edge Technology:** Leverage state-of-the-art tailor made tools and systems that enable you to perform at your best.

* **Dynamic & Supportive Culture:** Work in a collaborative environment where teamwork and personal growth are prioritized.

* **Central** **Madrid** **Office: A fantastic location with excellent transport links.**

This is a **fixed-term appointment** with an initial duration of 4 years. Depending upon performance and organisational needs, the appointment may be extended up to a possible maximum duration of 8 years.

  

**Location**
  
ESTEC, Noordwijk, Netherlands with a resident assignment to ESAC, Villanueva de la Cañada, Spain.

**Description**
---------------

The Directorate of Human and Robotic Exploration Programmes (D/HRE) is a programme directorate within the ESA matrix structure. Through a partnership between humans and robots, D/HRE is dedicated to exploring destinations in space where humans are already living and working —– or will live and work in the future —– for the purpose of scientific research, economic development, international cooperation and public inspiration.

The Science Operations Department (SCI-S), within ESA’s Directorate of Science (D/SCI), hosts the scientists and engineers who oversee the space missions from study to the end of operations, develops the science operation systems for the missions and operates the missions in space, and archives and curates their data during operations and beyond. The Department provides support to D/HRE in the curation, archiving and dissemination of data from its planetary missions, such as the Rosalind Franklin Mission (RFM) and other Mars or lunar experiments. Its main objective is to maximise the scientific output of the missions for the benefit of humankind.

You will be assigned as Archive Scientist for ESA planetary missions under the direct responsibility of the Chief Exploration Scientist reporting functionally to the Head of the Science Archives Development and Operations Section, also known as the ESAC Science Data Centre (ESDC) in the Data Science and Archives Division within the Science Operations Department (SCI-S).

You will have further functional reporting lines within the mission(s) you support, initially the ESA ExoMars RFM and Comet Interceptor.

**Duties**
----------

You will be responsible for the definition and specification of the scientific archive for the supported ESA planetary missions, initially the ESA ExoMars RFM and Comet Interceptor, and for the follow-up and monitoring of its implementation and operation with the goal of maximising the scientific return of the missions. You will work in close collaboration with the planetary mission project scientists, the other mission archive scientists, the ESDC Software and Data Systems Architect and the members of the Planetary Science Archive User Group.

  

As Archive Scientist, your specific responsibilities will include:

  

* ownership of use cases and drivers for the mission archives, including:
  + interfacing with the Project Scientist, the Science Operations Centre (SOC) team, other archive science leads and other archive scientists, as well as the external stakeholders, such as the instrument teams and the mission scientific community, to provide the science use cases that drive the mission archive and determine the priorities for implementation;
  + providing scientific support and steering the development and operations of the archives for the supported ESA planetary missions, providing the ESDC development team with an archive user requirements document as a baseline for implementation;
* chairing and coordinating a mission-level Data Archive Working Group (DAWG);
* monitoring the implementation, testing and expected performance of the archive based on use cases gathered by the mission team and derived requirements; in particular, defining and performing the end user acceptance testing of the different archive versions prior to their release to the scientific community;
* with the help of the instrument operations scientists, supervising and coordinating the definition and provision of science data products and any higher-level data products from the community or instrument teams as needed, including liaising on submission schedules and content;
* liaising with any internal and external providers to ensure the completeness of all levels of data products with maximum science quality, contributing to the optimisation and refinement of the archive products when possible;
* encouraging and contributing to the science exploitation of the missions’ data products through archive usage;
* participating in archive scientist meetings and user groups and sharing ideas and proposals for the strategy and promotion of the ESA science archives;
* supporting the scientific community with archive- and data product-related matters.
  

As a scientist in the Department, you will be required to actively pursue personal scientific research, publishing articles using archival data, and to actively participate in the Department’s research activities.

**Technical competencies**
--------------------------

Experience in science data management and archiving systems

Experience working with planetary science data in a research setting, preferably including data from surface/in situ planetary missions

Experience in coordinating the scientific community and managing multiple interfaces at international level within a large multidisciplinary team.

Experience in science operations, preferably in the context of ESA missions

**Behavioural competencies**
----------------------------

Result Orientation
  
Operational Efficiency
  
Fostering Cooperation
  
Relationship Management
  
Continuous Improvement
  
Forward Thinking

**Education and professional experience**
-----------------------------------------

A PhD in a relevant domain is required for this post, together with one year of relevant professional experience.

**Additional requirements**
---------------------------

The following are assets for this position:

  

* Experience in promoting science to the wider scientific community and general public;
* Understanding of user needs in relation to complex software systems;
* Experience in science operations, preferably in the context of ESA missions;
* Experience in agile and DevOps methodologies, human factor engineering (UX design) and associated technologies and their use in modern software engineering.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusiveness**
  
ESA is an equal opportunity employer, committed to achieving diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. We therefore welcome applications from all qualified candidates irrespective of gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religious beliefs, age, disability or other characteristics.

At the Agency we value diversity, and we welcome people with disabilities. Whenever possible, we seek to accommodate individuals with disabilities by providing the necessary support at the workplace. The Human Resources Department can also provide assistance during the recruitment process. If you would like to discuss this further, please contact us via email at contact.human.resources@esa.int.

  

**Important Information and Disclaimer**
  
In principle, recruitment will be within the advertised grade band (A2-A4). However, if the selected candidate has less than four years of relevant professional experience following the completion of the master’s degree, the position may be filled at A1 level.

Applicants must be eligible to access information, technology, and hardware which is subject to European or US export control and sanctions regulations.

During the recruitment process, the Agency may request applicants to undergo selection tests. Additionally, successful candidates will need to undergo basic screening before appointment, which will be conducted by an external background screening service, in compliance with the European Space Agency's security procedures.

Note that ESA is in the process of transitioning to a Matrix setup, which could lead to organisational changes affecting this position.

The information published on ESA’s careers website regarding working conditions is correct at the time of publication. It is not intended to be exhaustive and may not address all questions you would have.

  

**Nationality and Languages**
  
Please note that applications are only considered from nationals of one of the following States: Austria, Belgium, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, the United Kingdom and Canada, Cyprus, Latvia, Lithuania and Slovakia.

According to the ESA Convention, staff shall be recruited on the basis of their qualifications, taking into account an adequate distribution of posts among nationals of the Member States.

The working languages of the Agency are English and French. A good knowledge of one of these is required. Knowledge of another Member State language would be an asset.

**Fuera del área del CTO**

* Dominios de producto. Son el principal interlocutor. Aplican la metodología en sus proyectos, sean internos o externalizados, y la exigen a sus proveedores. Software Delivery les da un proceso claro y les acompaña en su adopción.

* Arquitectura y UX. Definen sus estándares; Software Delivery garantiza que intervienen en cada proyecto mediante puntos de control obligatorios.
