title: Head of Information Security Architecture (m/f/d)
description:
We are expanding our Corporate Information Security Team and look forward to welcoming new colleagues and leaders. We are looking for a **Head of Information Security Architecture** **(m/f/d)** .

Reporting to the Global CISO, you will define how security is embedded across Liebherr’s IT, OT, cloud, data, digital products and emerging technology landscape. You will own the information security architecture strategy, target state, principles and governance, translate business risks and regulatory obligations into scalable architectural direction, and drive Security by Design from idea through to operation.

The role leads the Information Security Architecture team and acts as the enterprise-level security architecture authority in close partnership with Enterprise Architecture and all Corporate Information Security domains.

The working location for this position will be in Madrid city where we are currently setting up a new office. We operate a hybrid model, requiring at least 40% of the working time on-site on a weekly basis.

**Creating passion: your responsibilities**
-------------------------------------------

**Principles, standards and reference architectures:**

* Define, maintain and govern information security architecture principles, standards, patterns, reference architectures and reusable blueprints.
* Provide integrated architectural direction across identity and access, cloud, network and Zero Trust, infrastructure, endpoint, data protection, security monitoring, OT and Product Security.
* Contribute to the information security architecture strategy and roadmap, aligning security architecture with business and CIS priorities.
* Define security architecture guardrails for AI and emerging technologies, partnering with key stakeholders to ensure secure-by-design solutions aligned with risk, policy and regulatory requirements.

**Security by Design and architecture governance:**

* Establish and drive Security by Design, embedding proportionate security requirements into initiatives from idea, investment and design through implementation and operation.
* Establish and chair the information security architecture decision, and governance process, including architecture intake, design reviews, decision rights, approval criteria, escalation paths and exception management.
* Design a scalable, risk-based engagement model that supports delivery teams without making Information Security Architecture a bottleneck.

**Risk, regulatory and threat alignment:**

* Translate business risk, cybersecurity risk, regulatory obligations and security policies into architecture principles, patterns and technical control requirements in collaboration with Security GRC and accountable control owners.
* Ensure architecture decisions reflect relevant threats, attack paths, systemic risks and lessons from security operations, incidents, assurance activities and vulnerability exposure.
* Advise senior management on strategic security risks, architectural trade-offs, residual risk and major technology decisions.

**Stakeholder leadership and architecture community:**

* Provide enterprise-level architectural authority and coordination for IT, OT, product engineering, business and Corporate Information Security stakeholders.
* Build strong partnerships with Enterprise Architecture, technology platforms, engineering teams, divisional security functions and relevant governance bodies. Team leadership and performance.
* Lead and manage the Information Security Architecture team, including organizational design, hiring, objectives, performance management, succession and capacity planning.
* Define and report meaningful KPIs and KRIs covering standards adoption, review outcomes, exceptions, technical debt, Security-by-Design effectiveness and target-state maturity.

**Contributing your strengths: your qualifications**
----------------------------------------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Proven ability to establish Security by Design, architecture governance, standards and target-state architectures.
* Strong leadership and ability to translate business, risk and regulatory requirements into clear architecture decisions and guardrails.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture and security architecture frameworks such as TOGAF and SABSA, and security standards such as NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001 and IEC 62443.
* Professional fluency in English is required; German language skills are an advantage.
* Willingness to travel internationally (up to 30%) as required by project work.

Preferred certifications Relevant certifications are advantageous, for example: CISSP, CISM, SABSA, TOGAF, ITIL, COBIT, and cloud or technology-specific architecture certifications across Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.

**Our commitment to you: your benefits**
----------------------------------------

At Liebherr, we believe people are at the heart of our success. As part of our international team, you’ll enjoy a secure role in a family-owned company that values innovation, collaboration, and long-term career growth:

  

* Competitive compensation and benefits package that recognizes your expertise
* Flexible and hybrid working model
* Creative freedom and responsibility to shape processes and solutions in our global transformation
* Continuous learning and development with tailored training and certification opportunities
* Meal vouchers
* Life and accident insurance
* Option to include a premium private health insurance package as part of the flexible remuneration
* A safe, stable and international workplace within a trusted family business that invests in people

Please note that we can only accept applications submitted through our website, using the online application form.

Please note that we do not accept applications via recruitment agencies for this position.

Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Marija Kostadinovic.

title: Lead Motion & Graphic Designer
description:
**TripleTen**
is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.
  
  
As a Lead Motion & Graphic Designer in the Curriculum team, you’ll turn complex tech concepts into clear visual and interactive learning experiences, and lead the team that makes them. About 80% of your time goes to hands-on design, motion, video, and interactive work; the other 20% to team leadership. Curriculum visuals help students understand and remember a concept, so we favor clarity, calm pacing, and accurate diagrams over flashy effects.
  
  
What you will do:
  
  

* Design learning visuals. Create graphics, animations, motion pieces, and explainer videos with Learning Experience Designers, from concept and storyboard to final edit.
* Set the quality bar. Own visual and motion standards for curriculum content: guidelines, templates, and reusable asset libraries.
* Lead the team. Run critiques, weekly planning, and retros; mentor designers with regular, actionable feedback; improve intake, reviews, and handoffs.
* Speed up production. Partner with product, design, and engineering on shared libraries, AI-assisted workflows, and automation of repetitive work.
* Prototype interactive formats. Design clickable diagrams, simple simulations, and step-by-step visual explainers for our learning platform.
* Finish video. Edit and enhance video content, adding simple visual effects and sound design.
* Experiment with new formats. Test new video and interactive formats, using Claude Design and Claude Code to prototype faster.

Requirements:
  
  
**Must have**

* 4+ years in motion and graphic design. A portfolio showing motion, graphic design, and visual storytelling, built in After Effects, Premiere Pro, and Figma.
* Design leadership. Experience leading or mentoring designers, or owning design standards and processes for a team.
* English at B2 or higher. Confident written and spoken English for daily work in a remote, cross-functional team.

**Nice to have**

* Interactive and UX work. Interactive pieces in your portfolio, and a grasp of how people read, scan, and interact with learning materials.
* AI creative tools. Hands-on use of Claude Design, Claude Code, or AI agents in Figma to prototype.
* Ed-tech and languages. Experience in ed-tech, e-learning, or instructional design; Spanish or Portuguese.

What we can offer you:
  
  

* Ownership. Real decision-making power in your area: we trust your expertise and don’t micromanage.
* Remote and flexible. Fully remote collaboration.
* Digital office. Slack, Notion, Miro, and Zoom, with every license you need.

**Conteúdo, Comunicação e Marca**

title: Associate Director - Marketing and Communications
description:
**Please note all applications will be through our job platform Applied, not directly through Indeed this is for advertisement purposes.**

https://app.beapplied.com/apply/b0wdupztoc

Job description

**MAIN PURPOSE**

The Associate Director - Marketing & Communications is responsible for providing leadership & strategic direction for BUCS’ marketing & communications in line with our strategic objectives. As a member of the Senior Leadership Team, the Associate Director - Marketing & Communications will contribute to the collective leadership & strategic development of BUCS, whilst retaining specific delegated responsibility for the organisation’s marketing & communications agenda.

As a leader in an ambitious & transforming organisation, the Associate Director - Marketing & Communications will be responsible for shaping & driving a contemporary marketing & communications approach that increases the profile, reach & reputation of BUCS, supports organisational strategy outcomes & strengthens the value we provide to students, member institutions & partners.

The Associate Director - Marketing & Communications will use professional marketing expertise to build commercial potential & support the effective servicing of commercial partners, whilst ensuring that the marketing & communications needs of members remain central to BUCS’ approach. This will include developing creative & effective approaches to marketing with & to students, supporting increased entries to BUCS sport events & programmes & delegates at member events, increasing BUCS’ profile in sport & in Higher Education, & ensuring that BUCS’ broadcast profile supports organisational strategy outcomes.

Reporting to the CEO, the Associate Director - Marketing & Communications will provide strategic leadership for the effective development & delivery of BUCS’ activity in this area, ensuring that content, campaigns, channels & platforms are aligned to organisational priorities & the needs of our audiences.

The Associate Director - Marketing & Communications will work closely with the Senior Leadership Team, Management Team, members, participants, partners & wider stakeholders to ensure that BUCS’ marketing & communications activity is creative, contemporary, inclusive & impactful.

**MAIN DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Provide strategic leadership to BUCS’ marketing & communications functions, ensuring activity is innovative, contemporary, dynamic & aligned to organisational strategy.
* Develop & deliver a strategic marketing & communications programme that increases the reach, reputation & influence of BUCS across higher education, sport & wider stakeholder audiences, whilst creating value for members, participants & partners.
* Work as a member of the Senior Leadership Team, contributing to collective organisational leadership, strategic decision-making & the delivery of BUCS’ wider strategic priorities, with appropriate budget management & responsibilities.
* Develop creative & contemporary approaches to marketing with & to students, using insight to increase engagement, support entries to BUCS sport events & generate excitement & momentum with students for BUCS sporting offer & partner activations.
* Lead high-quality corporate & member communications, ensuring BUCS’ voice is active on key issues & milestones & that members receive the information they need & drive attendance at member events.
* Drive respectful & fruitful member relationships, securing member & participant voice & ensuring marketing, communications & content reflect the diverse range of students & members we serve, including developing BUCS’ platforming of students as authentic voices & creators.
* Work collaboratively with the Director of Sport & relevant colleagues to promote the BUCS sport portfolio & maximise opportunities through events, broadcast, storytelling & social media.
* Ensure that BUCS’ broadcast & content profile supports organisational strategy outcomes, using key moments in the BUCS programme to extend reach, reputation & impact.
* Use research, insight & performance data to inform marketing & communications activity, evaluate impact & support key messaging, audience development, partner reporting & the BUCS annual Impact Report.
* Lead the evolution, development & application of BUCS’ brand & visual identity, ensuring consistently high standards of graphic design & creative presentation organisation wide.
* Work with commercial colleagues to use marketing expertise to build BUCS’ commercial potential, develop effective propositions & provide high-quality marketing & communications support to commercial partners & contributing to commercial stakeholder engagement.
* Support the effective design, development & use of BUCS’ digital platforms & tools, maximising their contribution to marketing, communications & audience engagement.
* Optimise marketing & communications policies, systems & processes, overseeing relevant suppliers & resources & providing effective management information to support decision-making.

**STAFF**

* Ensure that BUCS has an exceptional staffing experience within the marketing & communications function by establishing cultural & management practices that enable staff to thrive.
* Drive an organisational culture within the marketing & communications function that is founded on the BUCS values of respectfulness, inclusiveness, dynamism & innovation, measuring the impact of this with colleagues & stakeholders, including the Head of Belonging.
* Lead the development of initiatives that encourage creativity, collaboration & open communication, building confidence & trust as a platform for exceptional organisational performance.
* Lead the professional development of colleagues in the team, ensuring access to appropriate training, development & professional support that enables staff & the organisation to thrive.
* Design, deliver training & support, monitor & evaluate relevant staff performance review processes ensuring that they drive a transparent, fair & equitable basis for the assessment of staff performance, enabling BUCS & its people to thrive, driving personal & organisational success.
* Provide support to colleagues as required, including one-to-one, mentoring & access to specialists.
* Ensure that team members understand the strategic priorities of BUCS & can translate these into creative, effective & measurable activity.
* Support a culture in which staff are encouraged to innovate, test new approaches, learn from activity & respond dynamically to changing audience & organisational needs.

**OTHER**

* Actively role model the BUCS values & integrate these into our policies & practices.
* Contribute as a member of the Senior Leadership Team to the collective leadership, strategic development & organisational performance of BUCS.
* Promote the organisation externally & represent the BUCS brand with the highest of standards.
* Act as a senior advocate for the role of marketing & communications in delivering participant value, member value & organisational health.
* Act on any other reasonable request of the CEO or Board.

**PERSON SPECIFICATION**

BUCS is a Disability Confident Committed & Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity & are committed to fostering an inclusive & supportive work environment. We make all employment decisions without regard to age, national origin, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, gender, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Research shows that some people don’t apply for a role if they feel they do not meet 100% of the person specification. We encourage you to apply for this role if you feel you meet the key skills & knowledge listed below, even if you feel you do not have all of them. We are passionate about identifying the right people to help us develop & thrive.

**Essential knowledge or experience**

* Senior experience with a proven ability to lead, develop & motivate others to fulfil their potential.
* Significant professional experience, with a strong understanding of current & emerging marketing practice, audience engagement & communications channels to develop & deliver marketing & communications strategies that contribute to organisational objectives.
* Development of creative & effective marketing approaches that engage students with BUCS’ offer.
* Development of high-quality corporate communications programmes that build organisational profile, reputation & influence.
* Experience of developing targeted communications for members, customers & other defined audiences.
* Marketing-led support of commercial development, partner value & the creation of new opportunities, understanding the sensitivities of working in a membership organisation & with corporate partners.
* Development of holistic change programmes that drive transformation through professional development, resources & support tools.
* Leading high-level projects with significant dependencies & applying relevant risk & assurance protocols, working strategically with senior leaders & governance structures to influence organisational development & decision-making.
* Use of audience insight, data & performance measures to develop & evaluate marketing & communications activity.
* Understanding of operational & project planning protocols & knowledge of how to monitor & evaluate impact of workstreams aligned to organisational metrics.
* Understanding of the role of digital platforms, channels & user experience in high performing digital content, social media, written content, broadcast, livestream &/or PR & communications.

**Essential skills & abilities**

* Ability to work on own initiative& provide strategic leadership across a complex organisation.
* Strong team player with good interpersonal abilities including an ability & willingness to communicate & develop trusted relationships with a range of stakeholders.
* Effective mentor, motivator, manager & influencer of people.
* Ability to influence & provide strategic advice to senior leaders, building confidence & trust through effective communication & evidence-based decision-making.
* Excellent organisational & planning skills.
* Ability to manage a complex workload including competing priorities, achieve targets & respond quickly & flexibly to changing needs & demands.
* Conscientious with high standards & a commitment to excellence.
* Tenacious when it comes to problem-solving / acquiring key information.
* Ability to think strategically, identify opportunities & risks, & translate organisational priorities into practical & deliverable action.
* Ability to operate effectively as part of a Senior Leadership Team, contributing constructively to collective decision-making & organisational performance.
* Ability to develop creative, innovative & audience-focused approaches to marketing & communications, based on audience insight & performance information to inform strategic decision-making.
* Ability to communicate complex or sensitive information clearly & appropriately to different audiences.

**Desirable knowledge or experience**

* Experience of working in the higher education &/or sport sectors, &/or a membership organisation.
* Knowledge of the BUCS history, purpose & ethos working with members, participants & partners.
* Knowledge of the key strategy & operational opportunities in the calendar for BUCS to target key communications that develop the presence of the brand in the higher education & sport sectors.
* Experience of using marketing to support commercial partnerships, sponsorships, events or other income-generating opportunities.
* Development of student-focused &/or student led marketing campaigns or initiatives.
* Working with broadcast, livestream or sports media to drive profile, reach & engagement.
* Supporting the development or effective use of digital platforms & systems for marketing, communications or audience engagement.
* Development of approaches that improve engagement, reputation & organisational performance.
* Knowledge of data protection, privacy & the ethical use of data within marketing & communications.

**Desirable skills & abilities**

* Ability to innovate, be creative & work dynamically.
* Ability to build effective relationships & influence across different levels of an organisation.
* Ability to balance strategic priorities with operational requirements & respond effectively to changing organisational needs.
* Identification & maximisation of opportunities to increase audience engagement, participation, profile & partner value.
* Effective communication across a range of channels & formats, adapting approach to different audiences.

**Working at BUCS**

BUCS prides itself on being an ambitious and challenging place to work, where staff enjoy work, embrace development opportunities, and have fun.

Benefits include:

* Generous Pension Scheme
* Paid Health Care Plan
* Tax-free - Cycle to work scheme
* Christmas Closure
* Volunteering Day leave
* Flexible - hybrid working
* Wellbeing and Social activities
* Company-supported Learning and Development opportunities

**How to Apply**

Please apply via https://app.beapplied.com/apply/b0wdupztoc.

Should you have any questions about the role, please contact **Will Roberts, CEO – will.roberts@bucs.org.uk**

**Application deadline:**

11:59pm, 19th Nov 2026 GMT

**Interview Information:**

If successful candidate will be called to interview on the provisional dates of **1, 3 and 4 December 2026.**

Candidates who successfully advance to the interview stage will receive further information about logistics and tasks via email. Some candidates may process to a second interview, which will be communicated accordingly. If any reasonable adjustments are required, please communicate them when accepting the interview offer.

Due to the expected high number of applications, it is likely we will only be able to provide feedback to those who reach the interview stage. If you don’t hear from us within two weeks of the closing date, please assume that, unfortunately, your application has not been successful.

Applicants should have the right to work in the UK and will be asked to provide proof of their eligibility to work in the UK before employment is confirmed.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: Up to £64,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Company events
* Company pension
* Sick pay
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in London SE1 0QX

### **Description**

Zappi is looking for a senior advertising effectiveness and creative development expert to help strengthen our authority, differentiation, and commercial success in the advertising research and creative effectiveness space.

This person will serve as both:

* A trusted expert, educator, and industry advocate externally
* A strategic, cross-functional SME and connective layer internally

We are looking for an experienced advertising and marketing professional with a strong understanding of creative development and advertising program building. The ideal candidate will bring a marketing-led perspective, with experience working in/with brands, agencies or advertising platforms, and understand how data and technology can be leveraged to inform better advertising decisions.
  
  
*While an understanding of consumer insights and advertising effectiveness is valuable, this is not primarily an insights or research methodology role.*

You should be credible with senior Marketing, Brand, Media, Creative, Commercial, Strategy and Insights leaders, and able to connect a practical understanding of advertising with a modern, scalable approach to advertising research and creative effectiveness.

### **What you'll do:**

  

**Build external credibility**

**Influence product and strategy**

**What success looks like**

### **What we’re looking for:**

  

* 10+ years of experience in advertising, marketing, creative development, brand strategy, campaign strategy or advertising effectiveness, ideally gained within an agency, advertising platform, ad tech business or in-house brand or marketing team.
* A strong understanding of how advertising is developed and how creative development and advertising programmes support broader marketing objectives.

title: Director, Global Brand and Communications
description:
**Reapit – Who are we?**

Reapit is the original, end-to-end business technology provider for estate agencies of all sizes. We’ve been helping sales and lettings agents to build relationships and grow their businesses for more than 25 years. Our technology connects property professionals in Europe, the Middle East, Australia, and New Zealand with buyers, sellers, tenants and landlords to power the relationships that change lives.

In the United Kingdom and Ireland, Reapit’s market-leading technology product suite provides estate and lettings agents with powerful tools covering sales, lettings, property management, block management, client accounts and analytics, underpinned by a robust, security infrastructure.

**What you’ll be doing**

Reapit is the market leader in estate agency technology. But leadership isn’t something you declare. It’s something the market believes.

We’re looking for a Director, Brand & Communications to shape that belief, strengthening Reapit’s visibility and influence across the industry and ensuring we are at the heart of the conversations shaping its future.

You’ll own how Reapit shows up in the market, from brand and PR to social media, thought leadership, executive communications and compelling storytelling. You’ll build awareness and preference for Reapit, grow our share of voice and position both the company and our leaders as influential voices within the industry.

This is a global role, working closely with our regional marketing teams. While regional teams own customer engagement, local marketing plans and commercial outcomes, you’ll give them the brand, campaigns, content, creative services and communications support they need to increase their impact.

Through our central Brand & Communications function and Global Brand Studio, you’ll build a model that combines strong global brand leadership with effective regional execution.

Success isn’t measured by how much content we produce. It’s measured by the influence Reapit has in the market and the value Brand & Communications creates for our regional teams.

Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, you’ll lead Reapit’s global Brand & Communications function and be responsible for:

* Owning Reapit’s global brand and communications strategy, strengthening our visibility, credibility and influence across the estate agency technology market.

* Leading our PR, media and industry influencer strategy, using compelling storytelling, thought leadership and executive visibility to build trust and market leadership.

* Growing Reapit’s share of voice across earned media, social media, industry channels and relevant communities.

* Developing and delivering brand campaigns and content that position Reapit as an innovation leader in PropTech.

* Leading Reapit’s in-house Global Brand Studio, bringing together design, copywriting and communications capabilities.

* Partnering with Global Demand Generation and regional marketing teams to deliver creative services, campaign assets, PR support and thought leadership programmes.

* Owning our internal communications programme, helping colleagues understand and connect with Reapit’s vision, strategy and culture.

* Building executive communications and speaking programmes that establish Reapit leaders as recognised industry voices.

* Creating a clear operating model for regional support, including prioritisation, intake processes and service standards.

* Defining meaningful measures for brand awareness and influence, share of voice, reputation, internal engagement and the value Brand & Communications delivers to regional teams.

**Who we're looking for**

At Reapit, we prioritise hiring individuals who share our values and possess the right attitudes and behaviours for success. Whilst some of the listed requirements may be important, don’t worry if you don’t meet all of them, we’d still like to hear from you.

* Senior leadership experience across brand, communications, PR, corporate affairs or a closely related discipline.
* Proven success increasing brand awareness, preference and influence in a B2B SaaS, technology or platform business.
* An exceptional creative storyteller who can turn company strategy, customer insight and market trends into compelling narratives.
* Strong expertise across brand campaigns, public relations, social media, thought leadership and executive communications.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary creative, content and communications teams, including an in-house studio or agency model.
* A strong track record of partnering with senior executives, regional marketing teams and external media or industry stakeholders.
* Experience creating global narratives while adapting effectively to regional market nuances, ideally including the UKI and ANZ markets.
* A commercial, outcomes-focused approach, with the ability to define meaningful measures for awareness, share of voice, reputation and internal engagement.
* A degree or equivalent professional experience in Marketing, Advertising, Public Relations, Communications or a related discipline.

**What your impact and success looks like**

As Director, Brand & Communications, we expect your success and impact in the early stages of your career with us to look something like this:

**Within 1 month:**

* Build relationships with the Chief Marketing Officer, regional marketing leaders, executives and the central Brand & Communications team.

* Assess current brand positioning, channel performance, share-of-voice data, internal communications and regional support needs.

* Agree the priority outcomes, baseline measures and immediate opportunities for Brand & Communications.

**Within 3 months:**

* Present a global Brand & Communications strategy and roadmap covering PR, brand campaigns, thought leadership, executive visibility and internal communications.

* Implement a practical measurement framework for share of voice, brand awareness, reputation, executive visibility, internal engagement and regional-team value.

* Establish clear Global Brand Studio ways of working, including regional intake, prioritisation and service standards alongside Demand Generation.

**Within 6 months:**

* Deliver initial brand, PR and thought-leadership programmes that increase Reapit’s visibility in priority markets and industry conversations.

* Demonstrate improved support for regional marketing teams through consistent creative delivery, campaign assets and communications programmes.

* Show measurable progress against the agreed brand, media, reputation and internal communications baselines.

**What’s in it for you?**

We operate a Flexible Working Policy and this role can be based remotely.

We’re offering the chance to really make a difference here at Reapit and the opportunity for personal growth is very real. You’ll feel part of a special team. You can expect a highly competitive salary and some great benefits, including:

* 5.5% employer pension contribution
* 24 days annual leave (plus a day for your birthday) increasing by a day for every year worked
* Business permitting, we’re closed over Christmas and New Year, to give you time back to your friends and family
* Formal and in-house training for your L&D plus access to Go1 – the worlds largest online learning library
* Health benefits via Benenden Health
* Regular local and companywide social events
* Opportunity to participate in retail benefits and savings via our Benefits partner, Zest!

**Don't tick all the boxes? Neither do we**

We care about our industry and want it to become a more inclusive and diverse place to work. So, we’re driven by hiring not only by experience and relevance for the role but by sharing our values and the right attitudes and behaviours for success. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
  
  
The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
  
  
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.
  
  
**About The Role**
Design at Ramp looks very different than it did a year ago: we’re building tools and agents, designing memory, shipping PRs, and rethinking the process every few months as new capabilities unlock. A few things have not changed, the role of design is to distill problems to their essence, obsess over craft and delight where it matters most, know customers deeply and advocate for them, lead with creativity and storytelling, and keep it fun, because a product built with joy always wins.
  
  
We're looking for a Director of Product Design to lead a team of builders across some of our highest-priority bets. This role is for you if you’re excited by:
  
  

* Leading through craft, setting vision and unlocking customer impact: you will define where a product should go, then jump into the details with the team to unblock, teach, and ship. You raise the bar through product judgment, design craft, and your ability to make everyone around you better.

* Building the environment where great work comes from: clear roles, high standards, low ego, and just enough structure to keep the bar high without slowing people down. That means building a caring yet demanding structure, investing deeply in people — coaching, feedback, growth — so designers can do the best work of their careers and develop in this new age of Design.

It’s never been a more interesting time to build.

title: Head of Performance Creative
description:
**Role Objective**
**AtlasBrands is looking for a Head of Performance Creative (Meta) to serve as the "CEO" of our primary acquisition channel.**
Because Meta represents 100% of our customer growth, you will take complete, end-to-end ownership of the channel and leading with an obsessive, direct-response creative strategy while cross-functionally overseeing media buying execution.
  
  
You are a world-class performance creative lead who stays deeply in the trenches, studying market trends and competitor ads to craft high-converting hooks and concepts. Your core objective is to build and scale a pod-based creative department that powers rapid revenue expansion while maintaining strict unit economics, total account stability, and proactive resolution of ad rejections and account risk across high-risk verticals (e.g., supplements). Operating as a strategic player-coach, you will transition current lead oversight, build custom tracking dashboards, and recruit an A-player team that executes with speed and autonomy.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Channel Onboarding & Transition: Audit active ad accounts, creative pipelines, and team members to deliver a clear execution plan. Fully assume Meta decision-making (budgets, launches, creative) and seamlessly transition the incumbent lead into a dedicated Creative Strategist role.
* Brand Scaling Systems: Execute staged growth targets for existing brands at first-rebill break-even or better. Establish a standardized launch protocol for new brands to reach scale rapidly while maintaining a near-perfect success rate.
* Retention & Margin Optimization: Shift brands from first-rebill break-even to first-purchase break-even as they mature, sustaining performance month-over-month. Proactively flag risks ahead of time with actionable recovery plans.
* Ad Rejection & Account Health Management: Rapidly troubleshoot and resolve ad rejections, policy flags, and disablements inherent to high-risk verticals (e.g., supplements). Set up and manage redundant account architecture (backup BMs, ad accounts, payment methods) to guarantee zero downtime and keep spend scaling uninterrupted.
* Pod Architecture & Department Building: Grade current team members and design final pod structures. Fully staff every pod with top-tier talent so strategists own creative direction end-to-end.
* Analytics & AI Operations: Build custom AI-driven live dashboards (using Claude) tracking spend, acquisition costs, payback periods, creative win rates, and rejection rates. Lead concise weekly executive syncs that require zero prep from leadership.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Proven $100K+/Day Scale: Track record taking DTC brands to aggressive scale, directly responsible for managing $100K+ daily Meta ad spend across catalog depth (6–10+ distinct SKUs).
* Direct-Response Mastery & In-the-Trenches Mindset: Obsessed with studying winning market trends, analyzing competitor ads, and turning consumer psychology into high-velocity creative concepts.
* Operational Resilience in High-Risk Verticals: Hands-on experience resolving policy flags, ad rejections, and account risks in supplement/health categories while keeping spend live via backup account infrastructure.
* High-Tempo Work Ethic (60+ Hrs/Wk): Hyper-ambitious operator who thrives under high pressure, brings a history of 60+ hour work weeks, and wants to grind alongside an elite team pushing toward 9 figures.
* Full Channel Ownership & Execution: Operates as a true "CEO of Meta"—building A-player creative pods, overseeing media buying alignment, and executing with extreme speed and autonomy.
* AI-Driven Automation: Leverages modern LLMs (Claude, GPTs) and automated data workflows to streamline creative analysis, build tracking dashboards, and scale output.

**Working Hours & Culture**

* Role Timeline: Full-time leadership hire.
* Async-First: Global, remote-first team setup requiring core daily overlap with US EST business hours for team syncs and cross-functional alignment.

**How To Apply & What To Expect**
At AtlasBrands, we value your time and expertise, which is why we’ve built a streamlined, highly transparent interview process designed to look for a true partner rather than a transactional contributor.

title: Director of Design Execution
description:
### **About Switch**

At Switch, we don't just design, build and operate data centers—we are enabling the technology of the future. Led by Founder & CEO, Rob Roy, we believe in revolutionary innovation, operational excellence and the principle of karma. Switch is where talented people come together to EVOLVE the digital world.

We believe that innovation isn't just about technology—it's about the people, culture, and purpose that make it happen. Every Switch team member contributes to a mission greater than themselves: to create the world's most advanced digital infrastructure that powers the progress of humanity.

**The Role: Director of Design Execution**
------------------------------------------

The Director of Design Execution provides enterprise leadership for the practical execution, technical coordination, and field validation of data center designs across Switch's project portfolio. This role leads the team responsible for translating design intent into solutions that are safe, constructible, commissionable, operable, maintainable, and repeatable.

You will lead Design Execution from post-design handoff through construction, commissioning, turnover, and operational readiness while providing technical support throughout the infrastructure lifecycle. You will establish engineering governance, execution standards, decision and escalation processes, and feedback mechanisms that improve reliability and consistency across regions.

This role leads a team of technical subject matter experts and manages supporting third-party consultants and contractors. You will also partner closely with Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Operations, EHS, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders to improve project delivery and turn field experience into standards and lessons learned for future projects.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Lead and develop the Design Execution team, including technical subject matter experts and supporting third-party consultants and contractors.
* Set team priorities, allocate resources, establish performance expectations, and provide coaching and development.
* Lead Design Execution activities across the project lifecycle, including design handoff, construction, commissioning, turnover, operations support, infrastructure improvements, and end-of-life planning.
* Establish and maintain the engineering governance framework for post-IFC execution, including handoff requirements, engineering decision management, escalation pathways, design-change oversight, performance metrics, and continuous improvement.
* Translate design intent into practical field execution requirements that support constructability, commissioning, maintainability, and operational readiness.
* Oversee resolution of construction and field engineering issues, including complex procedure reviews, critical equipment concerns, and technical event support.
* Oversee engineering solutions for upgrades and retrofits that increase capacity, availability, efficiency, reliability, or operational capability across existing data centers.
* Provide technical leadership for electrical and mechanical infrastructure, including transformers, generators, UPS systems, power distribution, HVAC and cooling systems, controls, and related critical infrastructure.
* Review and interpret construction drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics, sequences of operation, specifications, submittals, and other engineering documentation.
* Partner with Design Engineering to translate field experience, operational feedback, commissioning results, and lessons learned into improved standards and future designs.
* Coordinate with Construction, Commissioning, Operations, EHS, and other stakeholders to maintain consistent technical and execution standards across projects.
* Manage engineering consultants, vendors, contractors, and other external technical resources supporting Design Execution.
* Establish processes, procedures, and tools that enable consistent execution and support customer and project requirements across data center campuses.
* Establish and monitor Design Execution performance metrics and provide project, risk, and program updates to senior leadership.
* Lead assigned engineering projects and programs and ensure delivery against schedule, budget, quality, and operational requirements.
* Coordinate maintenance windows and implementation activities with facility leadership to minimize operational disruption.
* Ensure Design Execution activities comply with applicable codes, regulations, Switch requirements, and safety standards, including NFPA 70E requirements where applicable.
* Support Operations during turnover, customer-impacting events, near misses, and other complex technical situations.
* Identify systemic issues, recurring field challenges, and opportunities to improve execution, reliability, efficiency, and cost.
* Build strong working relationships across Operations, Finance, Legal, Construction, Commissioning, Design Engineering, and other stakeholders.
* Maintain an active field presence to understand conditions firsthand and validate that solutions can be executed as intended.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* You lead technical teams with clear expectations, accountability, coaching, and consistent follow-through.
* You make sound engineering decisions while balancing safety, reliability, constructability, cost, schedule, and operational impact.
* You can make informed recommendations when technical information is incomplete or conditions are changing.
* You identify design and execution risks early and develop practical solutions before they affect project or operational outcomes.
* You communicate complex engineering issues clearly to technical teams, business partners, and senior leadership.
* You build alignment across Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Operations, and external partners.
* You establish standards and governance that improve consistency without creating unnecessary barriers to execution.
* You use field experience, data, root cause analysis, and lessons learned to drive continuous improvement.
* You develop internal talent while holding consultants, contractors, and other external resources accountable for quality and results.
* You are comfortable spending time in the field to understand problems firsthand and validate solutions.
* You demonstrate the judgment, accountability, collaboration, and leadership expected under Switch's Culture Codes.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive engineering experience supporting industrial, commercial, or mission-critical facilities such as data centers, power generation, or oil and gas facilities.
* 5+ years of experience leading engineering teams, technical professionals, consultants, or comparable resources.
* 4+ years of project management experience supporting data center engineering or comparable mission-critical infrastructure.
* Deep understanding of electrical and mechanical systems used in mission-critical environments, including power distribution, transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, cooling systems, HVAC, controls, and fire protection.
* Experience leading or supporting construction, commissioning, turnover, operational readiness, retrofit, or infrastructure improvement activities.
* Experience managing engineering projects, consultants, contractors, and other external technical resources.
* Experience reading, interpreting, and reviewing construction drawings, specifications, submittals, wiring diagrams, schematics, sequences of operation, and MEP documentation.
* Experience with EPMS, SCADA, BMS, or comparable monitoring and controls systems.
* Strong knowledge of safety requirements and applicable OSHA standards for multi-megawatt or mission-critical facilities.
* Working knowledge of NFPA 70E and electrical safety requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute solutions for complex engineering and operational problems.
* Strong project and program management, prioritization, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Experience using engineering, project management, calculation, data analysis, and collaboration tools.
* Ability to support after-hours or weekend activities when required for critical projects, maintenance windows, commissioning, or operational events.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally as business needs require.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
* Professional Engineer registration or other relevant professional engineering certification.
* Experience leading enterprise or multi-region engineering programs within data centers or other mission-critical environments.
* Experience establishing engineering governance, technical standards, design-change processes, or post-IFC execution frameworks.
* Experience supporting root cause analysis, fleet optimization, lifecycle management, and infrastructure reliability programs.

We recognize that qualified candidates may not meet every preferred qualification. If your experience aligns with the core responsibilities of the role, we encourage you to apply.

### **Why Switch?**

* A Culture of Karma – We are self-motivated by karma, ensuring our actions contribute to a positive, supportive and forward-thinking environment.
* Industry Leading Designs – Work with the most advanced data center technology on the planet and be a part of emerging technology development.
* Flexibility & Remote Opportunities – Whether in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, we offer the technology and support to keep teams connected and productive.
* Career Stability & Growth – In this expanding industry, we invest in our people, providing opportunities & advancement in a stable, growing company.
* Generous Benefits Package - Switch provides comprehensive coverage for you and your family that can be tailored to fit your personal needs, and more!

### **Join Us & Make a Difference**

This is more than a job—it's a mission. If you're ready to be part of a culture that values innovation, karma, and limitless potential, we want to hear from you.

Apply Now and Let's Build the Future Together.

title: Director of Product Design
description:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

Beacon Biosignals is seeking a Director of Product Design to lead and grow our Product Design function. Product Design at Beacon is a shared function that serves the entire business: the hardware experience of our EEG headbands and other devices, the mobile apps that participants and patients use at home, the web applications that clinical teams and trial sponsors rely on, the printed materials that guide patients and site staff, and the design of internal business processes across logistics, support, and clinical operations. In this role you'll lead a team of three senior product designers, set the vision for how design works at Beacon, and plan the function's growth as the company scales. We expect this role to stay close to the craft. You'll model best practices directly alongside the team, not just direct it from above. This role reports directly to Beacon's VP of Platform.

Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first-class remote work experience, but we also have in-person office hubs located in Boston, New York City, and Paris. For this position, candidates based in the Boston or surrounding area are preferred

**What success looks like:**

As a successful Director of Product Design at Beacon, you'll...

* Lead and coach a team of three senior product designers, helping each of them grow their craft, expand their impact, and build a clear path forward in their careers.
* Craft, iterate, and execute on a vision for what product design should be at Beacon, and translate that vision into a concrete plan for how the function grows alongside the business.
* Operate as a player-coach, particularly in your first year: taking on design work yourself where it sets the standard, demonstrating the practices you want to see, and raising the bar by example rather than by directive.
* Own prioritization across the full breadth of Beacon's design surface, from device and mobile to web, print, and business process, making the tradeoffs that determine where a small, senior team spends its time and ensuring no single designer becomes a bottleneck for the company.
* Build the cross-functional connections that design depends on, partnering closely with Device Engineering, Platform, Clinical Operations, Logistics, Support, and Quality to bring design into decisions early rather than at the end.
* Establish the processes, standards, and shared systems that let design scale: a coherent design language across hardware and software, reusable patterns, and design reviews that improve quality without slowing delivery.
* Ensure design's contribution to Beacon's regulated products is rigorous and well-documented, partnering with Quality and Regulatory on usability and human factors work for our cleared devices.
* Own the headcount plan, budget, and vendor relationships for the function, and make the case for investment in design with the same rigor you'd bring to a design problem.
* Develop a deep understanding of everyone Beacon serves: patients using our devices unsupervised at home, the clinical staff and healthcare providers who care for them, the site teams running trials, and the sponsors who rely on the insights we deliver. Build the research practice that keeps that understanding current.
* Develop an equally deep understanding of how Beacon itself operates, so that design serves our internal teams as well as our external users, from device provisioning and logistics through support and scientific services.
* See around corners: anticipate where design debt, inconsistency, or unowned experience problems are accumulating, and address them before they become urgent.

**What you will bring:**

* 10+ years of product design experience, including 4+ years managing and developing designers.
* Experience building or substantially maturing a design function. You know what the first eighteen months of that work actually look like.
* A portfolio that spans both hardware and software experiences. You're comfortable moving between a physical device, a mobile app, a data-heavy web application, and the printed material that ties them together.
* You have experience and familiarity working in the medical device space, clinical diagnostics, real-world-data, pharma/biotech or other related fields.
* You've worked in a regulated industry before, and have successfully navigated the tension between fast-paced iterative design and strict design controls. Familiarity with usability engineering and human factors practice (e.g. IEC 62366, FDA human factors guidance) is a strong plus.
* You're genuinely energized by coaching senior individual contributors. You can give feedback that a strong, experienced designer will respect and act on.
* You're comfortable being hands-on without defaulting to it. You know the difference between modeling the work and doing the work because it's easier than delegating it.
* Experience designing service and business process experiences, not just product interfaces. You've improved how an organization operates, not only what it ships.
* You bring strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align partners around decisions, tradeoffs, and evolving plans, including in regulated or quality-sensitive environments.
* You demonstrate a bias towards simplicity, avoid misallocating complexity, and try to impose structure at the right time - not too early or too late.
* You're comfortable working in a highly asynchronous remote work environment, and have demonstrated success doing so in the past.

The base salary range for this role is $200,000 - $215,000, depending on past experience, specific skills, and qualifications. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO, and other benefits.

At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

title: 21GRAMS- Director, Product Design
description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

**21GRAMS, a Real Chemistry subsidiary, is an advertising agency born to make healthcare more human.** Not just in our work, but in how we conduct business, approach client relationships, and treat each other. We believe in being good to each other and hard on the work, and in creating work that makes a meaningful difference for patients, caregivers, healthcare professionals, and brands.

#### **Job Summary**

The Director, Product Design is a senior design leader responsible for setting the product design vision, raising the quality of the work, and building the conditions for teams to deliver cohesive, accessible, and effective digital experiences. This role leads complex engagements across websites, platforms, products, services, and connected ecosystems, translating user needs, brand strategy, business goals, technology constraints, and healthcare requirements into clear experience direction.

This is not solely an execution role. The Director is accountable for design strategy, client leadership, team development, resourcing, design operations, and measurable experience outcomes. They remain close enough to the work to guide critical decisions, facilitate discovery, critique design, and step into high-impact moments while enabling senior designers to lead day to day.

#### **What You Will Do**

**Design Vision and Product Strategy**

* Own the product design vision and experience strategy across a portfolio of complex client engagements, connecting user needs, brand intent, business objectives, and technical feasibility.
* Partner with Experience Strategy, UX, Product Management, Creative, Technology, Data, Medical, Strategy, and Account leadership to frame opportunities, define roadmaps, and establish measurable outcomes.
* Lead discovery and definition activities, including stakeholder alignment, experience principles, journey framing, service blueprints, value propositions, prioritization, and product or platform planning.
* Identify opportunities that extend beyond the immediate brief and turn them into clear, decision-ready recommendations for clients and agency leadership.

**Design Excellence and Delivery**

* Set and uphold a high bar for interaction design, visual design, responsive behavior, content hierarchy, prototyping, motion, and end-to-end experience coherence.
* Guide teams from early concepts through detailed design, validation, launch, and optimization, ensuring that strategic intent is maintained through implementation.
* Oversee scalable design systems, component libraries, pattern governance, and documentation in Figma, working with engineering partners to improve quality and delivery efficiency.
* Build accessibility into the work from the start, applying WCAG 2.2 AA principles and inclusive design practices rather than treating compliance as a final review step.
* Use qualitative research, analytics, usability findings, and business measures to evaluate design decisions and recommend iteration.

**Client and Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Act as a trusted senior design partner to clients, clearly articulating experience strategy, design rationale, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations to executive and working teams.
* Lead high-stakes presentations, workshops, critiques, and decision-making sessions, creating alignment across internal and external stakeholders.
* Partner with project and account leadership on scope, staffing, schedules, assumptions, and change management; surface delivery risks early and propose practical solutions.
* Represent Product Design in new-business opportunities, estimates, proposals, capability presentations, and pitch work.

**People Leadership and Practice Development**

* Manage, coach, and develop product designers across levels through clear expectations, actionable feedback, growth plans, and regular career conversations.
* Create an environment where designers can do their best work, with strong critique, psychological safety, accountability, and thoughtful delegation.
* Partner with Experience leadership on hiring, staffing, performance management, succession planning, and capability development.
* Improve the Product Design practice through reusable methods, templates, standards, training, and responsible adoption of emerging tools, including AI-enabled workflows.
* Contribute to a culture of collaboration across Product Design, UX, Creative, Technology, and Strategy, reducing silos and improving continuity from concept through launch.

#### **What Success Looks Like**

* Clients see Product Design as a strategic partner, not only a production capability.
* Teams have clear experience direction, decision criteria, and an appropriate level of design leadership from discovery through delivery.
* Creates a more consistent, accessible, and high-quality experience across the portfolio.
* Designers receive strong coaching, understand what is expected of them, and demonstrate measurable growth.
* The practice becomes more scalable through better systems, methods, staffing decisions, and cross-functional ways of working.
* Experience recommendations connect to defined user, client, and business outcomes.

#### **What You Should Have**

* 10+ years of experience in product design, experience design, interaction design, or a related discipline, including 3+ years managing and developing designers.
* A portfolio demonstrating leadership across complex, multi-channel digital products or platforms, from strategy and concept through detailed design and launch.
* Experience leading multiple workstreams or a portfolio of client engagements in an agency, consultancy, product organization, or similarly complex environment.
* Deep fluency in human-centered design, interaction design, visual systems, prototyping, responsive design, information architecture, and design systems.
* Strong working knowledge of Figma and modern collaborative design workflows; familiarity with Adobe Creative Cloud and prototyping or motion tools is helpful.
* Practical knowledge of accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.2 AA, and the ability to guide teams in designing inclusive experiences.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with engineering, product, research, content, analytics, strategy, creative, and account teams.
* Excellent executive communication, facilitation, storytelling, critique, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Experience defining design outcomes and using research, usability testing, analytics, and performance data to improve experiences.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity, making informed trade-offs, and balancing strategic leadership with hands-on guidance when the work requires it.

#### **This Position Is a Strong Fit If**

* You can move between the 30,000-foot view and the detail that determines whether an experience actually works.
* You are direct, low-ego, generous with feedback, and able to challenge the work while supporting the people doing it.
* You bring structure to ambiguity, anticipate needs, and help teams make better decisions faster.
* You care about craft, but judge success by the quality, usefulness, accessibility, and impact of the experience.
* Our Company values – *Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always* and *Accountability with an “I”* – really speak to you.
* You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
* You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
* You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

#### **Preferred Experience**

* Healthcare, pharmaceutical, patient support, medical technology, or other regulated-industry experience.
* Experience with privacy, consent, regulated content, and design considerations for patients, caregivers, and healthcare professionals.
* Experience supporting business development, scoping, estimating, and presenting capabilities or pitch work.
* Experience leading enterprise websites, authenticated platforms, service ecosystems, omnichannel programs, or AI-enabled experiences.

  

**Pay Range:** $140,000 - $155,000  
This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. title: Director, Brand & Creative Marketing
description:
As a Director of Brand & Creative Marketing, will own the evolution of MongoDB's global brand identity and creative expression. MongoDB isn't just about logos or design systems—it's about driving real business outcomes, translating our complex technical offerings into stories and experiences, and fostering pride and loyalty among all audiences. This is your chance to shape the creative future of one of the fastest-growing enterprise companies in the world.

You will lead and influence all aspects of MongoDB's brand visual expression. title: Senior Director, Product Creative Direction
description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

**Team and Role**

This role is part of our Product Design team, which turns a deep understanding of our users and customers into product experiences they love. Our designers bring expertise across design systems, visual design, interaction design, content design, and product design. At ServiceNow, design has an intentional seat at the table, and we partner with Engineering and Product Management from the outset.

We're looking for a Senior Director of Product Creative Direction to define and evolve the visual expression of our product portfolio. This leader will set a distinctive product visual direction, translate it into a scalable system, and help teams make complex enterprise software feel clear, coherent, modern, and unmistakably ServiceNow.

This is a product-focused creative leadership role. You will work as part of cross-functional software development teams and partner across Platform and the business units to connect creative vision with customer needs, product strategy, and technical realities. Product teams retain ownership of their product strategy, design, roadmap, quality, and delivery; this role provides shared visual direction, systems, critique, and enablement.

You will also advance the responsible use of AI in creative work and make accessibility intrinsic to the product visual language.

**What you get to do in this role**

* Define and champion a differentiated visual direction for the product portfolio, grounded in our brand, customer needs, product strategy, and the evolving relationship between people and AI.
* Establish a clear point of view across typography, color, composition, iconography, illustration, motion, data visualization, density, and other visual foundations.
* Create future-state concepts, reference experiences, and exemplars that make the visual direction tangible.
* Work with Design Systems, Product Design, Content Design, Accessibility, Localization, and Research to translate the visual language into scalable foundations, components, patterns, and guidance.
* Partner with Design Systems, Product Management and Engineering throughout the software development lifecycle so the creative direction can be applied effectively in shipped products.
* Define where consistency is essential, where variation creates value, and how teams can extend the system without creating a centralized bottleneck.
* Lead the strategy for AI-enabled creative exploration, prototyping, asset creation, system evolution, and evaluation, focusing on meaningful gains in range, speed, consistency, and quality.
* Move promising AI approaches from experimentation to repeatable practice through pilots, playbooks, training, exemplars, responsible-use standards, and measurable adoption goals.
* Provide creative direction and hands-on critique for priority, cross-product initiatives while reinforcing product-team ownership.
* Partner with Brand and Marketing so the company expression and product experience tell a coherent story while remaining useful and native to interactive software.
* Make accessibility intrinsic to the creative vision and visual foundations, partnering with Accessibility and Engineering to meet or exceed applicable standards, including WCAG 2.2 AA.
* Lead, develop, and attract exceptional visual, motion, and multidisciplinary design talent.
* Build the culture, enablement, and shared critique practices that help product designers and distributed visual designers understand, apply, and continually raise the visual craft bar.
* Build a network of creative leaders and contributors across the business units who can extend the direction while maintaining coherence.

 **Qualifications**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience in product design, visual design, experience design, creative direction, or a related field, including significant leadership experience shipping complex digital products.
* A portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual craft and creative leadership across shipped product experiences, not only brand campaigns or marketing communications.
* Experience defining or materially evolving a visual language across a complex, multi-product software portfolio.
* Deep understanding of design systems, including visual foundations, design tokens, components, patterns, governance, contribution models, and the relationship between design and code.
* Demonstrated experience adopting AI-enabled creative tools and workflows and moving teams from isolated experimentation to sustained, responsible use at scale.
* Proven ability to influence senior executives and align multiple organizations without relying solely on reporting authority.
* Expert command of typography, color, composition, interaction, motion, and information hierarchy, with the judgment to apply them to dense and complex product workflows.
* Strong systems thinking and the ability to connect an inspiring creative idea to the practices and adoption mechanisms required to make it real at scale.
* Demonstrated commitment to accessible and inclusive design, with working knowledge of WCAG and platform accessibility considerations.
* Excellent communication, storytelling, facilitation, and critique skills, including the ability to make a direction compelling to executives and actionable for delivery teams.
* Experience leading leaders and building high-performing, inclusive creative teams.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience participating in the complete product development lifecycle of web and/or software applications.
* Experience working as a member of cross-functional Product Management, Engineering, and Design teams.
* Experience leading creative teams and partnering across a complex organization.

We're looking for a Director, Data & Analytics to own how Ritual measures its business as we grow from a DTC-first brand into an omnichannel one. Ritual now reaches consumers through our own ecommerce site, Amazon, and national retail partners, and we're investing in upper-funnel media to reach new audiences. That makes leadership's questions harder: Is retail growing the brand or moving demand we already had? What is brand media actually buying? Where should the next dollar of growth capital go? You'll own those answers and bring them to our CGO, CFO, and executive team in a way that changes decisions. Reporting to our SVP, Product & Engineering, you'll lead a team of analysts and data engineers. You'll be a strategic partner to leaders across the business, working as a peer to our VP, Omnichannel Media and alongside our DTC, Wholesale, Amazon & Marketplaces, Brand, and Finance teams. You'll inherit a modern, stable data platform. Your job is to scale what it delivers, grow the people on it, and shape the team for its next stage.

**What you'll do**

* **Own Ritual's omnichannel measurement:** Build and run a single connected view of customer value and acquisition cost across DTC, Amazon and marketplaces, and retail: LTV:CAC, payback, and contribution profit by channel. Explain how channels interact, including halo, cannibalization, and whether new distribution expands the market or shifts it.
* **Own the read on marketing investment:** Partner with our VP, Omnichannel Media to plan, test, and optimize the full media budget; you own the measurement ecosystem across MMM, attribution, geo-lift, and incrementality, including what upper-funnel investment is buying in reach and household penetration.
* **Measure every channel on the same terms:** Bring retail and Amazon up to the standard we hold DTC to, covering sell-in versus sell-through, distribution and velocity, promotions, syndicated and panel data, and new-to-brand customers.
* **Shape decisions at the top:** Be the executive voice on business performance for our CGO, CFO, and leadership team. Own the reporting the business runs on, partner with Finance on plan, mine the insight that matters, and build the artifacts that move planning, budget, and board conversations.
* **Lead and build the team:** Grow analysts into domain experts and coach them to build influential analysis and the narrative around it. Lead data engineering and own how our stack and project architecture evolve with the changing needs of the business.

**Who you are**

* **Executive Translator:** You turn complex, multi-channel analysis into a clear recommendation a CFO can act on, and you're comfortable defending it in the room. Leaders seek out your point of view before they make the call.
* **Healthy Skeptic:** You know when a number is wrong before anyone else does, and you say the inconvenient thing plainly and kindly. You'd rather surface a hard finding early than defend a comfortable one later. When priorities compete, you negotiate calmly and constructively, holding to what the data supports while staying open to what others need.
* **Omnichannel Systems Thinker:** You see DTC, marketplace, and retail as one portfolio. You think in contribution profit, not channel silos, and you understand how media, distribution, and retention work together.
* **Storyteller and Teacher:** You can turn a messy dataset into a sharp narrative, and you teach others to do the same. Your feedback on a draft makes the analyst better, not just the deck.
* **Focused Operator:** You've led a lean data team inside a growing business with many internal customers. You check that the work ladders up to Ritual's goals, protect your team's capacity, and take on ad-hoc asks selectively instead of chasing every fire drill.
* **Listener and Team Builder:** You listen as closely to your team as you do to the business, and you find the balance between what each needs. You grow analysts into leaders, and you're credible with engineers on the tradeoffs that keep a data platform trustworthy.

**What you'll need**

* 8+ years in analytics, data science, or marketing measurement, starting as a practitioner analyst with strong business instincts, and including several years leading lean, technical data teams of analysts and data or analytics engineers, with credibility on pipeline, modeling, and data-quality tradeoffs.
* Hands-on marketing measurement expertise across MMM, multi-touch attribution, incrementality testing, and geo-lift, including where each method breaks, and a track record of using it to rationalize upper-funnel spend.
* Experience measuring marketing efficiency at a consumer brand that sells both DTC and through retail, including marketplace channels, subscription or e-commerce economics, cohort retention, and cross-channel effects.
* Retail data experience, including POS and sell-through data, retailer data portals, syndicated and household panel data, and reconciling sell-in to consumer takeaway. CPG or health and wellness experience is a plus.
* Demonstrated executive influence and storytelling: a portfolio of analyses and executive artifacts that changed decisions at the C-suite or board level, and experience coaching analysts to produce them.
* Deep experience with dbt and a modern data stack (Snowflake and a BI semantic layer, with Omni a plus), as a hands-on practitioner or as the manager of the engineers who own it. Amazon Marketing Cloud experience is a plus.

*We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification listed above. We’re committed to building a diverse team and recognize that skills can be developed in many different ways.*

title: Multimedia Designer- 1099 Contract
