title: Brand Protection Manager
description:
About the job

Department: Brand Protection & IP Enforcement

Reports to: Director of Brand Protection & IP Enforcement

Location: Remote (US)

Employment Type: Full-Time, Exempt

Pay Range: $80,000 - $100,000

**About Intake Breathing**

Intake Breathing is a DTC health and wellness startup helping people breathe better through our subscription-based nasal breathing device. Our customers don't just buy a product. They adopt a practice that transforms their sleep, recovery, and daily life.

As we've scaled, protecting that product and the brand behind it has become mission-critical. This year alone, our Brand Protection department has driven 16,000+ enforcement actions, blocked an estimated $6.6M in counterfeit revenue, and expanded our trademark and patent portfolio into 20+ countries. We're looking for someone to own the day-to-day operation of that enforcement program so it can keep scaling with us.

The Role

The Brand Protection Manager owns the day-to-day execution of Intake's brand protection and IP enforcement operations — managing our enforcement team, running marketplace compliance and appeals, and keeping the systems and documentation behind it all running smoothly, without requiring constant oversight.

This role reports to the Director of Brand Protection & IP Enforcement, who owns strategy, litigation, IP portfolio decisions, the legal budget, and legal/regulatory compliance. This role owns the operational layer underneath that — it's the first management layer in a department that's actively scaling.This is a hands-on role that combines people management, marketplace operations, and judgment under volume. You'll be trusted to run the team, make the daily calls, and know when something needs to come to the Director instead.

What You'll Own

* Enforcement ExecutionLead day-to-day takedown execution across platforms and regions
* Ensure actions are timely, defensible, and properly documented
* Identify patterns in counterfeit activity and repeat bad actors, and flag them to the Director for strategic action
* Work inside Shoalvex (our proprietary enforcement platform) as the primary system of record for case management and monitoring
* Marketplace & Platform ComplianceOwn compliance responses and appeals across Amazon and other marketplaces, including reinstatement appeals that require written narratives and supporting documentation (screenshots, invoices, brand documentation)
* Manage escalations and remediation plans for account or listing-level actions
* Flag platform policy changes or emerging risk to the Director
* Team Building & TrainingOnboard and train enforcement team members once hired — every hire to date has started with zero brand protection background, so this role owns getting new hires productive
* Define day-to-day role expectations and coach reps against them
* Maintain and update our Trainual process library as SOPs evolve, so training doesn't depend on tribal knowledge
* Operating Rhythm & ReportingOwn the team's daily accountability standard, reviewed on a trailing weekly average
* Run regular check-ins with the team and directly follow up with reps trending below standard
* Report team performance, appeal outcomes, and takedown volume to the Director on a consistent cadence
* Escalate ambiguous judgment calls or anything requiring legal input to the Director rather than guessing; independently manage everything else
* What We're Looking For3+ years of hands-on brand protection, anti-counterfeiting, or IP enforcement experience — you've personally done takedowns, appeals, or case investigation, not just managed people who do
* Direct experience with Amazon Brand Registry, Seller Central, or marketplace enforcement/appeals processes
* People management experience, ideally with distributed or remote teams
* Strong written communication — appeals and escalations often come down to how clearly and persuasively the case is made in writing
* Working familiarity with IP concepts — trademarks, copyright, DMCA takedowns, counterfeit identification
* Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision, and sound judgment about when to solve something yourself versus escalate
* Nice to have:
* Experience with multiple marketplaces beyond Amazon (Walmart, eBay, Etsy, TikTok Shop, etc.)
* Background in e-commerce operations or seller support
* Exposure to brand protection platforms or tools (Shoalvex, MarkMonitor, Red Points, or similar)
* Familiarity with international enforcement or trademark filing processes
* Paralegal or legal support background
* ADA/web accessibility compliance experience (WCAG standards, accessibility audits, or remediation work) — we're building out this function within the department and this is a real plus, not a requirement

**Why This Role**

This role owns the operational backbone of brand protection at Intake. You'll have direct responsibility for the team that keeps counterfeiters off our marketplaces, builds the appeals that protect our seller accounts, and turns brand-new hires into productive enforcement professionals.Success in this role means becoming the trusted owner of day-to-day enforcement operations — running the team, the standard, and the process well enough that the Director can spend his time on litigation, IP strategy, and legal compliance instead of managing queues.

* Additional Information
* This position is remote-eligible; occasional availability for team coordination across time zones is expected.
* This position is exempt and not eligible for overtime.
* Employment is at-will and may be terminated by either party at any time, with or without cause or notice.
* Reasonable accommodations will be provided in accordance with applicable law.
* We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other status protected under applicable law.

Pay: $80,000.00 - $100,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

title: Senior Manager, Amazon (Marketplaces)
description:

**About the Role:**

Amazon is our anchor platform, and you will support the build-out of the next wave of marketplaces, starting with Faire and extending to US and international platforms. Amazon experience is a strong plus. You are comfortable managing the detail, owning the numbers, and turning data into action.

You will partner with Paid Media, Marketing, Ops, Merchandising, Finance, CX, Data & Insights, and Performance-Led Creative to grow marketplaces efficiently, strengthen Comfrt's brand on each platform, and create halo effect into DTC and other channels.

**What You'll Do:**

* Manage marketplace GMV, contribution margin, and profitability against plan, and report results to the Senior Director and Finance.
* Support the development of annual operating plans, forecasts, and inventory strategy aligned with company targets.
* Manage Amazon channel execution, including 1P vs. 3P, FBA/FBM/AWD mix, and pricing architecture.
* Support launch of new marketplaces (starting with Faire) by preparing market analysis, launch plans, and go/no-go inputs based on margin, brand fit, and enterprise value.

**Catalog, Listings & Compliance**

* Ensure platform compliance to minimize the risk of deranking or suppression. Partner with the Brand Protection team on Brand Registry and proactive IP protection.
* Monitor algorithm changes and category trends to keep listings competitive on every platform.

**Analytics & Insight**

* Track portfolio KPIs (GMV, TACoS, contribution margin, organic rank, inventory turns, in-stock rate) and partner with Data & Insights on reporting that surfaces opportunities to scale.

* Lead and develop direct reports and the marketplace team (Ops/ Catalog), setting clear goals and building capability.
* Manage agencies and external partners as needed.
* Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Marketing, Growth, Performance-Led Creative, Inventory, and Supply Chain to align execution with portfolio strategy.

**Who You Are:**

**Required**

* 5-7 years of progressive experience in ecommerce, marketplace, or retail operations, including at least 3 years managing Amazon for a multi-SKU brand.
* Experience in a fast-moving, multi-SKU environment (retail, beauty, or consumer products) with frequent launches, promotions, and inventory decisions.
* Hands-on fluency in 1P/3P strategy, FBA/FBM/AWD, retail media (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, DSP), and catalog and compliance management.
* Working knowledge of P&L drivers (GMV, margin, TACoS, inventory turns) and the ability to analyze them and act on the results.

This range represents the anticipated base salary and does not include bonus, benefits, or other forms of compensation.*

title: Marketing Director
description:

2Modern is a curated online destination for modern furniture, lighting, and decor, carrying about 300 of the best design brands. title: Social Media and Graphic Design Specialist
description:
**Social Media and Graphic Design Specialist**

*Independent contractor | 10 to 15 hours per week*

Remote within the United States. Salt Lake City area preferred.

**About TOUTI**

The Our-Trees Initiative (TOUTI) highlights the importance of trees through the power of stories from many ways of knowing, inspiring actions that help trees and people flourish. Led by forest canopy ecologist Dr. Nalini Nadkarni, TOUTI brings together community groups and National Geographic Explorers to share their relationships with trees and support projects in their communities.

**The opportunity**

We are looking for someone with strong design skills to create content and manage TOUTI’s Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube accounts. Most of the work will involve social media posts, graphics, and short videos, with occasional support documenting project activities. You will work with Program Manager Owen Watkins, who will provide project updates and source materials, set priorities with Director Nalini Nadkarni, and coordinate content approval.

**Responsibilities**

· Design social media graphics, reels, event announcements, and reusable templates that match TOUTI’s visual style. Use clear layouts and readable text, and prepare each design for the platform where it will appear.

· Write captions and adapt project updates, stories, and resources for Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube. Suggest post ideas and ways to make TOUTI’s work easier to understand and share.

· Maintain a social media calendar, prepare drafts for review, and schedule and publish approved content. Keep account information current and add titles, descriptions, and thumbnails to YouTube uploads.

· Edit photos and footage into Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other short videos. Select useful clips, improve audio where needed, and add accurate captions and simple graphics.

· Check comments and messages, respond to routine questions, and flag anything needing staff input. Share a brief monthly update on reach, engagement, and which posts performed well.

· Provide occasional documentation support using materials supplied by TOUTI staff, such as assembling a photo recap or preparing a short project summary for social media.

**Initial priorities**

Review the accounts and existing content with the TOUTI Program Manager, then develop a small set of design templates and a proposed posting calendar. Agree on a realistic mix of graphics, posts, and short videos within the weekly hours. Social media and graphic design will take priority when planning assignments.

**Experience and skills**

· Experience creating social media content for an organization, publication, campaign, or client.

· Strong caption writing and editing skills, with the ability to turn supplied information into clear, accurate posts.

· Familiarity with Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube, and other social media platforms, including scheduling, publishing, and basic analytics.

· Proficiency with Canva or Adobe design tools and a video editor such as CapCut or Premiere Pro. Ability to prepare polished graphics and edit short videos with accurate captions.

· Ability to follow brand guidelines, incorporate feedback, organize working files, and meet agreed deadlines. Careful attention to accessibility, image credits, and instructions about permissions.

Experience with environmental, science, or nonprofit communications is welcome. A specific degree is not required.

**Compensation and contract details**

The rate is $20 to $30 per hour, depending on experience and portfolio, for approximately 10 to 15 hours per week. This is an independent contractor opportunity, remote within the United States. Salt Lake City area candidates are preferred for occasional local photo or video support arranged in advance. The schedule is flexible around agreed deadlines and occasional virtual meetings during Mountain Time business hours. The start date and contract duration will be agreed with the selected contractor.

**How to apply**

Email Owen Watkins at owen.watkins@utah.edu with a resume or brief professional background, a short note about your interest in TOUTI, and links to 3 to 5 relevant work samples. Please include your location, availability, and possible start date.

Pay: $20.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 10.0 – 15.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

title: Senior Motion & Graphic Designer (Remote)
description:
Silverback Strategies is a performance marketing agency built to help marketers grow and capitalize on change. Ad Age, Inc Magazine, The Washington Post, The Washingtonian, and The Washington Business Journal have recognized Silverback as one of the best places to work.  
  
We hire the best and help them get better. Silverbackers are supported, challenged and inspired by their peers. Regardless of title or tenure, every Silverbacker plays a role in helping our agency get better. This is a place where you can make a difference.

### **What you will do:**

* Translate strategy into visuals: partner closely with our Creative Strategist to take research, hooks, and loose creative briefs and turn them into concrete visual concepts, storyboards, and finished assets
* Produce both statics and video: design and build static ad creative and edit/produce short-form video and motion content for paid social at a consistently high craft level
* Interpret brand guidance at any altitude: work from anything ranging from a thin one-pager to a comprehensive brand system, and reliably produce creative that's unmistakably on-brand either way
* Navigate regulated-industry review cycles: produce creative that anticipates compliance and legal scrutiny, minimizing revision rounds and rejection risk without watering down creative quality
* Push brands into new creative territory: identify opportunities to evolve a brand's creative expression to unlock scale and new-market growth, while staying inside brand-safety guardrails
* Select and edit raw footage/imagery: review raw photography and video footage from shoots and select, crop, cut, and edit the strongest material into finished assets — no on-set creative direction required
* Own asset quality and turnaround: deliver polished, client-ready work with minimal internal revision cycles so assets aren't burning days internally before they even reach the client
* Maintain visual consistency at scale: keep creative consistent and on-brand across a high volume of ad variations, formats, and platform

### **What we are looking for:**

**Core Experience**  

* 5+ years in a hands-on creative production role — Art Director, Senior Designer, Creative Producer, or similar —with dedicated performance/paid social experience
* A portfolio that shows range across both static design and video/motion editing, ideally for paid social specifically
* Experience working within brand guidelines of varying depth and translating them into new creative applications
* Experience in regulated or highly regulated industries (healthcare, finance, insurance, legal, or similar) is a strong plus, given our client base
* Experience working in matrixed organizations with multiple stakeholders and layered approval processes

  
**Craft & Technical Skills**  

* Expert-level proficiency in Figma (or similar) for static design and layout
* Strong proficiency in After Effects (or similar) for motion graphics and video editing
* Comfortable editing raw video/photo footage into finished assets: selects, cuts, pacing, captions/graphics overlays
* Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Premiere, Illustrator) as needed
* Understands platform-specific creative specs and best practices across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, and other paid social channels

Creative & Strategic Judgment  

* A strong eye for what "good" looks like in modern performance advertising — thumb-stopping, polished, and effective, not just pretty
* Understands performance/paid-social fundamentals (hooks, pacing, hierarchy, CTAs) well enough to make smart creative calls independently, without needing to run the strategy
* Can take a loose brief or visual direction and fill in the gaps with sound creative judgment
* High attention to detail — typos, brand misapplications, and spec errors don't make it to client review
* Comfortable giving and receiving fast, iterative feedback in a deadline-driven environment

  
**Working Style**  

* Thrives on speed without sacrificing polish — this role owns production timelines that need to move fast to offset long approval cycles
* Collaborative by nature; sees the Creative Strategist as a partner, not a hand-off point
* Self-sufficient in production; doesn't need heavy oversight to get from brief to finished asset

### **What success looks like:**

* Assets consistently reach client/compliance review in 1–2 internal revision rounds or fewer
* Creative reliably passes compliance and legal review with minimal rework
* Output balances brand safety with creative freshness — clients see growth and new territory, not just "more of the same"
* The Strategist and Senior Performance Creative function as a true two-person creative engine, each covering what the other doesn't

### **What This Role Is Not:**

* Not a photo/video shoot creative director — you won't be expected to run or direct live shoots, just to select and edit from what's captured
* Not a pure strategist — research, testing frameworks, and reporting live with the Creative Strategist, not this role

### **—Why Silverback?—**

Silverback isn’t for everybody. If you’re an A player, you will get paid more, learn more and grow faster with support from a smart and fun team. If you’re a B player, you will be miserable

* Make an impact: We’re a small agency. Everybody has the opportunity to drive change and impact
* Get paid: We hire the best and pay them generously
* Do cool sh\*t: From media to SEO to measurement, learn the cutting edge of what works

* Virtual Team Events and a fun, casual, inclusive company culture

You'll also run the cloud, AI, and venue infrastructure under our portfolio of brands, from client-facing experiences to the systems that keep our nearly 40 venues running. This is a rebuild. You design it *and* you build it.

Today, deployments are manual and happen about once a sprint. That's the starting line. You'll rethink how we ship so that deployments are unlocked, safe, secure, and governed.

You'll have high autonomy and real decision-making power over the tools we use and how we build. We're committed to AWS and will build deeply on it. Most of what sits on top is fair game: CI tooling, pipeline design, orchestration patterns, and source control.A decision like Bitbucket versus GitHub is a live call, and it's yours to make. Legacy migration follows the decisions. You make the call, then you do the move. This role will have a lot of influence.

This is a wide seat. You'll work across product and corporate engineering, and you're a big part of how we get to AI-first, spec-driven development.

**What You'll Do:**

* **Rebuild the deployment path.** Own CI/CD end to end: build, release, and rollback. Take us from manual deploys to an automated path.
* **Make it safe, secure and governed.** Access control, audit trails, secrets management, environment separation, and a rollback path any engineer can execute.
* **Make the platform calls.** Source control, CI tooling, orchestration, and infrastructure-as-code patterns. Jenkins is what we run today; what we run next is up to you. Decide, document the trade-off, then go forth and migrate.
* **Run the AI gateway.** Build and operate the layer between our engineers, agents and the models they call: provider routing, key management, rate limits, token metering, and usage logging. Every AI call should be visible, governed, and attributable.
* **Enable AI-first, spec-driven development.** Build the environments, pipelines and guardrails that let engineers and agents ship with confidence: ephemeral environments, fast feedback, and automated verification.
* **Model and manage cloud and AI cost.** Forecast what AI systems will cost before we commit and give Finance numbers they can plan against. Keep a standing view of where cloud spend goes and why, and partner with teams to help keep it in check.
* **Support in-venue networking applications.** Each venue relies on network infrastructure for access control, connectivity, and on-site A/V and production. You'll give our networking team the visibility to monitor and support the applications that keep those venues running.
* **Build the observability layer.** Logging, metrics, alerting, and routing on our Loki/Grafana stack, so every failure reaches a named owner.
* **Spread what you know and what you do.** Coordinate with the product engineers and ensure a level of backup: documented runbooks, a named second operator on every critical path, and dissemination of knowledge and function across product and corporate engineering. Within six months, you can take two weeks off and we can trudge through an emergency without interrupting you.

**What We Look For:**

* You have 9+ years of experience building and running production cloud infrastructure.
* You're deep on AWS: multi-account structure, networking, IAM, and container orchestration on EKS and/or ECS. You've operated production workloads through incidents, upgrades, and growth.
* You're fluent in infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) and treat infrastructure changes with the same rigor as application code: reviewed, versioned, reproducible.
* You've built or rebuilt a CI/CD pipeline that teams actually use. You know what it takes to move an organization from manual deploys to automated ones, including the trust and process work that comes with it.
* You think about security and governance as design inputs rather than a review gate. Secrets, least privilege, audit trails, environment isolation, and who is allowed to push what, where.
* You've run AI systems in production, from the gateway layer (access control, provider routing, cost attribution, observability) to LLM-backed features, including their evaluation, monitoring, and versioning. Experience with MLOps is a plus as our needs grow.
* You can estimate cost and defend the number. You've modeled the spend of an architecture before it was built and adjusted the design when it didn't hold up.
* You're high agency. You set direction without waiting for a spec, make platform decisions with real consequences, and then own the migration. You hold positions firmly, change them on evidence, and leave behind a written trail.
* You're a problem solver. Application and data teams seek you out for collaboration on architecture, debugging, and trade-off analysis.
* You work in the open and hand things off deliberately. You write the runbook, train the second operator, and measure your success partly by how little depends on you being reachable.
* You explain decisions, risks and trade-offs clearly to engineers, non-engineers, and executives. You make teammates better through code review, pairing, and mentoring.
* You use AI agents for real multi-step work beyond autocomplete, and you verify what they produce against the real system.

title: Director of Safety
description:
Honor Technology's mission is to change the way society cares for older adults. As a leader in aging care innovation, Honor provides the technology, tools, and services that empower older adults to live life on their own terms. Honor's growing portfolio includes its consumer care brand, Home Instead, Inc., the world's leading provider of in-home care for older adults. With a global franchise network and more than 100,000 Care Pros, Home Instead delivers over 50 million hours of personalized care annually.

Together, Honor and Home Instead are setting a new standard for aging in place, backed by powerful technology, compassionate care, and a commitment to aging on your own terms.

Join us to create a new and better aging experience for our clients, their families, and our Care Professionals.

**About the Role**

We're hiring a Director of Safety to build and scale safety strategy for our distributed in-home care workforce. In this role, you will own reducing injury rates and severity, reducing workers' compensation spend, and driving a safe environment for clients and Care Professionals (CPs). You'll mine large, ambiguous, and imperfect datasets to surface the risk indicators that actually predict incidents and injuries, then design systemic solutions—built on technology, not just process—that hold up as we grow into new markets and service lines. You'll own the full workers' compensation lifecycle, building durable programs that manage costs more effectively. You will also partner with Product and Engineering to build tools and automation that make safety a scalable advantage rather than a manual, reactive function.

The right candidate has built and scaled safety, trust & safety, or risk programs inside a technology-enabled, high-growth, distributed workforce, using data and product thinking to solve problems at scale. You're equally comfortable diving into the details of a single incident investigation and stepping back to design company-wide systems. You think outside the box rather than defaulting to "industry best practice"—you can identify the handful of activities that actually move injury and cost outcomes, build the case for whichever investment they require, and influence outcomes across distributed teams who don't report to you. You can also translate messy, imperfect data into a clear, credible story for leadership.

This role is fully remote and can be based anywhere in the U.S. You'll manage your team remotely, so strong written communication and remote coaching skills are essential.

**As a Director of Safety at Honor, you will:**

**Safety Program Leadership**

* Own the safety operating model and architecture, balancing quick fixes with the larger structural changes the business needs as it scales.
* Build systemic solutions that address common in-home care hazards: environmental safety, mobility issues, infection control, client behavior, and more.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to build tools, automation, and product features that reduce risk, and make the case for the investment they require.
* Develop programs to build a culture of safety among Care Professionals and HQ employees.

**Workers' Compensation & Incident Management**

* Own the outcome of reducing workers' compensation spend, with end-to-end accountability for strategy and case management.
* Use data to find the levers that reduce claim cost and cycle time, and build durable programs and tooling that manage costs more effectively when injuries do occur, keeping claims on track at scale.
* Own vendor management and evaluate alternative models.
* Lead incident investigations and root cause analysis, and turn findings into corrective action plans that prevent recurrence.
* Maintain accurate incident records and reporting for leadership.
* Forecast reserves, build forward-looking budgets, and communicate financial impact to leadership. • Ensure compliance with OSHA and state-specific home care regulations.

**Data & Culture**

* Own the metrics that make safety and claims performance visible and enable early intervention.
* Communicate complex and imperfect data clearly to leadership, presenting findings and recommendations—including business cases for new investment—in terms executives can act on.
* Influence outcomes across distributed, cross-functional teams—franchise operators, field leaders, Product, and Engineering—who don't report to you directly.

**Leadership Principles We'll Assess in This Role**

* **Balance Incremental and Radical Change:** You know when to close the gap with a quick fix and when the data says to rethink the safety or claims model entirely. You push for durable, technology-enabled programs and you're willing to think outside the box and embrace unconventional approaches when a conventional fix won't hold.
* **Think Systemically:** You consider how a safety intervention ripples across markets, franchise operators, Care Pros, and clients before you act, and you build systemic solutions that leverage technology rather than one-off fixes. You identify the handful of activities that actually move injury rates and workers' compensation spend, rather than defaulting to "industry best practice."
* **Fly High & Dive Deep:** You work with large, ambiguous, and imperfect datasets to find the risk indicators hiding in the noise, and you know when to dive into the details of a single claim or incident versus stepping back to run the function at scale. You audit when the data and what you're hearing from the field don't match.
* **Drive Impact:** You own the outcome of reducing workers' compensation spend and building a safer environment for clients and Care Professionals—measured by injury rate and severity reduction, not activity. You communicate complex and imperfect data clearly to leadership and influence outcomes across distributed, cross-functional teams who don't report to you.

**We're Looking for You to Bring**

* 8+ years in safety, risk, trust & safety, or operations leadership, with a track record of scaling programs inside a fast-growing, technology-enabled, distributed workforce (delivery, rideshare, e-commerce fulfillment, on-demand services, logistics).
* Strong data skills (SQL, analytics, dashboarding) and a track record of working with large, ambiguous, and imperfect datasets to identify risk indicators, find root causes, and prioritize investment.
* Experience using technology and automation—not just process and headcount—to scale safety or operational outcomes.
* Experience owning workers' compensation end-to-end: claims, return-to-work plans, and provider relationships (or comparable risk/insurance claims experience).
* A track record of building the business case for investment, communicating complex and imperfect data clearly, and winning buy-in from senior leadership.
* Experience building and managing a remote team, including hiring, developing, and retaining talent as a function scales.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence outcomes across distributed teams—from frontline staff to executives.
* Working knowledge of OSHA and related regulatory frameworks, or the ability to ramp quickly from an adjacent regulated environment.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience at a technology-enabled, high-growth company (DoorDash, Amazon, Chewy, Instacart, Uber, Lyft, or similar) in safety, trust & safety, risk, or operations.
* Experience partnering with Product and Engineering to ship tools or product features that reduce risk at scale.
* Familiarity with modern safety/case management software, data platforms, and BI tools.
* Experience scaling a team through a period of significant growth, including building a leadership pipeline.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Identifies and leads direct reports, staff and agencies in management of efficient brand/product portfolio decisions including SKU rationalization, pricing, pack development and customer relations to deliver annual and long-term sales and profit objectives .

* Directs growth in marketing team’s business acumen including consumer insights, project management, financials, forecasting, building a business case, customer relations and presentation skills.

**Evaluation Metrics**

* Brand or Sub-brand $ Sales, $ Sales growth and Market Share, Margin targets
* Flawless execution of project deliverables
* On-time timeline deliverables
* Brand Health scores ( e.g. share of voice, brand equity purchase funnel, household panel indicators)
* Innovation & Renovation Concept Scores
* Innovation & Renovation $ Sales and New product performance vs. forecast
* KPIs met on consumer campaigns and communication activities
* Self-development and team development goals

**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field
* 8-10 years of brand management experience within the CPG industry
* 3+ years managing direct reports
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint)
* Strong interpersonal

**Preferred**

* MBA

**Work Designation**
This position is a Hybrid position at our Corporate Office which is 3 days onsite and 2 days remote.
  
  
**Pay Range**
USD $180,000.00 - USD $210,000.00 /Yr.
  
  
**About Us**
OUR FOUNDER, MOMOFUKU ANDO
  
  
There is only one company that can rightfully claim the Pinnacle of Noodledom. Only one company whose founder, faced with a Japanese food shortage after WWII, invented instant ramen and sparked a 3-minute global revolution. Only one whose spirit of innovation continues to provide simple, nourishing delight to billions of people. Only one that has been loved around the world for more than 60 years. There is only one Nissin Foods.
  
  
NISSIN IN THE U.S.
  
  
On a trip to the U.S. in 1966, Mr. Ando noticed Americans curiously eating forkfuls of noodles out of cups, instead of using bowls and chopsticks. With that simple observation, the worldwide Cup Noodles® phenomenon was born. Shortly after, Nissin officially put down its roots in the U.S. In 1972, our Gardena, CA, plant started production of Top Ramen®—the first instant ramen manufactured and sold in the U.S. And ever since, Nissin Foods USA has launched a continuous stream of new and innovative products for hungry, noodle-loving Americans.
  
  
WHY NISSIN?
  
  
Nissin Foods celebrates diversity and inclusion both in our brands and how we do business. Why? Innovation is best driven by diverse perspectives, which create unique results. Respect, steady professional growth, and quality work make our team stronger. We welcome quality folks to join Team Nissin and fulfill our mission to “make people happy by creating delicious, convenient and value-oriented Asian-inspired meal solutions.” If you celebrate innovation and love noodles, you belong here!

title: VP, Group Director, Integrated Production
description:
**Company Description**

EVERSANA INTOUCH® is a global, full-service marketing agency network serving the life sciences industry, and is the first – and only – agency network to be part of a fully integrated commercialization platform through EVERSANA®. We provide next-generation creative and media services, enterprise solutions and data analytics services for clients.

We get fired up when people talk about getting—and staying—healthy. That’s where we find our inspiration: in the very human experiences of patients, doctors, and even each other. Then, we collaborate on ways to make caring for one’s health more achievable, connecting patients and physicians with the information and tools they need.

We embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs.

 **Job Description**

**WHAT DOES A VP, GROUP DIRECTOR, INTEGRATED PRODUCTION DO?**

The VP, Group Director, Integrated Production oversees the Integrated Creative Production and teams. This role is responsible for the success, direction, motivation and financial impact of Integrated Creative Production which includes: video, broadcast, print, social content, art buying, emerging production, event production, AR/VR production and post-production (MGFX & editing) services both in terms of delivering on time and budget for clients as well as achieving creative excellence in tandem. Provides leadership and expert knowledge of the talent, techniques, and technology necessary to execute the work to the highest standards.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**  
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

* Functions as a lead Producer on large scale and high visibility production projects as needed
* Experience managing 12+ Producer, MGFX Designers and Editors
* Manages the Integrated Production and Post-Production teams directly
* Educates peers and clients on Integrated Production and Post-Production at EVERSANA INTOUCH
* Manages freelance and external vendor pool
* Manages freelance and contractor’s time and assignments
* Responsible for full team’s billability goals and meeting business needs
* Assigns agency Producers, Motion Graphics Designers and Editors to projects, helping to balance workloads
* Provides estimates and input to estimates as required
* Looks for ways to grow and further develop the department and services for the agency
* Attracts, develops and deploys production talent to ensure the best content and production value possible for the concept and the client.
* Accountable for the overall quality of work, ensuring goals are met and projects delivered on time and on budget.
* Takes a proactive role in business development efforts, helping prepare and present written, video and audio presentations.
* Defines individual goals for direct reports, providing mentorship, and managing performance reviews
* Advise project brand teams and clients on best practices, process, scope, schedules, and pricing, while building strong, resilient relationships along the way.
* Work closely with the Resource Management team and the Executive Producers of each affiliate to manage current workloads and best forecast incoming projects to secure adequate resources.
* Evolve operational processes and workflow documentation, while overseeing all aspects of the project life cycle from concept to delivery.
* Partners with Human Resources to identify and hire new Integrated Production talent, ensuring the department keeps pace with demand as well as recruiting through a lens of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
* Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.
* All other duties as assigned

**PEOPLE LEADER**

People leaders must possess both the skills to effectively accomplish these tasks and the emotional intelligence to do so in alignment with our cultural values. In addition to the critical management and leadership tasks listed above, this role also includes the following unique responsibilities:

* Responsible for and oversee their respective department.
* Interview, select and supervise the activities of the department staff; communicate interpret and discuss with team the company policies and procedures.
Determine job objectives, work methods and performance standards; review performance relative to departmental objectives discussion appraisal with each employee and performance; authorize and communicate salary changes, promotions, transfers, discipline, and discharge and administer all other personnel actions.  

  
  
**Qualifications**

**WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?**

**MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

* 15+ years’ experience in Integrated Production with progressively expanding roles in an advertising agency environment.
* Extensive understanding of the video and print production, motion graphics and video editing process, proactively educating others as needed.
* Confident at estimating hours and out-of-pocket costs on production related requests.
* Proven experience implementing solutions that deliver services with high-quality standards in a profitable and sustainable manner.
* Demonstrated experience working with and successfully hiring, managing, motivating, and developing team members.
* Comfortable with developing internal training materials and resources that support team/individual growth and development.
* Experience auditing and redesigning Integrated Production process and workflows.
* Stays on the edge of Emerging Production trends, integrating them into EVERSANA INTOUCH’s offerings as needed.
* Proficient in delegating tasks appropriately, providing guidance and support to ensure smooth project execution.
* Client facing experience
* Change management experience.
* Strong written and presentation skills.
* Exceptionally results-driven, responsible, and accountable.
* Eager to grow and continue to improve Integrated Production and Post-Production offerings at EVERSANA INTOUCH.
* Solid business acumen and problem-solving skills.
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and guide creative and production teams.
* Extensive conflict resolution skills and experience

  
**Additional Information**

**OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:**

**Patient Minded** I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

**Client Delight** I own every client experience and its impact on results.

**Take Action** I am empowered and empower others to act now.

**Grow Talent** I own my development and invest in the development of others.

**Win Together** I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.

**Communication Matters** I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.

**Embrace Diversity** I create an environment of awareness and respect.

**Always Innovate** I am bold and creative in everything I do.

Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.

EVERSANA is committed to providing competitive salaries and benefits for all employees. If this job posting includes a base salary range, it represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position and is not applicable to locations outside of the U.S. Compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, other job-related qualifications/skills, and geographic location (to account for comparative cost of living). This role is eligible for hire in select U.S. locations based on business and operational considerations. For a full list of locations, visit eversana.com/careers. More information about EVERSANA’s benefits package can be found at eversana.com/careers. EVERSANA reserves the right to modify this base salary range and benefits at any time.

From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws, it is the policy of EVERSANA to provide reasonable accommodation when requested by a qualified applicant or candidate with a disability, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship for EVERSANA. The policy regarding requests for reasonable accommodations applies to all aspects of the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the interview and hiring process, please contact us at applicantsupport@eversana.com.

title: Director, Digital Media Planning - Contract
description:
The **Director of Digital Media Planning** **(Contract)** is a vital participant in developing and executing strategic direction for the paid digital media programs of our clients, and guides the planning and media buying execution to acquire, cultivate, retain, and upgrade donors or customers. The ideal candidate will combine significant strategic planning, digital media management, analytic and account management experience, along with the ability to flourish in a fast-paced, creative environment with ever-shifting schedules and priorities. The Director of Digital Media Planning is a proactive self-starter that works with the leadership team towards an efficient, highly productive, steadfast department that executes upon all the inputs from other Moore Digital departments, sister agencies and clients.

  

**This position is remote within the US.**

  

**Moore Media and Digital**, a division of Moore, works to build donor surround sound with video, audio, and other digital messages. Part of this is through addressable media where you know who the person is you are targeting; this includes programmatic video, CTV, programmatic display, email, texting, and some social ads. And part is through non-addressable media like DRTV, traditional radio advertising, and other digital services like website design.

**Moore** is a data-driven constituent experience management (CXM) company achieving accelerated growth for clients through integrated supporter experiences across all platforms, channels and devices. We are an innovation-led company that is the largest marketing, data and fundraising company in North America serving the purpose-driven industry with clients across education, association, political and commercial sectors.

**Check out www.WeAreMoore.com for more information.**

  

**Your Impact:**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Digital Media Planners and Producers, fostering growth, collaboration, and high performance.
* Drive strategic media planning and forecasting for existing and prospective clients in partnership with internal teams and agency stakeholders.
* Serve as a senior client leader, providing strategic direction, overseeing campaign execution, and ensuring exceptional client service and results.
* Shape and optimize multichannel paid media strategies across search, social, programmatic, and emerging platforms to drive acquisition and revenue growth.
* Partner with analytics teams to develop meaningful reporting frameworks and actionable performance insights.Support business development efforts through RFP responses, media strategy development, revenue projections, and presentation of departmental capabilities.
* Champion innovation by identifying new advertising opportunities, technologies, and media approaches that improve client outcomes.
* Improve operational excellence by standardizing processes, removing roadblocks, enhancing communication, and ensuring timely delivery of media plans and reporting.
* Collaborate across teams, agencies, and partners to drive efficient execution and maximize campaign effectiveness.
* Contribute to departmental leadership by supporting workforce planning, team engagement, training initiatives, and continuous improvement efforts.

### **Your Background:**

* 8+ years of experience in digital media planning, buying, and strategy with expertise across programmatic, paid search, and paid social channels.
* Proven success developing media strategies that generate leads, customer acquisition, revenue growth, and measurable business outcomes.
* Demonstrated leadership experience managing, coaching, mentoring, and developing high-performing teams.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing analytics, reporting methodologies, and performance optimization.
* Experience managing multiple complex projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Exceptional client relationship management and stakeholder communication skills.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and solutions-focused with the ability to take initiative and drive projects forward.
* Collaborative leadership style with a customer-service mindset and ability to influence cross-functional teams.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Nonprofit fundraising and marketing experience preferred.

  

**How We’ll Support You:**

* Join the largest marketing and fundraising company in North America serving the nonprofit industry where we prioritize innovation and professional growth.
* Collaborate with industry subject matter experts with over 5,000 employees across the enterprise.
* To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including comprehensive healthcare, paid holidays and generous paid time off so you can have the time and space to recharge pursue your other passions and be with the people you care about.
* Moore is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Director, Product Design
description:
****🚀 Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!****
Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.
  
  
As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.
  
  
We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a strategic and inspiring Director of Product Design to lead our Buyer Design team, the group responsible for shaping the end-to-end experience for millions of users navigating our platform.
  
  
As the design leader overseeing the entire buyer journey, you'll drive the strategy and execution for everything from customer acquisition, activation, to retention and re-engagement. This includes onboarding, discovery surfaces (browse, search, ranking, personalization, taxonomy), the live shopping experience, customer service, our games team, and customer service flows.
  
  
You’ll be a true player-coach, equally comfortable building and developing a high-performing design team as you are rolling up your sleeves and doing the work yourself. You’ll help shape the team, establish clear career paths, mentor designers, and create an environment where people can grow and do their best work.
  
  
As a leader, you’ll help define the design strategy and set a clear vision for what our experiences can become, partnering closely with product, engineering, research, and business teams to turn that vision into a roadmap for the team.
  
  
As a practitioner, you’ll stay close to the work. You’ll move fluidly from defining the long-term experience vision to tackling specific product and feature-level design challenges - exploring concepts, prototyping ideas, and helping bring the details to life. This role is for someone who can lead through both direction and craft, knowing when to empower the team and when to jump in and design alongside them.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and scale a high-performing team of product designers across the buyer funnel.
* Define and drive the vision, strategy, and execution for the buyer experience in collaboration with cross-functional partners.
* Partner with research, data, and product to develop deep customer empathy and inform high-impact design decisions.
* Shape intuitive, elegant systems across discovery, live shopping, and post-purchase experiences.
* Ensure our experiences are accessible, inclusive, and delightfully human.
* Champion design quality and consistency across surfaces while enabling speed and iteration.
* Nurture a strong design culture through mentorship, feedback, and high standards for craft and thinking.
* Represent design in executive conversations and influence company-wide priorities.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years of product design experience, with at least 3+ years leading teams.
* A player-coach mindset-excited to mentor, but equally passionate about designing and solving problems hands-on.
* Strong portfolio showcasing interaction and visual design skills, with a track record of shipping successful products.
* Proven success designing and scaling customer-facing experiences across a complex funnel (acquisition through retention).
* Deep expertise in interaction design, systems thinking, and user-centered design.
* Strong understanding of search, discovery, personalization, and taxonomy design principles.
* Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, or live shopping platforms is a major plus.
* A strong collaborator who thrives at the intersection of product, business, and user needs.
* A portfolio that demonstrates thoughtful, elegant solutions to complex problems.

**Why You’ll Love This Role**
You’ll help define how the next generation of users discover, shop, and engage with sellers and communities they love. You’ll work alongside a passionate and ambitious team that values joy, experimentation, and deep customer empathy. And you’ll help build a design culture where creativity and performance go hand in hand.
  
  
If you’re an experienced design leader who loves craft, strategy, and collaboration, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
****Reporting Structure****
Jon Malkemus - VP of Design
  
  
**Please note: Whatnot will only contact you through official @whatnot.com email addresses. If you see an email impersonating a Whatnot recruiter, please disregard and report it as spam.**
****💛 EOE****
Whatnot is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, parental status, disability status, or any other status protected by local law. We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce.
